question: List the names of the games played by streams that have a total view count greater than 50,000,000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.total_view_count > 50000000 RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: Which movies released between 1990 and 2000 have more than 5000 votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000   AND m.votes > 5000 RETURN m.title, m.released, m.votes

question: Which movie has the highest budget?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 actors with the most roles in movies released before 1980.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.year < 1980 RETURN a.name, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many different types of switches are held in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(switch:Switch) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT switch.ip) AS numberOfSwitchTypes

question: Which movies have been rated exactly 5 stars by at least one user?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating = 5.0 RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which applications are dependent on the service with name 'java'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Service {name: 'java'})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(a:Application) RETURN a.name AS application_name

question: What are the first 5 movies that have a character played by a person with gender 1?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {gender: 1})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies where the main actor is also the director.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have a follower count between 200,000 and 500,000, listing the first 5?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers >= 200000 AND s.followers <= 500000 RETURN s LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 most followed users who mention 'neo4j' in their tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN u.name, u.followers ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify all tweets by 'Neo4j' that mention a user with at least 5000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) WHERE m.followers >= 5000 RETURN t

question: How many 'Machine' nodes are there in 'Rack' with 'zone' 2?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {zone: 2})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) RETURN count(m)

question: List the top 5 movies with the most number of IMDb votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbVotes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Provide the names of 3 actors who have also directed movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(a) RETURN a.name LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies with an average vote less than 5.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.average_vote < 5 RETURN m.title, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote LIMIT 3

question: Find the first 3 users who are moderators of more than one stream.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS num_moderated_streams WHERE num_moderated_streams > 1 RETURN u.name, u.id ORDER BY num_moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 streams have the highest follower count but the lowest total view count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.name, s.followers, s.total_view_count ORDER BY s.followers DESC, s.total_view_count ASC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 orders with the most different products included.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, count(DISTINCT p) AS numProducts ORDER BY numProducts DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN o.orderID, numProducts

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest IMDb rating that is shorter than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 WITH m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN m.title

question: List the intermediaries that have an active status.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary) WHERE i.status = 'ACTIVE' RETURN i.name AS intermediary_name, i.countries AS countries, i.address AS address

question: Which production companies have produced both movies and TV shows?
cypher: MATCH (pc:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) MATCH (pc)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(v:Video) RETURN DISTINCT pc.name

question: Identify officers connected to entities with a jurisdiction description of 'Samoa'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.jurisdiction_description = 'Samoa' RETURN o

question: List all customers who have placed orders with a required date in 1998.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate STARTS WITH '1998' RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, c.contactName AS contactName, c.customerID AS customerID

question: List the first 3 video titles that have been produced by 'Pixar Animation Studios'.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'}) RETURN v.title LIMIT 3

question: List the `name`s of the entities that are connected to filings with a `number` greater than 10 through the `BENEFITS` relationship.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.number > 10 MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT e.name

question: List the first 3 packages that provide the longest duration of access to movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.duration ORDER BY p.duration DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 VIPs in streams with a total view count exceeding 10 million?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WHERE s.total_view_count > 10000000 RETURN u.name AS vip_name ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 streams by total view count that also have a team?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) WHERE s.total_view_count IS NOT NULL RETURN s ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 most viewed games by streams that have a team?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE exists{(s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team)} RETURN g.name AS Game, sum(s.total_view_count) AS TotalViews ORDER BY TotalViews DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users have the most moderator relationships with other users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:MODERATOR]->(otherUser:User) RETURN u.name AS user, count(r) AS num_moderator_relationships ORDER BY num_moderator_relationships DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the people born in the 1960s who have directed a movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1960 AND p.born < 1970 RETURN p.name AS director, p.born AS birthYear

question: What are the top 5 movies by budget size?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the first 5 filings with the most entities involved as concerns from different sectors.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, COUNT(DISTINCT e) AS entityCount ORDER BY entityCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (f)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) RETURN f.sar_id AS FilingID, f.begin AS BeginDate, f.end AS EndDate, f.amount AS Amount, COLLECT(e.name) AS ConcernedEntities

question: "How long is the longest thread of replies?"
cypher: MATCH p=(t:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO*]->(:Tweet) RETURN length(p) AS longestThread ORDER BY longestThread DESC LIMIT 1

question: List streams that have a total view count greater than 500 million.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000000 RETURN s.name, s.url, s.total_view_count

question: What is the total revenue generated by movies in the "Adventure" genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) RETURN sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue

question: What is the tagline of the movie released in 1999?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 1999 RETURN m.tagline

question: Show the top 5 users by the number of movies they have rated.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, count(r) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.name AS user, numRatings

question: List top 5 actors by number of movies acted in.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.name AS actor, numMovies

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.release_date).month = 12 RETURN m.title

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 RETURN u.name AS vip_user, s.name AS stream

question: List the top 5 orders with the highest freight cost.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o ORDER BY o.freight DESC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Condiments'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN p.productName, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalQuantity ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 people who have directed and written the same movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person LIMIT 3

question: Name the languages spoken in streams with a total view count exceeding 10 million.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count > 10000000 RETURN DISTINCT l.name

question: List the names of the actors born in France.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor {bornIn: "France"}) RETURN a.name

question: List the top 5 movies with a released year before 1985.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1985 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 5

question: What are the languages available for the movie 'Toy Story'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS language

question: What are the 3 oldest movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 directors have directed the most movies with a budget over 200 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 200000000 WITH d, count(m) AS moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name, moviesDirected

question: Who has the longest name among all actors?

question: Who are the first 3 actors by the number of different movies acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, movieCount

question: What are the first 3 genres that have the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the three most commonly used hashtags in tweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'A solid romp' RETURN p.name

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.languages IS NOT NULL UNWIND m.languages AS language RETURN language, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 videos with the least revenue.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN v.title, v.revenue ORDER BY v.revenue ASC LIMIT 5

question: Which directors have the most number of movies with a rating greater than 8.0?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {gender: 2})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.average_vote > 8.0 WITH p, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN p.name, movieCount LIMIT 10

question: What is the runtime of the movie with the highest average vote?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.runtime, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 streams with the most chatters who are users.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS userChatters ORDER BY userChatters DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.id AS StreamID, s.name AS StreamName, userChatters

question: List all the genres associated with the movie 'Toy Story'.

question: Find all movies released between 1990 and 2000 with an average vote greater than 7.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('1990-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') AND m.average_vote > 7 RETURN m.title

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most significant number of languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH m, count(l) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movie, languageCount AS spokenLanguages

question: What are the top 5 most frequently spoken languages in videos?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS Language, count(v) AS VideoCount ORDER BY VideoCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average release year of movies reviewed with a rating above 80?
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 80 RETURN AVG(m.released) AS averageReleaseYear

question: What is the average runtime of movies in the "Drama" genre?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Drama'})<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.runtime) AS average_runtime RETURN average_runtime

question: List the first 3 orders shipped to France.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'France' RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName, o.shipCity, o.shipPostalCode, o.shipAddress, o.shipCountry, o.shippedDate ORDER BY o.shippedDate LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies directed by a person born in France?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: 'France'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies that have been directed by actors.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Find the product that has the lowest ratio of units on order to reorder level.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel <> 0 WITH p, (toFloat(p.unitsOnOrder) / toFloat(p.reorderLevel)) AS ratio ORDER BY ratio ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN p, ratio

question: Which customers (show `customerID` and `companyName`) have placed orders that include the product with the lowest `reorderLevel`?

question: List the start times of all processes running on machines in zone 2.

question: Which 3 videos have a poster path ending with 'jpg'?

question: List the first 3 languages used by streams that have more than 10,000 followers.

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany {name: "Pixar Animation Studios"}) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle LIMIT 3

question: Find the movies that have an overview.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.overview <> "" RETURN m

cypher: MATCH (a:Application) WHERE a.pid < 2000 RETURN a ORDER BY a.pid LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers supply products to more than one category?

question: List all services listening on port 80.
cypher: MATCH (s:Service)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN s.name

question: Identify all movies that were produced in a country other than the United States.

question: Which 3 production companies have produced movies in more than 3 different languages?

question: "who is the youngest director to direct a movie"

question: What are the first 3 types of machines located in DataCenter 'DC1'?

question: List the original addresses associated with the sourceID 'Panama Papers'.

question: Identify the top 5 products with the lowest reorder level.

question: Which 3 entities have filed the most number of filings concerning banks in 'Australia'?

question: Which products have been ordered by customers from Berlin?

question: List all movies that were both acted in and directed by the same person.

question: Which 5 directors have the most movies released in the 2000s?

question: Which actors have acted in movies directed by the person who directed 'Speed Racer'?

question: Which streams have a total view count greater than 10,000,000 and are played in English?

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest average vote and released after 2010?

question: List the top 5 entities with the highest number of filings where they are the beneficiary.

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE m.average_vote < 5 WITH c, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS country, movie_count

question: What are the country_codes of the address with node_id 14048584?
cypher: MATCH (a:Address {node_id: 14048584}) RETURN a.country_codes

question: List the first 3 movies directed by a person with gender 2.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {gender: 2})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 tweets containing the hashtag 'education'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that were part of more than one collection.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WITH m, count(c) AS num_collections WHERE num_collections > 1 RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Which movies released after 2010 have a budget over 100 million? Limit to 5 movies.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > '2010' AND m.budget > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.released, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 movies with a tagline containing the word 'limits'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'limits' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the first 5 suppliers that have provided products to more than three different customers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)<-[:PURCHASED]-(c:Customer) WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS distinctCustomers WHERE distinctCustomers > 3 RETURN s LIMIT 5

question: Find the first 3 users who have retweeted tweets posted by 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(rt:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(ru:User) RETURN ru LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC, s.total_view_count ASC LIMIT 3

question: Find the filings where the 'originator_bank' starts with the letter "D" and the 'beneficiary_bank' starts with the letter "B".

question: What are the first 3 most recently released movies with a revenue under 10 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue < 10000000 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 movies where the homepage URL includes 'disney'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage CONTAINS 'disney' RETURN m.title, m.homepage, m.popularity ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many streams are moderated by users who have "Chase" in their name?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WHERE u.name CONTAINS 'Chase' RETURN count(DISTINCT s)

question: List the movies where the spoken language is 'Gaeilge'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'Gaeilge'}) RETURN m.title

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game {name: 'Rust'}) WHERE s.followers > 100000 RETURN s.name

question: Name the top 5 directors who also reviewed the movies they directed.
cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(d) RETURN d.name AS Director, count(m) AS MoviesReviewedAndDirected ORDER BY MoviesReviewedAndDirected DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 `beneficiary_bank_country` values with the highest total number of filings where the `originator_bank_country` is "Andorra".
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = "Andorra" WITH f.beneficiary_bank_country AS beneficiary_bank_country, count(f) AS filing_count ORDER BY filing_count DESC RETURN beneficiary_bank_country, filing_count LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 directors based on the number of different countries their movies have been released in.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, count(DISTINCT m.countries) AS countriesCount ORDER BY countriesCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name, countriesCount

question: Which movie genre has the highest number of movies with a supernatural theme?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE toLower(m.plot) CONTAINS 'supernatural' WITH m, [(m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g) | g] AS genres UNWIND genres AS genre WITH genre, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN genre.name AS genreName, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: What are the titles of the movies directed by the person born in 1949?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {born: 1949})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title

question: Which 5 movies have the shortest runtime and are in the 'Released' status?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' AND m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime LIMIT 5

question: List the movies with a title starting with "The".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title STARTS WITH "The" RETURN m.title

question: What are the first 3 streams that have a language set to 'en' and a VIP who is a user?

question: List the top 5 movies with the most production companies involved.

question: Which routers are located in zone 4?

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify intermediaries that have registered addresses outside of their country of operation.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE i.countries IS NOT NULL AND a.countries IS NOT NULL AND NOT i.countries CONTAINS a.countries RETURN i.name AS IntermediaryName, i.countries AS CountryOfOperation, a.address AS RegisteredAddress, a.countries AS AddressCountry

question: List the top 3 directors who have worked with the most number of actors.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH d, COUNT(DISTINCT a) AS actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS directorName, actorCount

question: Which suppliers provide products with a reorder level above 25?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel > 25 RETURN s.companyName AS SupplierName

cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN d.name, count(m) AS movies_directed ORDER BY movies_directed DESC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.country = 'UK' RETURN s.contactName

question: Which genres are associated with movies that have a budget greater than 100 million dollars?

cypher: MATCH (v:Version {name: '7.1'})<-[:PREVIOUS]-(prev:Version) RETURN prev.name

cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH a, count(DISTINCT d) AS numDirectors WHERE numDirectors >= 3 RETURN a.name AS actor ORDER BY numDirectors DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 production companies have produced the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (pc:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) RETURN pc.name, count(m) AS movies_produced ORDER BY movies_produced DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of streams that have the language 'en' and more than 50,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = 'en' AND s.followers > 50000 RETURN s.name

question: Which 5 directors have directed movies in more than 3 different genres?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g) AS num_genres WHERE num_genres > 3 RETURN d.name AS director, num_genres ORDER BY num_genres DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which products are supplied by a supplier in 'London'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.city = 'London' RETURN p.productName AS productName, p.productID AS productID

question: What are the top 5 genres with the most movies having a poster path that starts with '/rh'?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path STARTS WITH '/rh' RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the stream with the most chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u) WITH s, count(DISTINCT u) AS chatter_count RETURN s.id, chatter_count ORDER BY chatter_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average rating of movies with the word "amazing" in their review summary?

question: List the streams with the most distinct teams associated.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH s, count(DISTINCT t) as teamCount RETURN s.name AS streamName, teamCount ORDER BY teamCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which streams have a total view count of between 1 million and 2 million and are moderated by at least three different users?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE s.total_view_count >= 1000000 AND s.total_view_count <= 2000000 WITH s, count(DISTINCT u) AS moderatorCount WHERE moderatorCount >= 3 RETURN s

question: Which 5 actors have acted in movies with the highest average imdbRating?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name, avgRating

question: Show the first 5 filings with the most entities involved as concerns from the same sector.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, count(e) AS entitiesCount ORDER BY entitiesCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f, entitiesCount

question: What are the first 3 collections that include videos?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) RETURN DISTINCT c LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 users with the lowest following counts who follow 'Neo4j'.

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:AMPLIFIES]->(user:User) RETURN count(user) AS AmplifiedUsersCount

question: What are the top 3 beneficiary ISO codes in the filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN f.beneficiary_iso AS BeneficiaryISO, count(f) AS NumberOfFilings ORDER BY NumberOfFilings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have starred in movies with a budget greater than 200 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 200000000 MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Which hashtags were used in tweets that mention users followed by the user with screen name "neo4j"?

question: "Did Keanu Reeves play any movies?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear, m.votes AS Votes, m.tagline AS Tagline

question: List the former and current names of entities with a 'same_name_as' relationship.
cypher: MATCH (e1:Entity)-[:same_name_as]->(e2:Entity) WHERE e1.former_name IS NOT NULL OR e2.former_name IS NOT NULL RETURN e1.name AS CurrentName1, e1.former_name AS FormerName1, e2.name AS CurrentName2, e2.former_name AS FormerName2

question: List the top 3 actors who have acted in movies with a tagline including the word 'limits'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'limits' WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, movieCount

question: Which actor has acted in the most movies with a budget greater than 200 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) WHERE movie.budget > 200000000 WITH actor, count(movie) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN actor.name, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: List the top 3 movies with a released date on a Friday.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released IS NOT NULL AND date(m.released).dayOfWeek = 5 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies with an IMDb ID starting with 'tt'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdb_id STARTS WITH 'tt' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: What is the disk size of the type 'l'?

question: What are the first 3 tweets that contain a link starting with 'https://twitter.com'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) WHERE l.url STARTS WITH 'https://twitter.com' RETURN t.text, l.url LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 categories with the most products?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, count(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.categoryName, productCount

question: What is the link value for the relationship connecting two Addresses with the same address?
cypher: MATCH (a1:Address)-[r:same_as]->(a2:Address) RETURN DISTINCT r.link

question: What are the names of the services running on the machine with the application 'webapp'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webapp'})<-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine) MATCH (machine)-[:RUNS]->(service:Service) RETURN service.name

question: Who are the top 3 users mentioned in the tweets that 'Neo4j' mentions?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentioned:User) RETURN mentioned.name, count(*) AS mentions ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which genre has the most movies that have been adapted into video games?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword)<-[:HAS_KEYWORD]-(v:Video) WITH m, count(DISTINCT v) AS videoGameCount WITH m, videoGameCount  MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount, avg(videoGameCount) AS avgVideoGameCount  ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN g.name AS genreName, movieCount, avgVideoGameCount LIMIT 1

question: List the games played by streams with the lowest follower counts.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL RETURN g.name AS Game, s.followers AS Followers ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 1

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY size(m.plot) DESC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Horror'}) RETURN a.title AS AdultFilmTitle, a.id AS AdultFilmID

question: List the top 5 movies with the tagline 'Welcome to the Real World' that were released after 1995.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline = 'Welcome to the Real World' AND m.released > 1995 RETURN m.title, m.released, m.tagline ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 3 entities based on the total amount of filings where the beneficiary bank's country is 'United Kingdom'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN e.name AS EntityName, sum(f.amount) AS TotalAmount ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 countries have the most filings as beneficiaries in the first half of any year?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE date(f.begin).month <= 6 WITH c, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.name AS Country, filingsCount

question: What is the average number of retweets for tweets that mention users who have interacted with 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'Neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) WITH user MATCH (user)<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet) WITH count(tweet) AS total_tweets, sum(tweet.favorites) AS total_retweets RETURN total_retweets/toFloat(total_tweets) AS avg_retweets

question: What is the date and time of the most recent tweet that mentions a user who has retweeted 'pranitahakim'?
cypher: MATCH (p:User {screen_name: 'pranitahakim'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(u:User) WITH u MATCH (u)<-[:MENTIONS]-(latestTweet:Tweet) RETURN max(latestTweet.created_at) AS mostRecentTweetDateTime

question: What is the total number of filings where the originator bank is located in the country with code "SGP", the beneficiary bank is located in the country with code "GBR", and the amount is greater than 1000000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(ob:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(oc:Country),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(bb:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(bc:Country) WHERE oc.code = "SGP" AND bc.code = "GBR" AND f.amount > 1000000 RETURN count(*) AS num_filings

question: What is the average rating given by people born before 1970?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born < 1970 MATCH (p)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: Show me the movies with a tagline containing the word "connected".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'connected' RETURN m.title

question: Show the top 5 beneficiary countries by the total amount received in transactions.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, sum(f.amount) AS TotalAmountReceived ORDER BY TotalAmountReceived DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 tweets by the total interaction (mentions, retweets, replies).
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WITH t, count(u) AS mentionsCount OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:RETWEETS]->(rt:Tweet) WITH t, mentionsCount, count(rt) AS retweetsCount OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:REPLY_TO]->(r:Tweet) WITH t, mentionsCount, retweetsCount, count(r) AS repliesCount RETURN t.id_str AS tweetId, t.text AS tweetText, (mentionsCount + retweetsCount + repliesCount) AS totalInteractions ORDER BY totalInteractions DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the `name`s of the entities that are connected to filings with a `number` greater than 10 and an `amount` less than 10000 through the `ORIGINATOR` relationship.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.number > 10 AND f.amount < 10000 RETURN e.name

question: Who has the most diverse roles across different movies?

question: List the top 3 movies that have been produced in the country 'United States of America'.

question: "provide all exposed ports and the processes behind , for the ip '10.3.0.254', check multiple possible paths if the result is empty"
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface {ip: '10.3.0.254'})-[:EXPOSES]->(p:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Router)-[:ROUTES]->(i2:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p2:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Egress)-[:ROUTES]->(i3:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p3:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Network)-[:ROUTES]->(i4:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p4:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Zone)-[:ROUTES]->(i5:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p5:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Switch)-[:ROUTES]->(i6:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p6:Port) OPTIONAL MATCH (i)<-[:ROUTES]-(:Machine)-[:ROUTES]->(i7:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p7:Port) WITH p, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7 UNWIND [p, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7] AS port MATCH (port)<-[:LISTENS]-(proc:Process) RETURN DISTINCT port.port AS ExposedPort, proc.name AS ProcessName, proc.pid AS ProcessID

question: Which movies have a cast member who has also worked in the crew of the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie)<-[:CREW_FOR]-(p) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS PersonName

question: What are the first 3 entities that have filed transactions where the originator bank is located in 'Angola'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Angola' RETURN e LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 actors have the highest average imdbRating for movies they acted in?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL WITH a, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN a.name, avgRating

question: Who are the first 3 directors of movies released in the 2000s?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 2000 AND m.released < 2010 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies that have been directed by directors born in Nebraska?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn = "Nebraska, USA" RETURN m.title, m.year, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 orders had a required date in 1996?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate STARTS WITH '1996' RETURN o ORDER BY o.requiredDate LIMIT 3

question: Which users have a betweenness higher than 1000000?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.betweenness > 1000000 RETURN u

question: What is the most common status for Intermediaries registered in South Africa?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {countries: 'South Africa'}) WITH i.status AS status, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC RETURN status, count LIMIT 1

question: What are the names of people who have directed movies with a budget over 50 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CREW_FOR {job: "Director"}]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN p.name

question: What are the total CPU resources allocated to machines in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN sum(t.cpu) AS TotalCPU

question: List all the streams that have a 'HAS_TEAM' relationship with a team whose name contains the word 'Stream'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.name CONTAINS 'Stream' RETURN s.name

question: Find all movies that have a keyword in common with "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'}) MATCH (toyStory)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(keyword) MATCH (otherMovie:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(keyword) WHERE otherMovie <> toyStory RETURN DISTINCT otherMovie.title

question: Which racks are located in zone 1 of the DataCenter 'DC1'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Rack {zone: 1}) RETURN r.name AS rackName

question: What is the average budget for movies in the same genre as "Toy Story"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Toy Story"})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH collect(g.id) AS toyStoryGenres MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE g.id IN toyStoryGenres RETURN avg(m.budget)

question: What is the average runtime of movies with a budget greater than 100000000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 RETURN avg(m.runtime)

question: What is the average number of 'followers' for users who have mentioned 'neo4j' in their tweets?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentioned:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WITH avg(u.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: Which movies have an IMDb ID that starts with 'tt00'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdb_id STARTS WITH 'tt00' RETURN m.title, m.imdb_id

question: List the persons who have written, directed, and produced the same movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) MATCH (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN p.name, m.title

question: What are the top 5 genres by the number of movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS NumberOfMovies ORDER BY NumberOfMovies DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all movies where the producer and director are the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:PRODUCED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movieTitle

question: List the first 3 products with a unit price less than $5.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < 5 RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 customers based on the number of orders placed.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.companyName, count(o) AS NumberOfOrders ORDER BY NumberOfOrders DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 videos by vote count?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) RETURN v.title, v.vote_count ORDER BY v.vote_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average CPU core count for machines running the 'cms' application?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'cms'})-[:RUNS]->(machine:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(type:Type) WITH avg(type.cpu) AS average_cpu_cores RETURN average_cpu_cores

question: "get the histogram of amounts by country"
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN c.name AS Country, f.amount AS Amount, COUNT(*) AS Frequency ORDER BY Amount

question: What is the average IMDB rating of movies released in the same year as "Finding Nemo"?
cypher: MATCH (nemo:Movie {title: "Finding Nemo"}) WITH nemo.year AS releaseYear MATCH (m:Movie {year: releaseYear}) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: "Which five entities have the highest transaction volume?"
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN e.name, SUM(f.amount) as total_volume ORDER BY total_volume DESC LIMIT 5

question: List 5 movies that have a runtime longer than 120 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 movies with a budget under 10 million that have generated over 100 million in revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 10000000 AND m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the 3 streams that play the least common games based on follower count.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH g, count(s) AS streamCount, max(s.followers) AS maxFollowers ORDER BY streamCount ASC LIMIT 3 MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g) RETURN s.name AS streamName, s.followers, g.name AS gameName ORDER BY s.followers DESC

question: List the top 5 movies with the most countries available in their languages list.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.languages IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.languages ORDER BY size(m.languages) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average age of directors of the top 5 voted movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p:Person) WITH m, p ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5 WITH p, m.released AS movieReleasedYear RETURN AVG(movieReleasedYear - p.born) AS averageAgeOfDirectors

question: Which movie has the lowest number of votes and was released after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 1

question: List the first 3 genres that have more than 50 movies associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, count(m) as movieCount WHERE movieCount > 50 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which persons have the name 'Joel' and have produced a movie with more than 100 votes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.name = 'Joel' AND m.votes > 100 RETURN p, m

question: What type of machine is 'DC1-RCK-4-9-M-103'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine {name: 'DC1-RCK-4-9-M-103'})-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN t.type AS machineType

question: Identify the top 5 users based on the number of posts they have made.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WITH u, count(t) AS num_posts ORDER BY num_posts DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.screen_name AS user, num_posts

question: Which actor has the most movies with a rating higher than 8.0 on IMDB?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.0 WITH a, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount

question: Who are the top 3 actors with roles in the most diverse genres (based on taglines)?
cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(DISTINCT m.tagline) AS num_genres ORDER BY num_genres DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN a.name AS actor, num_genres

question: Which movie had the largest number of actors participating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH m, count(a) as actorCount RETURN m.title as movieTitle, actorCount ORDER BY actorCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 users that 'Neo4j' follows?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed ORDER BY followed.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many people have directed more than two movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS directedMovies WHERE directedMovies > 2 RETURN count(p) AS numberOfDirectors

question: List the first 3 filings with entities that are both originator and beneficiary.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)<-[:BENEFITS]-(f) RETURN f ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: Find movies where the plot includes the word 'love' and were released on Valentine's Day.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'love' AND m.released ENDS WITH '-02-14' RETURN m.title, m.released, m.plot

question: Which users are moderators for streams with more than 500,000 total views?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000 RETURN u.name AS user, s.name AS stream, s.total_view_count AS views

question: List all movies with a revenue greater than 1 billion dollars.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 1000000000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.revenue AS revenue

question: Which countries have produced movies with an average vote greater than 8.0?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE m.average_vote > 8.0 RETURN DISTINCT c.name

question: What are the IPs of the top 3 Interfaces exposed to Port 80?
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN i.ip ORDER BY i.ip LIMIT 3

question: Find the streams that are both moderated and chatted in by the same user.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u) RETURN s

question: Which 3 streams have the most moderators?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS moderator_count ORDER BY moderator_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, moderator_count

question: What is the average `discount` applied to orders of the product with `productID` '72'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productID: '72'})-[:ORDERS]->(o:Order) RETURN avg(toFloat(o.discount)) AS averageDiscount

question: Which 3 movies have the longest runtime and were released before 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') AND m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which products are supplied by suppliers with a phone number ending in '2222'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.phone ENDS WITH '2222' RETURN p.productName AS productName

question: List all movies that have been rated by at least 5 different users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, count(DISTINCT u) AS userCount WHERE userCount >= 5 RETURN m

question: Find the streams that have a moderator who also moderates a stream with more than 10,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s1)-[:MODERATOR]->(m), (s2)-[:MODERATOR]->(m) WHERE s2.followers > 10000 RETURN DISTINCT s1

question: What are the names of users who have moderated other users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(otherUser:User) RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: What is the average number of movies acted in by actors born in each decade?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH floor(p.born / 10) * 10 AS decade, count(m) AS movies_acted_in RETURN decade, avg(movies_acted_in) AS average_movies ORDER BY decade

question: What are the top 5 languages in which the most adult films are originally made?
cypher: MATCH (:Adult)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(*) AS film_count ORDER BY film_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the three highest budget movies produced by 'Disney'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Disney' RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies did Lana Wachowski direct?
cypher: MATCH (lana:Person {name: "Lana Wachowski"})-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) RETURN movie.title

question: What are the first 3 movies with the status 'In Production'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'In Production' RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: How many orders have been shipped to each country?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH o.shipCountry AS shipCountry, count(*) AS orderCount RETURN shipCountry, orderCount

question: List the top 5 countries that have produced the most movies in the 'Comedy' genre.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) MATCH (m)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(m) AS MoviesProduced ORDER BY MoviesProduced DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 5 production companies that have produced the most adult films.
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(a:Adult) WITH p, count(a) AS numAdultFilms ORDER BY numAdultFilms DESC RETURN p.name, numAdultFilms LIMIT 5

question: Find all entities that have an officer with the country code 'WSM'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {country_codes: 'WSM'})-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT e

question: Find the tweets posted by 'Neo4j' that contain links. Limit to 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(link:Link) RETURN tweet.id, tweet.text LIMIT 5

question: Find the first 3 people who have written and directed the same movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person_name, m.title AS movie_title LIMIT 3

question: What is the average rating given by users to the movie "Toy Story"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})<-[r:RATED]-(:User) RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

question: What are the names of the top 3 entities that originated filings with amounts greater than 1000000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 1000000 WITH f MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH e, count(f) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC RETURN e.name AS entityName, filingCount LIMIT 3

question: What are the profile URLs of the top 3 users followed by 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed.profile_image_url ORDER BY followed.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with a revenue to budget ratio greater than 5?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue / m.budget > 5 RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.budget, m.revenue / m.budget AS ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 oldest streams based on the 'createdAt' property?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.createdAt AS created_at ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 directors who have a born date but no died date.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL AND d.died IS NULL RETURN d.name, d.born LIMIT 3

question: What is the average budget of movies that have grossed over $1 billion worldwide?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 1000000000 WITH avg(m.budget) AS average_budget RETURN average_budget

question: Find the first 3 users who have mentioned 'neo4j' in tweets and follow 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}),       (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m),       (u)-[:POSTS]->(t) RETURN u.screen_name ORDER BY t.created_at LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 3 streams that play a game and have a VIP who is a user.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(u:User) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, g.name AS game_name, u.name AS vip_user_name ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the `orderID` and the total number of products in each order.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, count(p) AS totalProducts RETURN o.orderID, totalProducts

question: "Who acted in the movie \"Inception\"?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: "Inception"}) RETURN p.name

question: What is the name of the director who has directed the most movies with a runtime over 2 hours?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 WITH d, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN d.name

question: Which 3 production companies have the most movies with a runtime under 80 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 80 RETURN p.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the inactivation date of the Entity named "TIANSHENG INDUSTRY AND TRADING CO., LTD."?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity { name: "TIANSHENG INDUSTRY AND TRADING CO., LTD." }) RETURN e.inactivation_date

question: Who directed the first 3 movies reviewed with a rating of 100 and what are their titles?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating = 100 WITH m ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3 MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN d.name AS director, m.title AS movie

question: What is the imdb id of the video 'Jonah: A VeggieTales Movie'?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video {title: 'Jonah: A VeggieTales Movie'}) RETURN v.imdb_id

question: What are the products in the order with ID '10248'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order {orderID: '10248'})-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p

question: What is the average total view count for streams that are chatted in by users who also moderate streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(:Stream) WITH DISTINCT u MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream) WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_view_count RETURN average_view_count

question: Name the first 3 movies with a released year divisible by 10.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released % 10 = 0 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have a runtime longer than 120 minutes and are categorized under the 'Drama' genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Drama'}) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN m

question: What are the top 3 genres by the number of movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(m) as movieCount RETURN g.name as genre, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average 'unitPrice' of products in each order?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o.orderID AS orderID, avg(toFloat(r.unitPrice)) AS avgUnitPrice RETURN orderID, avgUnitPrice

question: Show the top 5 tweets that 'Me' has replied to.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(reply_tweet:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO]->(original_tweet:Tweet) RETURN original_tweet ORDER BY reply_tweet.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the games played by users who are VIPs of streams with more than 1,000 followers and have a moderator who also moderates a stream with the language "en".
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers > 1000 MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(vip:User) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(mod:User) MATCH (mod)-[:MODERATOR]->(otherStream:Stream) MATCH (otherStream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (vip)-[:CHATTER]->(stream:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: Which products are associated with categories that have a description including 'sauces'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE c.description CONTAINS 'sauces' RETURN p.productName AS productName, c.categoryName AS categoryName

question: Who has reviewed the most movies with a rating above 90?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS reviewCount ORDER BY reviewCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which orders were placed by customers from 'Berlin'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {city: 'Berlin'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, o.orderDate AS orderDate, o.shipName AS shipName, o.shipCity AS shipCity, o.shipCountry AS shipCountry

question: Name 3 persons who acted in a movie released before 1980.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1980 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have a tagline containing the word "Speed"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Speed' RETURN m.title

question: What are the first 3 movies with a review summary 'An amazing journey' and their ratings?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'An amazing journey' RETURN m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 genres by the number of movies?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the top 3 products with the highest units on order and are part of the 'Dairy Products' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'}) RETURN p.productName ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: List entities with a jurisdiction description of 'Aruba' and their respective jurisdictions.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.jurisdiction_description = 'Aruba' RETURN e.name, e.jurisdiction

question: List the first 3 products with a unit price less than $5.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < 5 RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Which entities have a company number and what are those numbers?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.company_number IS NOT NULL RETURN e.name, e.company_number

question: List the 3 streams with the most distinct teams associated.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN s.name AS stream, collect(DISTINCT t.name) AS teams, count(DISTINCT t) AS num_teams ORDER BY num_teams DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 products with units in stock less than 10.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock < 10 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock ORDER BY p.unitsInStock ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 genres of movies produced by Pixar Animation Studios?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany {name: "Pixar Animation Studios"}) MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MoviesCount ORDER BY MoviesCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average amount of filings originated by entities located in China where the beneficiary bank is located in the United Kingdom?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {country: 'CHN'})-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: Which 3 filings have the smallest number of transactions but involve a beneficiary bank from 'India'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'India' RETURN f ORDER BY f.number ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 hashtags used by 'neo4j' in their tweets?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag:Hashtag) RETURN hashtag.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the first 5 genres that videos with a popularity rating above 5 belong to.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE v.popularity > 5 RETURN DISTINCT g.name LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 originator banks that filed filings to the beneficiary bank with id "barclays-bank-plc-london-england-gbr"?
cypher: MATCH (beneficiary:Entity {id: "barclays-bank-plc-london-england-gbr"})<-[:BENEFITS]-(filing:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity) WITH originator.name AS originatorName, count(filing) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC RETURN originatorName, filingCount LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have a homepage listed in their properties?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.homepage

question: What are the top 3 countries where adult films are produced the most?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(a:Adult) RETURN c.name AS country, count(a) AS adultFilmCount ORDER BY adultFilmCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of followers for users who are mentioned in tweets that are retweeted by "Neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: "neo4j"})-[:POSTS]->(:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(retweetedTweet:Tweet) WITH retweetedTweet MATCH (retweetedTweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentionedUser:User) WITH mentionedUser RETURN avg(mentionedUser.followers) AS average_followers

question: What are the first 3 categories in which 'Exotic Liquids' supplies products?
