question: What are the top 3 languages spoken in adult films with a vote count over 10?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE a.vote_count > 10 RETURN l.name, count(a) AS num_films ORDER BY num_films DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 people with the most crew roles in movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, roles

question: What is the total view count of all streams that are moderated by the user with id "129004176"?
cypher: MATCH (s1:Stream {id: "129004176"})-[:MODERATOR]->(s2:Stream) RETURN sum(s2.total_view_count)

question: Who reviewed movies with a rating higher than 90?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: What is the average number of followers for users who have replied to tweets that mention users followed by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'Neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) WITH followed MATCH (followed)<-[:MENTIONS]-(mentionedTweet:Tweet)<-[:REPLY_TO]-(replyingUser:User) WITH replyingUser RETURN avg(replyingUser.followers) AS average_followers

question: Who are the first 3 actors in the movie titled 'Speed Racer'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: List all actors born in the USA who have acted in at least two movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.bornIn = "USA" WITH a, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount >= 2 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount

question: What is the average amount filed by the entity with ID "the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp" between 2015-01-01T00:00:00Z and 2015-12-31T00:00:00Z?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {id: 'the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2015-12-31T00:00:00Z') WITH avg(f.amount) AS averageAmount RETURN averageAmount

question: List the intermediary names that have a registered address linked to them.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) RETURN i.name AS IntermediaryName

question: "how many actors have Tom Hanks acted with?"
cypher: MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActors:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT coActors) AS NumberOfCoActors

question: List the first 3 games played by streams with a language 'ja'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = 'ja' RETURN g.name LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of orders where the `shipCountry` is the same as the customer's country?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)<-[:PURCHASED]-(c:Customer) WHERE o.shipCountry = c.country WITH count(DISTINCT o.orderID) AS orderCount RETURN orderCount

question: List the first 3 orders that have been shipped to a region other than 'NULL'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shipRegion IS NOT NULL AND o.shipRegion <> 'NULL' RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName, o.shipCity, o.shipRegion, o.shipCountry, o.shipAddress, o.shipPostalCode, o.shippedDate ORDER BY o.shippedDate LIMIT 3

question: Which movies are associated with more than one production company?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany) WITH m, count(c) AS num_companies WHERE num_companies > 1 RETURN m.title AS movie, num_companies

question: List the 3 most recent filings involving 'Barclays Bank Plc' as the beneficiary bank.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing {beneficiary_bank: 'Barclays Bank Plc'}) RETURN f ORDER BY f.end DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most keywords associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, COUNT(k) AS keyword_count ORDER BY keyword_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, keyword_count

question: Who are the first 3 users that a specific user identified by screen name 'neo4j' follows?
cypher: MATCH (me:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed.screen_name, followed.name LIMIT 3

question: List the entities that have a company type of 'LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {company_type: 'LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY'}) RETURN e

question: List the directors who have directed movies in more than 3 different genres.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount WHERE genreCount > 3 RETURN d.name AS DirectorName

question: Name the top 5 movies with 'Animated' as a keyword.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'Animated'}) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average freight cost of orders placed by customers based in 'Germany'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.country = 'Germany' WITH avg(toFloat(o.freight)) AS averageFreight RETURN averageFreight

question: List the top 5 users who have rated videos the most.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(:Video) WITH u, COUNT(r) AS ratingCount ORDER BY ratingCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.id AS userId, ratingCount

question: List the movies with an average vote greater than 8.0.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.average_vote > 8.0 RETURN m.title

question: What are the top 3 ports listened to by the application 'webserver'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webserver'})-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN port.port AS PortNumber, count(port) AS Frequency ORDER BY Frequency DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the movies that share the same genre as "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: "Toy Story"})-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre:Genre) WITH genre MATCH (genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(movie:Movie) WHERE movie.title <> "Toy Story" RETURN DISTINCT movie.title

question: What are the top 5 games played by streams with more than 5000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 5000 RETURN g.name, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies that premiered in the last quarter of any year?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date IS NOT NULL AND m.release_date.month >= 10 RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show all officers of the entity with node_id 12160432.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity {node_id: 12160432}) RETURN o

question: What are the top 5 languages used by streams with more than 100,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 100000 RETURN l.name AS language, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the `original_name` of the entity with `name` "HOTFOCUS CO., LTD."?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "HOTFOCUS CO., LTD."}) RETURN e.original_name

question: Which streams have the description mentioning 'enjoy' and list the first 3.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'enjoy' RETURN s.name, s.description LIMIT 3

question: What is the country code of the entity that originated the filing with the second highest amount?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH f, e ORDER BY f.amount DESC WITH collect(f)[1] AS secondHighestFiling MATCH (secondHighestFiling)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.code

question: "Which director directed the least movies among the movies that the actor who acted in the most movies acted in?"
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH actor, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) WITH director, count(m) AS directed_movies ORDER BY directed_movies ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN director.name AS director_name, directed_movies

question: List the ports that the application "logstash" listens on.
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'logstash'})-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN port.port

question: List the three entities with the most filings involving a beneficiary bank in 'United Kingdom' and an originator bank in 'Singapore'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' AND f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e, filingsCount

question: How many streams are associated with each language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC

question: Which movies released before 2000 have a person who both acted and directed in them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) WHERE m.released < 2000 RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS person

question: Show the top 5 movies with the lowest average vote but highest revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.average_vote IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.average_vote ASC, m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 movies with a poster path ending in '.jpg'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path ENDS WITH '.jpg' RETURN m.title, m.poster_path ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 production companies by the number of comedy films produced?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN c.name AS company, count(*) AS comedyCount ORDER BY comedyCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which entities filed a report in March 2015 with an amount exceeding 500000?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.begin_date_format >= '2015-03-01T00:00:00Z' AND f.begin_date_format <= '2015-03-31T23:59:59Z'   AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN e

question: Identify the first 3 users who have retweeted tweets mentioning 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(rt:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User {name: 'Neo4j'}) RETURN u LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 3 hashtags used in tweets that mention 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'Neo4j' RETURN h.name AS hashtag LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 most popular movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.popularity AS popularity ORDER BY popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 directors have directed movies in more than 5 different languages?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, count(DISTINCT m.languages) AS num_languages WHERE num_languages > 5 RETURN d.name, num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which three filings had the longest duration from begin to end in 2009?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2009-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2009-12-31T23:59:59Z') WITH f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id, f.begin, f.end, duration

question: What are the first 3 filings with the highest total number of concerns?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, COUNT(e) AS concern_count ORDER BY concern_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, concern_count

question: "Recommend for me category with the least quantity?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) RETURN c.categoryID, c.categoryName, SUM(p.unitsInStock) AS totalUnitsInStock ORDER BY totalUnitsInStock ASC LIMIT 1

question: Show the first 3 movies that feature an actor from France.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.bornIn = "France" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.year AS ReleaseYear ORDER BY m.year LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies that have a poster path available.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.poster_path ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 products by reorder level.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel ORDER BY p.reorderLevel DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 most common supplier countries?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(:Product) RETURN s.country AS Country, count(s) AS NumberOfSupplies ORDER BY NumberOfSupplies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the 3 persons with the most directed movies that have a tagline?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL WITH p, count(m) AS directedMovies ORDER BY directedMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, directedMovies

question: What addresses are registered to entities in Hong Kong?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE e.countries = "Hong Kong" RETURN a.address AS registered_address

question: What are the movies with a budget over 200 million dollars and a revenue under 500 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 200000000 AND m.revenue < 500000000 RETURN m.title AS title, m.budget AS budget, m.revenue AS revenue

question: Which 3 filings have the largest amounts where the beneficiary bank's country is 'United Kingdom'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total amount of filings where the beneficiary entity's name contains the word "Bank"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WHERE b.name CONTAINS 'Bank' WITH sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount RETURN totalAmount

question: Which movies feature 'Tom Hanks' as a cast member?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which 3 adult films have the tagline 'Humiliation. Rape. Murder. You know the drill.'?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.tagline = 'Humiliation. Rape. Murder. You know the drill.' RETURN a.title LIMIT 3

question: Which products have been ordered with a discount of 0 and are from the 'Dairy Products' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'}),       (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS {discount: '0'}]->(p) RETURN p.productName

question: What are the first 3 movies with the highest number of associated production companies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany) RETURN m.title AS movie, count(c) AS num_production_companies ORDER BY num_production_companies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the three users with the most mentions in tweets?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)<-[:MENTIONS]-(t:Tweet) RETURN u.name AS user, count(*) AS mentions ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the person who has acted in both movies and videos?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:CAST_FOR]->(:Video) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Which movies have been rated exactly 5 by more than one user?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WHERE r.rating = 5 WITH m, COUNT(u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 1 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, userCount

question: What is the average vote count for movies released after the year 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.release_date) > date('2000-01-01') RETURN avg(m.vote_count) AS average_vote_count

question: Which actors have acted in movies with more than 60 votes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 60 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: What is the average amount filed by entities based in Singapore to entities based in the United Kingdom between 2015-03-25 and 2015-09-25?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin_date_format >= "2015-03-25" AND f.begin_date_format <= "2015-09-25" MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(org:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "Singapore"}) MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(ben:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c2:Country {name: "United Kingdom"}) WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: List all movies where Tom Hanks acted in.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title

question: List the top 3 movies with roles played by persons born in the 1940s.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1940 AND p.born < 1950 WITH m, count(r) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, role_count AS RolesCount

question: List the top 3 users who have moderated the most streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS moderated_streams ORDER BY moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name, moderated_streams

question: List the categories of products that have never been reordered (reorder level is 0).
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 0 RETURN DISTINCT c.categoryName

question: What is the quantity of product '72' in the order with orderID '10248'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order {orderID: '10248'})- [order:ORDERS]->(p:Product {productID: '72'}) RETURN order.quantity

question: Find all networks routing to the interface with IP '10.4.8.254'.
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface {ip: '10.4.8.254'})<-[:ROUTES]-(n:Network) RETURN n.ip AS network_ip, n.size AS network_size, n.zone AS network_zone

question: List the top 3 genres with the most movies associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the customers who have placed orders that were shipped earlier than the required date.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.shippedDate < o.requiredDate RETURN c.companyName

question: Find the streams by 'itsbigchase' and list their games.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.name = 'itsbigchase' RETURN s.id, g.name

question: "who had acted in the movie name \"Following\"?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: "Following"}) RETURN p.name

question: List the top 5 highest voted movies on IMDb.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.imdb_id, m.vote_count ORDER BY m.vote_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many applications are running on machines in zone 2?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack {zone: 2})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application) RETURN count(DISTINCT app) AS numberOfApplications

question: List the movies that have been both directed and acted in by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS person

question: List the movies that belong to a collection.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) RETURN m.title AS movie_title, c.name AS collection_name

question: List the first 3 directors born in the USA.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.bornIn = "USA" RETURN d.name, d.bornIn ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 videos that have been produced in more than one country.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH v, count(c) AS num_countries WHERE num_countries > 1 RETURN v LIMIT 3

question: Identify products with a unit price greater than 50 and are in the 'Confections' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) WHERE p.unitPrice > 50 RETURN p

question: How many machines run the service 'java' in the DataCenter 'DC1'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(s:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN count(m) AS NumberOfMachinesRunningJava

question: Which 3 adult films have the highest average vote?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.average_vote IS NOT NULL RETURN a.title, a.average_vote ORDER BY a.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the orders that include products from the 'Seafood' category and were shipped to France.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Seafood'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)-[:ORDERS]->(o:Order)-[:PURCHASED]->(cust:Customer) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'France' RETURN o.orderID, o.shippedDate, cust.companyName

question: Which genre has the highest average box office gross outside of the 'United States of America'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.name <> 'United States of America' WITH m, c MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, SUM(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WITH g, totalRevenue / movieCount AS averageRevenue ORDER BY averageRevenue DESC RETURN g.name AS genre, averageRevenue LIMIT 1

question: List the names and IMDb ratings of the movies directed by the director with the highest average IMDb rating.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 1 WITH d MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating

question: List the first 5 people born before 1980 who wrote a movie with a tagline mentioning 'speed'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1980 AND m.tagline CONTAINS 'speed' RETURN p.name, m.title, m.tagline LIMIT 5

question: Which person has acted in movies with the most diverse range of release years?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT m.released) AS releaseYears, max(m.released) AS maxYear, min(m.released) AS minYear WITH p, size(releaseYears) AS distinctReleaseYears, maxYear, minYear, (maxYear - minYear) AS releaseYearRange ORDER BY releaseYearRange DESC RETURN p.name, releaseYearRange, distinctReleaseYears, minYear, maxYear ORDER BY releaseYearRange DESC, distinctReleaseYears DESC LIMIT 1

question: What movies had a budget greater than 100 million dollars and were directed by a director born in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 AND exists {   (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m)   WHERE d.bornIn CONTAINS 'USA' } RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.year

question: Which movies have a homepage listed in their properties?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage IS NOT NULL RETURN m

question: What are the top 5 production companies by the number of movies with a runtime longer than 100 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WHERE m.runtime > 100 WITH pc, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN pc.name, movies_count

question: Find the movies that were released in the year 1995.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.release_date).year = 1995 RETURN m.title

question: Which 3 directors were born before 1900?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born < date('1900-01-01') RETURN d.name, d.born ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 3

question: Find the streams with the most user chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount

question: Find all movies where an actor also worked as a director.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN m.title

question: List the first 3 filings with the longest duration and involve entities from more than two countries.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS|:ORIGINATOR|:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS dur, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS countries WHERE size(countries) > 2 RETURN f.id, f.begin, f.end, dur, countries ORDER BY dur DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the tweets that mention a user who follows "Neo4j" and contain a link.
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) MATCH (neo4j)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:User) MATCH (follower)<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Link) RETURN tweet.id_str, tweet.text

question: Which 3 languages are most common in movies with a budget over $30 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.budget > 30000000 RETURN l.name, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which DataCenter has the egress named 'DC1-RE'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(e:Egress {name: 'DC1-RE'}) RETURN dc.name

question: List the roles of actors in the top 5 movies with the most votes.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS Movie, p.name AS Actor, r.roles AS Roles ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 processes dependent on the service named 'java'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Service {name: 'java'})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(p:Process) RETURN p.name, p.startTime, p.pid LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of Entities that are concerned by Filings involving more than $1,000,000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.amount > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT e.name

question: What are the top 5 users with the highest number of followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have ordered products with a total quantity greater than 50?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c, SUM(r.quantity) AS totalQuantity WHERE totalQuantity > 50 RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, totalQuantity

question: What are the top 3 countries of entities with the service provider 'Mossack Fonseca'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' WITH e.countries AS country, COUNT(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN country, count

question: What are the movies that have a plot containing the word 'zombie' with an IMDb rating over 7?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'zombie' AND m.imdbRating > 7 RETURN m

question: Find the tweets where 'neo4j' has been mentioned by users with more than 10000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WHERE u.followers > 10000 RETURN t.text, t.created_at, u.screen_name, u.followers

question: What are the top 5 streams with the highest total view count and are associated with the 'ESO Stream Team'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: 'ESO Stream Team'}) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.total_view_count AS total_views ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have been both highly rated and have high revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.average_vote IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC, m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 orders have the most distinct products included?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, count(DISTINCT p.productID) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN o.orderID, productCount

question: What is the source ID for the Officer with name "MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD."?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {name: "MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD."}) RETURN o.sourceID

question: List the first 3 movies that have been both produced and reviewed by people born before 1960.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1960 AND exists {   (p)-[:REVIEWED]->(m) } RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users have VIP status in the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, COUNT(s) AS vip_stream_count ORDER BY vip_stream_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName, vip_stream_count

question: List the top 5 originator banks that have originated filings with the highest average amounts.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH e.name AS originator_bank, AVG(f.amount) AS avg_amount ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN originator_bank, avg_amount

question: What are the URLs of the first 3 streams with the most languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH s, count(l) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.url AS streamURL

question: "Which actor worked with the same actors as Ron Burgundy?"
cypher: MATCH (ron:Person {name: "Ron Burgundy"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActor:Person),       (coActor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(otherActor:Person) WHERE NOT otherActor.name = "Ron Burgundy" RETURN DISTINCT otherActor.name

question: List all the movies produced by Joel Silver.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m

question: List the top 3 movies with a released date on a Friday.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.released).weekday = 5 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the first 3 actors who have acted in more than one movie with a tagline containing the word 'freedom'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'freedom' WITH p, count(m) AS moviesCount WHERE moviesCount > 1 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: List the entities that were incorporated in 2006 and their current status.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date CONTAINS '2006' AND e.status IS NOT NULL RETURN e.name, e.status

question: Which orders were required by a date earlier than '1997-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate < '1997-01-01' RETURN o

question: Identify the first 3 users followed by 'Neo4j' who have more than 500 followers.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) WHERE followed.followers > 500 RETURN followed.screen_name, followed.followers ORDER BY followed.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average IMDB rating of movies released in the same year as "Boxtrolls, The"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Boxtrolls, The"}) WITH m.year AS releaseYear MATCH (otherMovies:Movie) WHERE otherMovies.year = releaseYear WITH avg(otherMovies.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: Show the first 3 movies that have been rated below 3.0 by any user.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WHERE r.rating < 3.0 RETURN m.title, r.rating, u.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 5 services that a machine in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1' can run?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(service:Service) RETURN service.name LIMIT 5

question: Find the suppliers who have the highest average unit price for their products.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, avg(p.unitPrice) AS averageUnitPrice WITH s, averageUnitPrice ORDER BY averageUnitPrice DESC WITH s.companyName AS supplierName, collect(averageUnitPrice)[0] AS averageUnitPrice RETURN supplierName, averageUnitPrice

question: What are the top 3 hashtags used in tweets posted by 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag) RETURN hashtag.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 adult films that have a runtime longer than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.runtime > 90 RETURN a.title ORDER BY a.title LIMIT 3

question: List the movies that have a budget of zero.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget = 0 RETURN m.title

question: Which streams have a description containing 'premiere' and have at least 5000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'premiere' AND s.followers >= 5000 RETURN s

question: List the top 3 tweets with the highest number of favorites.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 people who have acted in at least two movies with more than 100 votes each?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 100 WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount >= 2 RETURN p.name AS person, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the addresses that have been registered after 2010 in the Panama Papers.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address) WHERE a.valid_until IS NOT NULL AND a.sourceID = 'Panama Papers' AND toInteger(substring(a.valid_until, -4)) > 2010 RETURN a

question: What are the most recent three movies added to the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the `productName` and `supplierID` for the product with the lowest `unitPrice` in each category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, min(p.unitPrice) AS minPrice, collect(p) AS products WITH c, minPrice, [product IN products WHERE product.unitPrice = minPrice][0] AS productWithMinPrice RETURN productWithMinPrice.productName, productWithMinPrice.supplierID, c.categoryName

question: What are the products with 'unitsInStock' less than 5?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock < 5 RETURN p

question: What is the average amount of filings in the database?
cypher: MATCH ()-[r:BENEFITS|CONCERNS|ORIGINATOR|FILED]->() WITH count(*) AS total_filings RETURN avg(total_filings) AS average_filings

question: Show all products with a 'reorderLevel' of 25 or higher.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel >= 25 RETURN p

question: What are the names of users who are moderators for more than three streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS num_moderated_streams WHERE num_moderated_streams > 3 RETURN u.name AS user_name

question: What are the names of all machines in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1' and their respective applications?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(a:Application) RETURN m.name AS MachineName, a.name AS ApplicationName

question: Find the entities that are originators of filings where the beneficiary entity's name contains "Bank" and the amount is greater than 100000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WHERE b.name CONTAINS 'Bank' AND f.amount > 100000 RETURN DISTINCT o

question: How many entities are connected to the address with node_id 24000001?
cypher: MATCH (a:Address {node_id: 24000001})<-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity) RETURN count(e) AS numberOfEntities

question: Which keyword is associated with the most number of movies with an average vote greater than 7.0?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.average_vote > 7.0 WITH k, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN k.name AS keyword, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 beneficiary banks in transactions involving multiple currencies?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_iso IS NOT NULL AND f.beneficiary_iso IS NOT NULL AND f.originator_iso <> f.beneficiary_iso RETURN e.name AS BeneficiaryBank, count(f) AS Transactions ORDER BY Transactions DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 actors by number of different genres they've acted in.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name, genreCount

question: List the top 5 movies that have been rated the most number of times.
cypher: MATCH (:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, COUNT(r) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS title, numRatings

question: Which 5 keywords are most common in adult films with a budget less than 500,000 USD?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE a.budget < 500000 RETURN k.name AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS occurrences ORDER BY occurrences DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 5 streams created in 2021?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.createdAt >= datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND s.createdAt < datetime('2022-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 5 tweets with links and sort them by number of favorites.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) RETURN t.id, t.text, t.favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the customers who have purchased products from the same supplier as 'Alfreds Futterkiste'.
cypher: MATCH (targetCustomer:Customer {companyName: 'Alfreds Futterkiste'}) WITH targetCustomer.customerID AS targetCustomerID MATCH (targetCustomer:Customer {customerID: targetCustomerID})-[:PURCHASED]->(:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(product:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(supplier:Supplier) WITH targetCustomerID, collect(DISTINCT supplier.supplierID) AS targetSupplierIDs MATCH (otherCustomer:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(supplier:Supplier) WHERE supplier.supplierID IN targetSupplierIDs AND otherCustomer.companyName <> 'Alfreds Futterkiste' RETURN DISTINCT otherCustomer.companyName, otherCustomer.customerID

question: List the product names of discontinued products that have been ordered at least once.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {discontinued: TRUE})<-[:ORDERS]-() RETURN DISTINCT p.productName

question: List the top 3 movies with a budget over 100 million USD and an average vote above 7.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 AND m.average_vote > 7 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 filings by the number of concerned entities.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, COUNT(e) AS concernedEntitiesCount ORDER BY concernedEntitiesCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS FilingID, concernedEntitiesCount

question: What is the average discount applied to orders placed in '1998'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.orderDate STARTS WITH '1998' WITH sum(toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * toFloat(rel.quantity) * (toFloat(rel.discount) / 100)) AS totalDiscount, count(o) AS orderCount RETURN totalDiscount/orderCount AS averageDiscount

question: What is the average age of directors at the time of their movie release?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH m.released - p.born AS age RETURN avg(age) AS average_age

question: Which streams have more followers, those playing "Rust" or "VALORANT"?
cypher: MATCH (rust:Game {name: "Rust"})<-[:PLAYS]-(rust_stream:Stream) MATCH (valorant:Game {name: "VALORANT"})<-[:PLAYS]-(valorant_stream:Stream) WITH rust, sum(rust_stream.followers) AS total_rust_followers, valorant, sum(valorant_stream.followers) AS total_valorant_followers RETURN case when total_rust_followers > total_valorant_followers then rust.name  when total_rust_followers = total_valorant_followers then 'Both games have the same number of followers' else valorant.name end AS most_popular_game

question: Which 5 movies were released after 2010 and have a vote count over 1000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date > date('2010-01-01') AND m.vote_count > 1000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 movies that have been rated 10 times or more?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS ratingCount WHERE ratingCount >= 10 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, ratingCount ORDER BY ratingCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the top five people who have reviewed a movie with a rating less than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN p.name, COUNT(m) AS movies_reviewed ORDER BY movies_reviewed DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 3 officers with the most connections to entities?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WITH o, count(e) AS connections ORDER BY connections DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN o.name, connections

question: Which movies have a revenue greater than 50 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 50000000 RETURN m

question: List the names of the first 3 applications that are running on machines in rack 1.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {rack: 1}) -[:HOLDS]-> (m:Machine) -[:RUNS]-> (a:Application) RETURN a.name LIMIT 3

question: Show the first 5 entities that have been beneficiaries the most times.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WITH e, count(f) as benefit_count ORDER BY benefit_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name as EntityName, benefit_count

question: Find all Addresses in Samoa that are linked to Entities with the service provider "Mossack Fonseca".
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: 'Mossack Fonseca'})-[:registered_address]->(a:Address {countries: 'Samoa'}) RETURN DISTINCT a

question: How many entities have an entity_number?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.entity_number IS NOT NULL RETURN count(e) AS entity_count

question: Identify the top 3 users by the number of people they are following.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.screen_name, u.following ORDER BY u.following DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of entities incorporated in Samoa?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {jurisdiction_description: "Samoa"}) RETURN e.name

question: List the first 3 genres with the most adult films associated.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(a:Adult) WITH g, count(a) AS adultCount ORDER BY adultCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS Genre, adultCount

question: "Which movies did Keanu Reeves play in?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title;

question: List the top 5 streams based on their creation date.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 `originator_bank_country` values with the highest average filing `amount`.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f.originator_bank_country AS originator_bank_country, avg(f.amount) AS avgAmount ORDER BY avgAmount DESC RETURN originator_bank_country, avgAmount LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 categories with the most products.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS category, COUNT(p) AS productCount RETURN category, productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 5 filings that ended in the year 2016 and involve an originator bank from 'Canada'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.end >= datetime('2016-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end < datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00Z')   AND c.name = 'Canada' RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 entities that have filed the most transactions with a beneficiary in 'China'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'China'}) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS transaction_count ORDER BY transaction_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, transaction_count

question: List the first 3 movies with the most different directors involved.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, size([(m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d) | d]) AS numDirectors ORDER BY numDirectors DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movie, numDirectors

question: What are the names of the top 3 suppliers based on the number of cities they supply to?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT o.shipCity) AS cityCount ORDER BY cityCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName, cityCount

question: What is the average revenue of movies released during the summer blockbuster season (May-August)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.release_date) >= date('1900-05-01') AND date(m.release_date) <= date('1900-08-31') WITH avg(m.revenue) AS average_revenue RETURN average_revenue

question: What is the average runtime of movies directed by the same director as "Finding Nemo"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Finding Nemo"})<-[:DIRECTED]-(d) WITH d MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(otherMovies) WITH avg(otherMovies.runtime) AS averageRuntime RETURN averageRuntime

question: What are the top 5 movies sorted by revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many people who acted in movies released in 1999 were born before 1960?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 1999 AND p.born < 1960 RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS result

question: Find the supplier who supplies the least number of distinct products to customers in 'USA'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {country: 'USA'}) MATCH (c)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) MATCH (o)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p) WITH s, count(DISTINCT p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount ASC RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, productCount LIMIT 1

question: Which movies have been tagged with the keyword 'jealousy'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'jealousy'}) RETURN m.title

question: Which products have a unitsOnOrder greater than 50?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 50 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder

question: List the first 5 streams that have changed their primary game at least once.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS gameCount WHERE gameCount > 1 RETURN s.name AS streamName, s.id AS streamId ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 5 users that 'Neo4j' interacts with and also follows?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) MATCH (me)-[:FOLLOWS]->(user) RETURN user.screen_name, user.followers, user.following ORDER BY user.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 suppliers have provided products to the most distinct categories?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS distinctCategories ORDER BY distinctCategories DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName, distinctCategories

question: List the names of all applications running on machines located in rack 'DC1-RCK-4-9'.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-4-9'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) MATCH (m)-[:RUNS]->(a:Application) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Display all products with 'unitsOnOrder' greater than 20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 20 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder

question: Retrieve the top 5 filings with beneficiary banks located in 'Singapore' and amounts less than 300000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'Singapore'}) WHERE f.amount < 300000 RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 movies with the highest budget to revenue ratio?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue > 0 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, (toFloat(m.budget) / m.revenue) AS budgetToRevenueRatio ORDER BY budgetToRevenueRatio DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the orders that include products supplied by suppliers located in 'USA'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {country: 'USA'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN DISTINCT o.orderID

question: Find the users who are both VIPs and chatters of streams that have "Dota 2" as a played game.
cypher: MATCH (user:User)-[:VIP]->(stream:Stream) MATCH (stream)-[:PLAYS]->(game:Game { name: "Dota 2" }) MATCH (user)-[:CHATTER]->(stream) RETURN DISTINCT user.name

question: List the top 3 games with the lowest average number of followers for streams playing them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH g, avg(s.followers) AS avg_followers ORDER BY avg_followers ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS game_name, avg_followers

question: Which 3 products have been ordered the most frequently?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(:Order) WITH p, count(*) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.productName, orderCount

question: Who are the first 3 actors by number of roles in movies with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' RETURN p.name AS actor, COUNT(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average freight cost per product for orders shipped to 'Germany'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'Germany' WITH o, sum(toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * rel.quantity) AS totalOrderCost, count(DISTINCT p) as productCount RETURN sum(totalOrderCost) / sum(productCount) AS averageFreightCostPerProduct

question: Which officers have a similar name or address to another officer?
cypher: MATCH (o1:Officer)-[:similar]->(o2:Officer) RETURN o1.name AS Officer1, o2.name AS Officer2

question: What is the name of the Data Center that contains the Rack that holds the Machine that runs the Application with the name 'webapp'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webapp'})<-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine)<-[:HOLDS]-(rack:Rack)<-[:CONTAINS]-(dc:DataCenter) RETURN dc.name

question: Which streams are part of teams created after 2018 and what are the team names?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt > datetime('2018-01-01') RETURN s.name AS stream, t.name AS team

question: Identify the top 3 entities that have filed the least amount of filings but have the highest amounts in those filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount, sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount ORDER BY filingsCount ASC, totalAmount DESC RETURN e.name, filingsCount, totalAmount LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 products have the highest units in stock?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock ORDER BY p.unitsInStock DESC LIMIT 3

question: "return all nodes in the database"
cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN n

question: Which type of machine has the maximum CPU capacity?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) RETURN t.name AS machineType, t.cpu AS cpuCapacity ORDER BY t.cpu DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many streams have a description that contains the word "Welcome"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'Welcome' RETURN count(s)

question: What is the name of the Process that has the most incoming connections from other Processes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)<-[r:DEPENDS_ON]-(other:Process) WITH p, count(r) AS incoming_count ORDER BY incoming_count DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS process_name

question: Which movies have been reviewed with a summary stating 'Dark, but compelling'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'Dark, but compelling' RETURN m.title

question: Retrieve the first 3 filings with an originator bank country of 'Angola' and a beneficiary bank country of 'Singapore'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Angola' AND f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'Singapore' RETURN f ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: What is the average unitPrice of products in the order with orderID equal to '10465'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order {orderID: '10465'})-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH avg(toFloat(p.unitPrice)) AS averagePrice RETURN averagePrice

question: List the original addresses associated with the sourceID 'Panama Papers'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address)-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity) WHERE e.sourceID = 'Panama Papers' RETURN a.original_address

question: Find all movies that have a plot mentioning 'hero'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'hero' RETURN m.title, m.plot

question: Which supplier has the highest average product unit price?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avg_price ORDER BY avg_price DESC RETURN s.companyName, avg_price LIMIT 1

question: What are the first 3 adult videos with exactly one keyword?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH a, COUNT(k) AS keywordCount WHERE keywordCount = 1 RETURN a.title AS AdultVideoTitle, a.id AS AdultVideoID ORDER BY a.title LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 actors who have acted in both comedy and drama genres.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g1:Genre {name: "Comedy"}),       (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g2:Genre {name: "Drama"}) WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) + COUNT(DISTINCT m2) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount

question: Which 3 production companies have produced films with a budget over 100 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 RETURN p.name, COUNT(m) AS numberOfMovies ORDER BY numberOfMovies DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with a revenue to budget ratio greater than 5?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue / m.budget > 5 RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.budget, m.revenue / m.budget AS ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 adult films with a tagline containing 'murder'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.tagline CONTAINS 'murder' RETURN a.title, a.tagline, a.imdb_id ORDER BY a.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the first 3 streams that play 'DayZ' and their respective follower counts.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game {name: 'DayZ'}) RETURN s.name AS stream, s.followers AS followerCount ORDER BY followerCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 orders have the highest number of units ordered per product?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, p.productName AS productName, r.quantity AS quantity ORDER BY r.quantity DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the source ID for the relationship connecting an Other node to an Entity with the same name?
cypher: MATCH (o:Other)-[r:same_name_as]->(e:Entity) RETURN r.sourceID

question: Show all orders from customers in 'Portland'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.city = 'Portland' RETURN o

question: Which actors have directed a movie they acted in? Limit to 5 actors.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(a) RETURN a.name AS actorName LIMIT 5

question: How many users are VIPs in streams that have the language "en"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(user:User) RETURN count(DISTINCT user)

question: What is the location of the user with the highest betweenness value?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.location ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 tweets have the highest aggregation of favorites and retweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:RETWEETS]->(rt:Tweet) WITH t, coalesce(sum(rt.favorites), 0) AS retweet_favorites RETURN t.id AS TweetID, t.text AS Text, t.favorites + retweet_favorites AS TotalFavorites ORDER BY TotalFavorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the products that have been ordered more than 50 times?
cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[o:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.quantity > 50 RETURN DISTINCT p.productName AS productName

question: Find the filings where the originator bank is 'CIMB Bank Berhad' and the amount is greater than 1 million.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = 'CIMB Bank Berhad' AND f.amount > 1000000 RETURN f

question: Which 3 keywords are most commonly associated with movies that have a revenue over 200 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.revenue > 200000000 RETURN k.name AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 products that have been ordered with a discount of more than 5%.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[ord:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(ord.discount) > 0.05 RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, ord.discount AS Discount ORDER BY ord.discount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all the relationships a person named 'Keanu Reeves' has with movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[r]->(m:Movie) RETURN type(r) AS relationship, m.title AS movie

question: Which 3 movies have the highest popularity but the least revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.popularity DESC, m.revenue ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS Title, m.popularity AS Popularity, m.revenue AS Revenue

question: What is the average freight of orders made by the customer with customerID equal to 'ERNSH'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: 'ERNSH'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WITH avg(toFloat(o.freight)) AS averageFreight RETURN averageFreight

question: What are the names of the first 3 products that have a unit price less than 5 and are discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < 5 AND p.discontinued = true RETURN p.productName ORDER BY p.productName LIMIT 3

question: What is the average amount filed by the entity with name "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH avg(f.amount) AS averageAmount RETURN averageAmount

question: Which 3 genres have the least movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount LIMIT 3

question: What software versions are available for 'RHEL'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'RHEL'})-[:VERSION]->(v:Version) RETURN v.name AS version

question: Which movies have been rated by user with ID 1?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {id: 1})-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: What is the average rating of movies with a title that contains the word "Matrix"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS 'Matrix' WITH avg(m.votes) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: List the first 3 country codes associated with Intermediaries.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary) RETURN i.country_codes LIMIT 3

question: Which entities have a closed date of '28-NOV-2012' and what are their names?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.closed_date = '28-NOV-2012' RETURN e.name AS entity_name

question: List the first 3 directors who have directed a movie with a runtime over 180 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 RETURN d.name AS director ORDER BY director LIMIT 3

question: What is the average rating given by users to movies in the "Comedy" genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) WITH m MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m) RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

question: What are the top 5 movies with a specific keyword 'space' and have been released?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE k.name = 'space' AND m.status = 'Released' RETURN m.title, m.release_date, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all movies with a vote count between 100 and 500.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes >= 100 AND m.votes <= 500 RETURN m

question: "which acters played more than 10 times in a movie"
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, COUNT(m) AS movies_count WHERE movies_count > 10 RETURN a.name, movies_count

question: What officers are shareholders of entities incorporated on '10-JAN-2006'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[r:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date = '10-JAN-2006' AND r.link = 'shareholder of' RETURN o

question: Find the movies directed by people born before 1950.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN m.title

question: "How many users chat in both tfue and shroud channels?"
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s1:Stream {name: "tfue"}), (u)-[:CHATTER]->(s2:Stream {name: "shroud"}) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount

question: What are the top 3 movies with the most diverse set of spoken languages?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, size(m.languages) AS numLanguages ORDER BY numLanguages DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS title, m.languages AS languages, numLanguages

question: List entities that have filed more than 20 filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings WHERE num_filings > 20 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: Which 3 suppliers have the most diverse range of product categories supplied?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, collect(DISTINCT c.categoryID) AS categories RETURN s.companyName, size(categories) AS categoryCount ORDER BY categoryCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users followed by 'neo4j' have tweeted the most?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WITH user, COUNT(tweet) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC RETURN user.screen_name, tweet_count

question: Which 5 countries have the highest number of filings involving transactions below $1 million?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS|:CONCERNS|:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.amount < 1000000 WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count RETURN country, filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all suppliers who supply products in both 'Beverages' and 'Condiments' categories.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE c.categoryName IN ['Beverages', 'Condiments'] WITH s, c.categoryName AS categoryName ORDER BY s.supplierID, categoryName WITH s, collect(categoryName) AS categories WHERE 'Beverages' IN categories AND 'Condiments' IN categories RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName

question: Find all interfaces connected to the router 'DC1-R-1'.
cypher: MATCH (router:Router {name: 'DC1-R-1'})-[:ROUTES]->(interface:Interface) RETURN interface

question: Which 5 directors have directed movies in more than three different countries?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT m.countries) AS countries WHERE size(countries) > 3 RETURN d.name AS Director, size(countries) AS CountryCount ORDER BY CountryCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 movies that have multiple languages but a single country of origin.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.languages) > 1 AND size(m.countries) = 1 RETURN m.title AS title, size(m.languages) AS numLanguages ORDER BY numLanguages DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name 3 persons who have produced the most movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS producedMovies ORDER BY producedMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS producerName, producedMovies

question: Which languages are used by streams that have more than 1 million total views?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT l.name

question: List the movies with taglines that start with 'Everything'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline STARTS WITH 'Everything' RETURN m.title, m.tagline

question: What are the names of the first 3 people who have produced, directed, and written the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) MATCH (p)-[:WROTE]->(m) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Show details of customers who have placed more than 5 orders.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WITH c, COUNT(o) AS orderCount WHERE orderCount > 5 RETURN c.customerID, c.companyName, c.contactName, c.contactTitle, c.phone, c.address, c.city, c.postalCode, c.country, c.region, c.fax

question: Which streams have a total view count greater than 1 million and what games are they playing?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, g.name AS game_name

question: List the movies with a runtime longer than 3 hours that have an IMDb rating above 8.0.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 AND m.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN m.title

question: Which users are mentioned in the tweets posted by 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentioned:User) RETURN DISTINCT mentioned

question: List the first 3 movies that were rated exactly 5 stars by any user.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating = 5.0 RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 tweets by favorites posted from 'Graphs Are Everywhere'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, t.favorites AS favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the products ordered by 'VINET' customer.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: 'VINET'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName AS ProductOrdered

question: What is the average budget of movies in the "Horror" genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "Horror"}) WITH avg(m.budget) AS average_budget RETURN average_budget

question: Which applications are running on machines with a type that has more than 16 CPUs?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.cpu > 16 WITH DISTINCT m MATCH (m)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application) RETURN DISTINCT app.name

question: Find all products that have never been reordered (reorder level 0).
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 0 RETURN p

question: List the first 3 countries by the number of filings they have as a beneficiary in transactions involving multiple currencies.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country IS NOT NULL AND f.originator_bank_country IS NOT NULL AND f.beneficiary_bank_country <> f.originator_bank_country WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count RETURN country, filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Display the top 5 longest movies by runtime.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the customers who have placed orders that include products with a unit price that is a multiple of 10.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toInteger(p.unitPrice) % 10 = 0 MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o) RETURN DISTINCT c.companyName

question: What is the IP address of the interface that is connected to the data center egress router?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(er:Egress) MATCH (er)-[:ROUTES]->(iface:Interface) RETURN iface.ip

question: List the roles of actors in the 3 movies with the highest number of actors involved.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(p) AS num_actors ORDER BY num_actors DESC LIMIT 3 MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN m.title, collect(p.name) AS actors, collect(r.roles) AS roles

question: Which 3 entities have the most relationships with filings where the originator bank country is 'United Kingdom'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' WITH e, count(f) as num_filings RETURN e.name, num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which people have produced and also reviewed the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p) RETURN p.name, m.title

question: List the users who are VIPs of streams with more than 500,000 total view count and have a moderator who also moderates a stream with the language "en" and have at least one chatter.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)  WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000 MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(vip:User) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(moderator:User) MATCH (moderator)-[:MODERATOR]->(s2:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language)  WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:CHATTER]->(chatter) RETURN DISTINCT vip.name

question: Which streams have a user as both a VIP and a MODERATOR?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:VIP]-(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) RETURN s.name AS stream, u.name AS user

question: Which customers have placed orders that were shipped to the same city they are based in?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.city = o.shipCity RETURN DISTINCT c.customerID, c.companyName

question: Who are the actors in the movie titled 'Open Season'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Open Season'})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) RETURN a.name AS actor

question: Show the first 5 filings with the most entities involved as benefits from the same country.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH f, c, COUNT(e) AS entityCount ORDER BY entityCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS FilingID, c.name AS Country, entityCount

question: Which person reviewed the movie with the lowest rating?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p, m ORDER BY r.rating ASC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of all services that have a dependency on the application 'cms' and listen on port 80.
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'cms'}) MATCH (app)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(service:Service) MATCH (service)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port {port: 80}) RETURN DISTINCT service.name

question: Which users are moderators for more than one stream?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS num_moderated_streams WHERE num_moderated_streams > 1 RETURN u.name AS user, num_moderated_streams

question: Show the top 5 countries by the number of filings they are involved in as both originator and beneficiary.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR|BENEFITS]->(f:Filing) WITH c, count(f) AS filingsCount RETURN c.name AS Country, filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the entities with an `officer_of` relationship to the officer with `icij_id` 'C0FCC85C73FE8405CBF5FD732A6787E5'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {icij_id: 'C0FCC85C73FE8405CBF5FD732A6787E5'}) MATCH (o)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name

question: What are the top 5 movies sorted by revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all the movies that have been both directed and acted in by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS person

question: Find the filings where the originator entity's name contains "AG" and the beneficiary entity's country is 'AFG'.
cypher: MATCH (filing:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity),       (filing:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(country:Country) WHERE originator.name CONTAINS 'AG' AND country.code = 'AFG' RETURN filing

question: Who are the top 5 youngest producers?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most user ratings?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE EXISTS { (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m) } RETURN m.title, count{(u)-[:RATED]->(m)} AS ratingsCount ORDER BY ratingsCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who acted in 'The Matrix'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: 'The Matrix'}) RETURN p.name AS actor

question: What are the first 3 movies reviewed by a person born in 1967?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {born: 1967})-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: What are the IP addresses of interfaces connected to the network '10.3'?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network {ip: '10.3'})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN i.ip AS InterfaceIP

question: What are the top 5 oldest movies in the database by release year?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.year ORDER BY m.year LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 movies with the most IMDb votes released before 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year < 2000 RETURN m.title, m.imdbVotes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the `orderID` and `shipName` of orders that include products from at least 3 different categories.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, collect(DISTINCT p.categoryID) AS categories WHERE size(categories) >= 3 RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName

question: Which entities have a last edit timestamp earlier than '1638311040000'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.lastEditTimestamp < '1638311040000' RETURN e

question: What are the IP addresses of Interfaces routed by Network '10.1'?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network {ip: '10.1'})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN i.ip AS InterfaceIP

question: List all users who have both posted a tweet mentioning 'Neo4j' and have been mentioned by 'Neo4j' in a tweet.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User {name: 'Neo4j'}) WHERE EXISTS {     (m)-[:POSTS]->(:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u) } RETURN u

question: Which 3 users are moderators for the most number of streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS streamsModerated ORDER BY streamsModerated DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name, streamsModerated

question: Which countries have produced movies with a revenue exceeding 200 million?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 200000000 RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS country

question: What are the titles of the top 5 highest-rated movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS average_rating ORDER BY average_rating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title

question: What is the average rating of movies with the word "journey" in the review summary?
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE toLower(r.summary) CONTAINS 'journey' RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

question: Identify the top 5 filings where the beneficiary bank is 'United Overseas Bank Ltd' and the amount specified.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = 'United Overseas Bank Ltd' RETURN f.sar_id AS SAR_ID, f.amount AS Amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average total view count of streams that have "en" as a language and are moderated by users who are VIPs of other streams and are part of a team?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User)-[vip:VIP]->(:Stream) MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) WITH DISTINCT s WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_view_count RETURN average_view_count

question: What is the average `unitPrice` of products supplied by the supplier with `supplierID` '2'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier { supplierID: '2' })-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN avg(p.unitPrice)

question: Which orders were placed by customers from 'Berlin'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {city: 'Berlin'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN o

question: Which 3 countries have entities that have filed the most filings with beneficiary banks in 'Singapore'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'Singapore' WITH c, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS Country, filingsCount

question: Which 3 entities have the most filings as beneficiaries and are located in 'India'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'India'}) MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: What is the IP address of the interface that exposes port 80?
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface)-[:EXPOSES]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN i.ip

question: List the 3 teams with the most associated streams.
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) RETURN t.name AS team, count(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the `name`s of the entities that are both `ORIGINATOR` and `BENEFICIARY` in at least one filing?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f MATCH (e:Entity)<-[:ORIGINATOR]-(f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e) RETURN DISTINCT e.name

question: Who are the first 3 users who have VIP status in streams playing 'Rust'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game {name: 'Rust'}) RETURN u.name AS user, s.name AS stream ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: Name the top 5 videos with the most associated genres.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH v, count(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN v.title AS VideoTitle, genreCount

question: Identify 5 users who follow more than 5000 users but have fewer than 10000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.following > 5000 AND u.followers < 10000 RETURN u LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 countries by the number of genres produced there?
