cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) WITH s, count(p) AS numProducts ORDER BY numProducts DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.companyName, numProducts

question: What is the name of the youngest director in the database?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) RETURN d.name, d.born ORDER BY d.born DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average number of votes for movies directed by people born before 1950?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN AVG(m.votes) AS average_votes

question: List the first 3 movies that have a link to their homepage that includes 'disney'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage CONTAINS 'disney' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 actors have the most roles in comedy movies?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "Comedy"}) RETURN a.name AS actor, COUNT(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 Officers with the sourceID "Panama Papers".
cypher: MATCH (n:Officer {sourceID: "Panama Papers"}) RETURN n.name LIMIT 3

question: Which intermediaries have a 'status' of 'SUSPENDED' and are 'intermediary_of' entities with an 'incorporation_date' before '01-JAN-2000'?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {status: 'SUSPENDED'}) -[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date < '01-JAN-2000' RETURN i.name

question: Identify the top 5 tweets linking to the most popular external sources.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) WITH t, l, COUNT(l) AS link_count ORDER BY link_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, l.url AS link_url, link_count

question: List the top 3 actors who have the highest average IMDb rating across their movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL WITH a, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating RETURN a.name AS actorName, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which user has moderated the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS moderated_streams RETURN u.name AS user_name, moderated_streams ORDER BY moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first 5 directors who have a biography listed in their profile.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.bio IS NOT NULL RETURN d.name, d.bio LIMIT 5

question: "Show me all the officers"
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer) RETURN o

question: Find streams that are moderated by users who are also chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s) RETURN s, u

question: What are the first 3 movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 RETURN m ORDER BY m.runtime ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 suppliers have the most diverse range of product categories supplied?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS numCategories ORDER BY numCategories DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName, numCategories

question: Which 3 streams have the most complex descriptions based on word count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WITH s, size(split(s.description, " ")) AS wordCount ORDER BY wordCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.name AS streamName, s.description AS description, wordCount

question: What are the first 5 movies in the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'})<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 5

question: What are the names of the entities that filed filings where the beneficiary bank is located in the United Kingdom and the amount is greater than 1000000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = "United Kingdom" AND f.amount > 1000000 MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f) RETURN DISTINCT e.name

question: Which Machines in DataCenter 'DC1' are running an Application named 'webserver'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application {name: 'webserver'}) RETURN machine.name

question: List the first 3 products that are supplied exclusively by 'Mayumi's'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: "Mayumi's"})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE NOT exists {     MATCH (s2:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p)     WHERE s2 <> s } RETURN p.productName, p.productID LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of 'favorites' for tweets that mention users with a high 'following' count and a high 'statuses' count?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 AND u.statuses > 500 WITH avg(t.favorites) AS average_favorites RETURN average_favorites

question: List the orders that include products from categories with a total quantity of units in stock greater than 100.
cypher: MATCH (cat:Category)<-[:PART_OF]-(prod:Product) WITH cat, sum(prod.unitsInStock) AS totalUnitsInStock WHERE totalUnitsInStock > 100 MATCH (cat)<-[:PART_OF]-(prod:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(order:Order) RETURN DISTINCT order.orderID

question: What is the name of the director who directed the movie with the highest budget?
cypher: MATCH (movie:Movie) WITH max(movie.budget) AS max_budget, movie MATCH (director:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie) WHERE  movie.budget = max_budget RETURN director.name

question: Find all directors who were born after 1970.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born > date('1970-01-01') RETURN d.name, d.born

question: List all genres that have been accessed by the 'Ultimate' package.
cypher: MATCH (p:Package {name: 'Ultimate'})-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre

question: List the names of people who have both written and directed a movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) WITH p MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name

question: List the first 5 videos that have a runtime under 60 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.runtime < 60 RETURN v LIMIT 5

question: List the games played by streams that have a description containing 'game play'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'game play' RETURN g.name AS GameName

question: What are the locations of the top 3 users who interact with 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(other:User) RETURN other.location AS Location ORDER BY other.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 3 games played by streams with a description containing 'hilarious moments'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'hilarious moments' RETURN g.name AS game, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the IP addresses of all networks in zone 3?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network {zone: 3}) RETURN n.ip AS NetworkIP

question: List all the streams that have a 'CHATTER' relationship with a user who is also a 'VIP' to another stream.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User)-[:VIP]->(s2:Stream) RETURN DISTINCT s

question: What are the top 5 most popular videos?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) RETURN v.title, v.popularity ORDER BY v.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all entities with a note about their status.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.note IS NOT NULL RETURN e.name, e.note

question: List the 3 streams with the most distinct users as VIPs.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, count(DISTINCT u) AS uniqueVips ORDER BY uniqueVips DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.id AS StreamID, s.name AS StreamName, uniqueVips

question: Find the streams that have a moderator who also moderates a stream with the game "Rust" and has more than 5,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s1:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game {name: "Rust"}) MATCH (s1)<-[:MODERATOR]-(m) MATCH (m)-[:MODERATOR]->(s2:Stream) WHERE s2.followers > 5000 RETURN DISTINCT s2.name

question: List the 3 games most commonly played by streams with an English language setup.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = 'en' RETURN g.name AS game, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: "which actor has the highest rating movies"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(r:Person) RETURN p.name AS Actor, AVG(r.rating) AS AvgRating ORDER BY AvgRating DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the top 5 filings with the largest amount transferred in 2011.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin.year = 2011 RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 users who are moderators for the most streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS moderated_streams ORDER BY moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.name, moderated_streams

question: "show me Movies directed by the Same Person and written by the same actor?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS DirectorAndWriter, a.name AS Actor

question: Name the first 3 streams that have had the same game since creation and more than 5 million total views.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.createdAt = s.createdAt AND s.total_view_count > 5000000 RETURN s.name AS StreamName, g.name AS GameName LIMIT 3

question: List all persons who have directed a movie and also follow someone.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WHERE exists{ (p)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:Person) } RETURN p.name

question: List the top 5 streams that have a 'createdAt' date after 2019.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.createdAt > datetime('2019-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s.name, s.createdAt ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the total number of streams that have at least one moderator and one VIP who are different users and belong to a team created before 2017 and have more than 50,000 followers and play the game "Rust"?
cypher: MATCH (stream:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(game:Game {name: "Rust"}) WHERE stream.followers > 50000 WITH stream MATCH (stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(moderator:User) WITH DISTINCT stream, moderator MATCH (stream)-[:VIP]->(vip:User) WHERE moderator <> vip WITH DISTINCT stream, moderator, vip MATCH (stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(team:Team) WHERE team.createdAt < datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00.000000000Z') WITH DISTINCT stream RETURN count(stream) AS totalStreams

question: Which 3 users have the highest average movie rating?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, AVG(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u AS User, avgRating AS AverageRating

question: List the top 5 most frequently ordered products by 'VINET'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: "VINET"})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, count(o) AS ordersCount ORDER BY ordersCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the people who have not acted in any movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name

question: What are the titles of the top 5 movies released in 1999?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 1999 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 suppliers are located in the UK?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {country: "UK"}) RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 products have the lowest 'unitPrice' in the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice ASC LIMIT 3

question: How many streams have the language 'de' and more than 10,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'de'}) WHERE s.followers > 10000 RETURN count(s)

question: List the titles of movies directed by someone born before 1960.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1960 RETURN m.title

question: List the actors who have acted in movies with a rating above 90.
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 WITH m MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: What are the last known addresses of entities with a status 'Defaulted' in 2013?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE e.status = 'Defaulted' AND (e.inactivation_date CONTAINS '2013' OR e.struck_off_date CONTAINS '2013') RETURN e.name AS entity_name, a.address AS last_known_address

question: What is the name of the country with country code 'AFG'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {code: 'AFG'}) RETURN c.name

question: What are the names of the first 3 languages spoken in streams with a total view count over 10000000?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count > 10000000 RETURN l.name LIMIT 3

question: How many machines are there in rack 'DC1-RCK-4-9' and what types are they?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-4-9'})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(type:Type) RETURN COUNT(machine) AS machine_count, COLLECT(DISTINCT type.type) AS machine_types

question: What are the products with a 'unitPrice' less than 10 and are discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < 10 AND p.discontinued = true RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice, p.discontinued

question: Find the orders that include products from the category with the lowest average unit price.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, avg(p.unitPrice) AS averagePrice ORDER BY averagePrice ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (c)<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN o.orderID, collect(p.productName) AS products

question: List the `name`s of all countries that have entities which are both `ORIGINATOR` and `BENEFICIARY` in at least one filing.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)<-[:BENEFITS]-(f) MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN DISTINCT c.name

question: What are the top five movies where the person who directed the movie was born in the 1940s?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1940 AND p.born < 1950 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 users have rated the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, count(r) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, numRatings

question: Name the first 3 movies with a tagline that includes the word 'real' and were released before 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'real' AND m.released < 2000 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

question: Give me the 3 movies with the lowest ratings.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WITH m.title AS movieTitle, collect(r.rating) AS ratings UNWIND ratings AS rating WITH movieTitle, avg(rating) AS averageRating ORDER BY averageRating ASC RETURN movieTitle, averageRating LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have been reviewed with a rating of 100?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating = 100 RETURN m.title

question: Find all customers who have ordered products from more than one category.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WITH c, collect(DISTINCT cat.categoryName) AS categories WHERE size(categories) > 1 RETURN c.companyName

question: List the top 3 genres most frequently associated with videos.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(v) AS VideoCount ORDER BY VideoCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies were released after the year 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, m.release_date

question: Who are the first 3 people to have produced a movie with more than 500 votes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 500 RETURN p.name, m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: What is the average age of directors at the time of their death?
cypher: MATCH (director:Director) WHERE director.died IS NOT NULL WITH avg(director.died.year - director.born.year) AS averageAge RETURN averageAge

question: What are the top 5 production companies by the number of comedy films produced?
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "Comedy"}) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS comedyFilmCount ORDER BY comedyFilmCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.name AS productionCompany, comedyFilmCount

question: What are the top 3 filings in terms of amount that occurred in 2016?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2016-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2016-12-31T23:59:59Z') RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average budget of movies directed by Steven Spielberg?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person {name: "Steven Spielberg"})-[:CREW_FOR {job: "Director"}]->(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.budget) AS average_budget RETURN average_budget

question: What are the top 5 hashtags in tweets retweeted by 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(rt:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name, count(h) AS hashtag_count ORDER BY hashtag_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 games are the most played by streams with over 1 million followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 WITH g, count(*) as playCount RETURN g.name as game, playCount ORDER BY playCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies by revenue released in 1995?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released STARTS WITH '1995' AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 production companies have produced the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) RETURN c.name AS company, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the most common country codes associated with the entities?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.country_codes AS country_code, COUNT(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show the names of Entities that have originator banks in 'Singapore'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' RETURN e.name

question: Find the movie with the highest rating that has the word "football" in its review summary.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'football' WITH m, r ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN m AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.languages IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.languages, size(m.languages) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have ordered the product with productID '1'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product {productID: '1'}) RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, c.contactName AS contactName, c.customerID AS customerID

question: Find the first three movies reviewed with a rating above 90.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title, r.rating, r.summary LIMIT 3

question: What is the `valid_until` date for the entity with `ibcRUC` '25249'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {ibcRUC: '25249'}) RETURN e.valid_until

question: List all movies directed by someone who has also acted in a movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists{ (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN m.title

question: Find the top 3 languages used by streams with more than 1000000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 RETURN l.name, count(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the movies that have been directed by directors who have also acted in them.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie), (d)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS movieTitle

question: List the movies directed by people born before 1970.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1970 RETURN m.title AS movie

question: List the top 5 movies with the smallest budgets.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.budget ASC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 genres that have the most movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with the shortest runtime?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.runtime ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies that have been directed by someone born in 1967.
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE director.born = 1967 RETURN movie.title AS title, movie.released AS released ORDER BY movie.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average rating for the movie "Toy Story"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WITH avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: List the intermediaries that are connected to entities with a status of 'Defaulted'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:intermediary_of]-(i:Intermediary) WHERE e.status = 'Defaulted' RETURN DISTINCT i.name AS IntermediaryName

question: What are the first 3 movies with a majority of non-English languages?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size([l IN m.languages WHERE l <> 'English']) > size(m.languages) / 2 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of streams that have at least one moderator and one VIP who are different users?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(moderator:User),       (s)-[:VIP]->(vip:User) WHERE moderator <> vip RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS streamCount

question: What are the top 5 most ordered products by customers from 'Berlin'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {city: 'Berlin'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, SUM(r.quantity) AS TotalQuantityOrdered ORDER BY TotalQuantityOrdered DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of followers for streams that belong to a team?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) RETURN avg(s.followers) AS averageFollowers

question: Which 5 movies have been rated by the highest number of users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS numUsers ORDER BY numUsers DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, numUsers AS NumberOfUsers

question: What are the names of the top 5 users interacting most frequently with others?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:INTERACTS_WITH]->(:User) WITH u, COUNT(r) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.name AS user_name, interactions

question: List officers with the same ID based on 'Paradise Papers - Malta corporate registry'.
cypher: MATCH (o1:Officer)-[:same_id_as {sourceID: 'Paradise Papers - Malta corporate registry'}]->(o2:Officer) RETURN o1.name AS Officer1, o2.name AS Officer2

question: How many entities were inactivated in February 2013?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.inactivation_date STARTS WITH '18-FEB-2013' RETURN count(e) AS InactivatedEntitiesCount

question: Which 3 genres have the least number of movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount

question: What are the top 3 filings with the highest number of entities involved as originators from the same sector?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH f, COUNT(e) AS originator_count ORDER BY originator_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, originator_count

question: Which officers have been linked to the entity 'NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD.'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity {name: 'NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD.'}) RETURN o.name AS OfficerName

question: Which 3 countries have produced the most movies in the genre 'Drama'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Drama'}) MATCH (m)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name, movies_count

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders placed in the first quarter of 1997?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.orderDate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.orderDate <= '1997-03-31' WITH o, toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * toInteger(rel.quantity) * (1 - toFloat(rel.discount)) AS revenuePerProduct WITH o, sum(revenuePerProduct) AS orderRevenue RETURN sum(orderRevenue) AS totalRevenue

question: What are the names of suppliers based in the UK?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {country: 'UK'}) RETURN s.companyName AS SupplierName

question: Identify the top 3 entities based on the total amount of filings where the beneficiary bank's country is 'United Kingdom'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' WITH e, SUM(f.amount) AS totalAmount RETURN e.name AS entityName, totalAmount ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the most common genre among the top 10 highest-grossing movies?

question: What are the top 5 movies that have a genre of 'Sci-Fi'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest vote count that was released after 2010?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date > date('2010-01-01') RETURN m.title AS movie_title, m.vote_count AS vote_count ORDER BY vote_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Give me the top 10 movies with the most votes and a rating higher than 85.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating > 85 WITH m, count(m) AS numVotes ORDER BY numVotes DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN m.title, numVotes

question: Find all machines running an OS that started after timestamp 1606000000000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(os:OS) WHERE os.startTime > 1606000000000 RETURN m.name

question: Display the first 3 users with the highest following who follow 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(me:Me {name: 'Neo4j'}) RETURN u ORDER BY u.following DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the highest revenue and were released in the 'United Kingdom'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'United Kingdom'}) RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have acted in movies directed by the person who directed the movie with the lowest number of votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Person) MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) MATCH (movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actorName

question: List the first 3 movies that have been produced by 'Pixar Animation Studios' and have a budget over 50 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'}) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 links contained in the tweets posted by users with fewer than 100 followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) WHERE u.followers < 100 RETURN l.url, COUNT(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the name of the production company that produced Toy Story?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) RETURN pc.name

question: Which 3 actors have acted in movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 RETURN a.name AS actor, m.title AS movie LIMIT 3

question: What is the average budget of movies in the "Comedy" genre?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Comedy'})<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.budget) AS averageBudget RETURN averageBudget

question: List the top 5 tweets by 'Neo4j' based on favorites.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which people have directed more than one movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS directedMovies WHERE directedMovies > 1 RETURN p.name AS Director, directedMovies

question: "영화 매트릭스에 출연한 배우는 누구야?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.title = "매트릭스" RETURN p.name

question: List all types of machines that have a CPU count of at least 8.
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.cpu >= 8 RETURN t.name AS machineType, t.cpu AS cpuCount

question: Which products have been ordered more than 100 times?
cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[o:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.quantity > 100 RETURN p.productName AS productName, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalQuantity ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC

question: Which 3 filings have the largest difference in latitude between originator and beneficiary locations?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.origin_lat IS NOT NULL AND f.beneficiary_lat IS NOT NULL RETURN f, abs(toFloat(f.origin_lat) - toFloat(f.beneficiary_lat)) AS lat_difference ORDER BY lat_difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the 3 streams with the most users as chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount

question: What are the first 3 production companies that produced videos with zero revenue?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany) WHERE v.revenue = 0 RETURN DISTINCT c.name LIMIT 3

question: Display the top 5 users who follow both 'Neo4j' and 'Me'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WHERE (u)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:Me) RETURN u.screen_name, u.name ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have a homepage and were released after 2010.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage IS NOT NULL AND m.release_date > date('2010-01-01') RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies with the most imdbVotes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbVotes IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 filings by amount in 2015?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2015-12-31T23:59:59Z') RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which process listens on the highest port number in the schema?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN p.name AS ProcessName, port.port AS PortNumber ORDER BY port.port DESC LIMIT 1

question: Name 3 people who were born after 1980 and have directed a movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1980 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies with the lowest revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue LIMIT 5

question: How many different versions of the software 'RHEL' are used by processes running in the data center?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) MATCH (p)-[:INSTANCE]->(:Software {name: 'RHEL'}) WITH DISTINCT p, p.name AS version RETURN count(version)

question: Which three users have rated the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, count(r) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, numRatings

question: Which director has the highest average movie IMDB votes?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, avg(m.imdbVotes) AS averageVotes RETURN d.name AS directorName, averageVotes ORDER BY averageVotes DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which movies have actors who were born in the USA and have acted in a comedy genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) MATCH (a:Actor {bornIn: 'USA'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN m.title AS movie, collect(a.name) AS actors

question: List the names of all machines that are holding a switch with an IP address starting with "10.2".
cypher: MATCH (s:Switch) WHERE s.ip STARTS WITH "10.2" MATCH (s)<-[:HOLDS]-(r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) RETURN m.name

question: List the products with a unitsInStock less than 15.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock < 15 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock

question: What are the top 3 sources used in tweets by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:USING]->(source:Source) RETURN source.name AS source, count(*) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which service provider has the most entities with a 'Defaulted' status?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {status: 'Defaulted'}) WITH e.service_provider AS service_provider, count(e) AS entity_count ORDER BY entity_count DESC RETURN service_provider, entity_count LIMIT 1

question: Which movies have the tagline 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {tagline: 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!'}) RETURN m

question: What is the average number of entities per address?
cypher: MATCH ()-[r:registered_address]->(a:Address) WITH count(*) AS num_addresses, count(DISTINCT startNode(r).node_id) AS num_entities RETURN round(toFloat(num_entities) / num_addresses, 2) AS avg_entities_per_address

question: Which 3 products have never been ordered?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE NOT exists{ (p)<-[:ORDERS]-(:Order) } RETURN p.productName LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have 'Tom Hanks' as a cast member?

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most roles for actors born after 1970?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[ai:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE p.born > 1970 WITH m, count(ai) AS roleCount RETURN m.title AS movie, roleCount ORDER BY roleCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 people who have acted the most in released movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' WITH p, count(r) AS num_roles ORDER BY num_roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS person, num_roles

question: List the 3 oldest directors based on their birth date.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) RETURN d.name, d.born ORDER BY d.born ASC LIMIT 3

question: Who produced 'Speed Racer' and what year was it released?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name AS producer, m.released AS year

question: Find the first 3 orders that required shipping after '1997-01-01'.

question: What are the first 3 movies released after 2010?

question: Which movies have been both produced and directed by the same person?

question: What are the names of all genres represented in the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'})<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS genre_name

question: Find the top 5 streams with the highest total view count.

question: List the first 3 entities that have filed the most number of filings with a beneficiary bank in 'Barclays Bank Plc'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing {beneficiary_bank: 'Barclays Bank Plc'}) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e

cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.revenue AS Revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the incorporation_date of the entity with the internal_id '1000022'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: '1000022'}) RETURN e.incorporation_date

question: Which movies feature the keyword 'jealousy'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'jealousy'}) RETURN m

question: What are the top 3 genres with the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: "Which actors played in the most movies?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, COUNT(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which movies are associated with the keyword 'space'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'space'}) RETURN m.title

question: Who are the top 3 persons with the most roles in movies they have acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, size(r.roles) AS numRoles RETURN p.name, sum(numRoles) AS totalRoles ORDER BY totalRoles DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 filings with the shortest duration from beginning to end.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS SAR_ID, f.begin AS Begin_Date, f.end AS End_Date, duration

question: Show the streams with the most languages.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH s, COUNT(l) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC RETURN s.name AS streamName, languageCount LIMIT 10

question: Identify the top 3 processes by PID that depend on the 'java' service.
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(s:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN p.name AS processName, p.pid AS processPID ORDER BY p.pid DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 genres have the least movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS Genre, movieCount

question: Find the actors who have worked on movies with more than 4 actors.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) WITH m, count(a) AS actorCount WHERE actorCount > 4 WITH m MATCH (m)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Person) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: What are the top 3 countries by the average amount of filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS|:CONCERNS|:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, f.amount AS amount RETURN country, AVG(amount) AS average_amount ORDER BY average_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which machine type has the highest RAM capacity?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) RETURN t.type ORDER BY t.ram DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the tweets where 'neo4j' is mentioned and the tweet has a favorite count over 100.

question: List all movies directed by a person born in France.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.bornIn = "France" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.year AS ReleaseYear, p.name AS DirectorName

question: What is the average number of followers for streams that play "Just Chatting"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: "Just Chatting"}) RETURN avg(s.followers)

question: Which 5 actors have acted in movies released in the most distinct years?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, collect(DISTINCT m.year) AS years RETURN a.name, size(years) AS distinct_years ORDER BY distinct_years DESC LIMIT 5

question: Name the first 3 Machines held in Rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'.
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine) RETURN machine.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies produced by Joel Silver and their respective release years?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 filings where the beneficiary bank country is 'Spain' and the amount is over 5 million USD.

question: Find the tweets that are replies to tweets that mention users followed by Neo4j.

question: What are the details of entities that have an incorporation date in 2006?

question: Which movie has the lowest number of votes and what is its tagline?

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.name, s.followers ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, m.released - p.born AS years_since_birth WITH p, min(years_since_birth) AS years_to_first_role RETURN avg(years_to_first_role) AS average_years_to_first_role

question: What is the total number of entities in the dataset?

question: Who are the first 3 directors with movies in at least three different genres?

cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.country = 'UK' WITH o, c MATCH (o)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, c.companyName AS customerName, SUM(toFloat(o.freight)) AS totalFreight ORDER BY totalFreight DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 actors have the highest total imdbVotes for all movies they acted in?

question: What are the names of the top 5 originator banks in filings that ended in the year 2014?

question: Show the first 3 tweets mentioning 'Neo4j' that have been retweeted by 'Me'.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(retweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(original:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(user:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN original.text, original.created_at ORDER BY original.created_at LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 genres with the highest average movie budget.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, avg(m.budget) AS average_budget ORDER BY average_budget DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre_name, average_budget

question: List the top 5 routers located in zone 2.
cypher: MATCH (r:Router) WHERE r.zone = 2 RETURN r.name LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 suppliers with the most products listed?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, COUNT(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName, productCount

cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE e.countries = "Hong Kong" RETURN a.address LIMIT 5

question: Which intermediaries have the same name as entities?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:same_name_as]->(e:Entity) RETURN i, e

cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) WHERE port.port > 1024 RETURN app.name

cypher: MATCH (t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt < datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z') WITH t MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_view_count RETURN average_view_count

question: List the first 3 suppliers of products in the 'Confections' category.

cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name AS hashtag, COUNT(*) AS usage_count ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source) WITH t, s ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS source

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 0 AND m.revenue > 0 WITH m, (toFloat(m.budget) / toFloat(m.revenue)) AS budget_to_revenue_ratio RETURN m.title AS movie_title, budget_to_revenue_ratio ORDER BY budget_to_revenue_ratio DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the `categoryName` of the category with the highest total revenue generated?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[oi:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, sum(toFloat(oi.quantity) * toFloat(oi.unitPrice)) AS totalRevenue ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC RETURN c.categoryName AS categoryName, totalRevenue LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 streams have the most chatter relationships?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s, count{(s)-[:CHATTER]->()} AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.name, s.createdAt ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "Action"}),        (p2:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m)  WHERE p1 <> p2 WITH p1, p2, COUNT(m) AS sharedMovies ORDER BY sharedMovies DESC RETURN p1.name, p2.name, sharedMovies LIMIT 1

question: Which users are VIPs in more than one stream?

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH l, sum(m.revenue) AS total_revenue ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN l.name AS language, total_revenue

question: List the names of the languages used by streams that are VIPed by users with more than 100000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers > 100000 MATCH (u)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN DISTINCT l.name

question: Which movies have been reviewed as "You had me at Jerry"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary = "You had me at Jerry" RETURN m.title

question: List the first 5 actors who have a poster URL listed on their profile.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE a.poster IS NOT NULL RETURN a LIMIT 5

question: Which movies have both high revenue (over 500 million USD) and high imdbRating (above 8.0)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 AND m.imdbRating > 8.0 RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.imdbRating

question: What is the name of the officer associated with the entity with internal_id '1000024'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: '1000024'}) MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e) RETURN o.name

question: What is the name of the Machine that has the most Interfaces connected to it?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) WITH m, count(i) AS interfaceCount ORDER BY interfaceCount DESC RETURN m.name LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 most expensive products supplied by 'Exotic Liquids'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: "Exotic Liquids"})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 5 actors who have starred in both a movie and an adult film?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:CAST_FOR]->(a:Adult) RETURN p.name AS actor_name LIMIT 5

question: What is the average runtime of movies released during the silent film era?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year <= 1927 RETURN avg(m.runtime)

question: List the top 5 countries based on the total number of entities that have filed something.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filings ORDER BY filings DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(e) AS NumberOfEntities ORDER BY NumberOfEntities DESC

question: List the first 3 movies that have a homepage listed.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.homepage LIMIT 3

question: Which three movies have the highest IMDb rating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 filings by number that had a beneficiary bank in 'United Kingdom'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN f ORDER BY f.number DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the maximum amount filed by the entity with name "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp." between 2016-01-01T00:00:00Z and 2016-12-31T00:00:00Z?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime("2016-01-01T00:00:00Z") AND f.begin <= datetime("2016-12-31T00:00:00Z") RETURN max(f.amount)

question: List the first 3 tweets created by users located in 'Graphs Are Everywhere' and posted after December 2020.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_at > datetime('2020-12-31T23:59:59Z') RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 countries where entities have filed the most filings that began in 2017.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.begin < datetime('2018-01-01T00:00:00Z') MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the genres associated with the movie 'Toy Story'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS GenreName

question: Display the country codes for the top 3 countries where the originator entities of filings are located.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.code AS country_code, COUNT(f) AS filing_count ORDER BY filing_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN country_code

question: Find the orders that include products from categories with an average unit price greater than 20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avg_price WHERE avg_price > 20 MATCH (c)<-[:PART_OF]-(p2:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN DISTINCT o.orderID

question: What is the average rating given by people born before 1950?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born < 1950 MATCH (p)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: What are the top 5 actors by number of movies acted in with a revenue greater than 500 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 WITH a, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name, movies_count

question: Which movies have been rated the highest by users who have rated over 100 movies?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, COUNT(r) AS numRatings WHERE numRatings > 100 MATCH (u)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, AVG(r.rating) AS AverageRating ORDER BY AverageRating DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the top 5 movies where the director and the main actor were born in the same decade.
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) WHERE actor.born / 10 = director.born / 10 WITH movie, actor, director ORDER BY movie.votes DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN movie.title AS movie, actor.name AS actor, director.name AS director

question: Which 3 orders have the highest number of distinct products ordered?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, count(DISTINCT p) AS numProducts ORDER BY numProducts DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN o.orderID AS OrderID, numProducts

question: Which movies are associated with the keyword 'space'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'space'}) RETURN m

question: Which 3 entities have filed the most filings that benefit entities in Germany?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "Germany"}) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS EntityName, filingsCount

question: What is the average discount applied to products in orders with a `freight` cost higher than 100?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(o.freight) > 100 WITH avg(toFloat(rel.discount)) AS averageDiscount RETURN averageDiscount

question: List 5 movies that have a poster path containing '/rh'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path CONTAINS '/rh' RETURN m.title, m.poster_path LIMIT 5

question: List all movies with more than 1000 votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 1000 RETURN m.title, m.votes

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(:User) WITH m, count(r) AS num_ratings WHERE num_ratings >= 50 RETURN m.title ORDER BY num_ratings DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 suppliers based in 'London'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {city: 'London'}) RETURN s.companyName, s.contactName ORDER BY s.companyName LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(neo:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) WHERE u.followers > 5000 RETURN u.screen_name

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH l, SUM(m.revenue) AS total_revenue ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN l.name AS language, total_revenue

question: Show the first 3 actors who have acted in movies with a budget under 10 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 10000000 RETURN a.name AS actorName, m.title AS movieTitle, m.budget AS movieBudget LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e, filingsCount

question: Which streams have a total view count below 10,000 and are linked to a language named 'en'?

question: List the names of the teams that have streams moderated by users with a total view count greater than 5 million.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.total_view_count > 5000000 MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN DISTINCT t.name

question: Which actor has the biggest difference between their highest and lowest rated movie?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WITH a, max(r.rating) AS maxRating, min(r.rating) AS minRating WITH a, maxRating - minRating AS difference RETURN a.name, difference ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find all streams that have a VIP who also chats in a stream with the word "Creative" in its description.

question: What is the jurisdiction of the entity with the most officers?

question: Which 3 directors have directed both animated and non-animated movies?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists{(m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Animation'})} WITH d, count(DISTINCT m) AS animatedCount WHERE animatedCount > 0 MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie) WHERE NOT exists{(m2)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Animation'})} WITH d, count(DISTINCT m2) AS nonAnimatedCount WHERE nonAnimatedCount > 0 RETURN d.name LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 5 youngest producers in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS producer, p.born AS birthYear ORDER BY birthYear DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of Ports per Process?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) WITH p, count(port) AS num_ports WITH avg(num_ports) AS average_ports RETURN average_ports

question: Find the actors who have played the same role in different movies.

question: Which 3 actors have the highest average imdbRating for movies they acted in?

question: Find all movies that have a revenue greater than the combined revenue of the bottom 10 movies.

question: Which actor has the highest average gross revenue per movie?

question: Find the top 5 officers by the number of similar relationships with other officers.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[r:similar]->(other:Officer) WITH o, count(r) AS numSimilar ORDER BY numSimilar DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN o.name, numSimilar

question: Which users have the most interactions with "Neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) MATCH (user:User)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]-(neo4j) WITH user, count(*) AS interactionCount RETURN user.screen_name, interactionCount ORDER BY interactionCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find all tweets from users who follow 'neo4j' and list the top 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 tweets with the most favorites posted by "Neo4j".
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WITH t  ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN t.id_str

question: Which 3 movies have the lowest revenue despite having a high IMDb rating (over 7.0)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 7.0 AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue ASC LIMIT 3

question: What is the highest rating given to any movie by any person?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN max(r.rating) AS highest_rating

question: List the first 3 movies with a review summary of 'Fun, but a little far fetched'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED {summary: 'Fun, but a little far fetched'}]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title, m.released, m.tagline LIMIT 3

question: Which people have reviewed a movie with the word "solid" in the summary?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'solid' RETURN p.name

question: What are the first 3 movies produced by people born in the 1950s?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1950 AND p.born < 1960 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List top 3 intermediaries that have been linked as officers of entities.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN i.name AS intermediary_name, COUNT(e) AS entity_count ORDER BY entity_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 filings with entities that are both originator and beneficiary.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity), (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e) RETURN f, e LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies of all time?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 genres that have movies with a runtime greater than 120 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN g.name AS genre ORDER BY genre LIMIT 3

question: Can you list streams that have a follower count between 1000 and 5000?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers >= 1000 AND s.followers <= 5000 RETURN s

question: Find 3 movies that were both directed and reviewed by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS Movie, p.name AS Director_Reviewer LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 persons have the most distinct roles in the ACTED_IN relationship?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, size(collect(distinct r.roles)) AS num_roles ORDER BY num_roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS person, num_roles

question: List the streams that have the same game played by both itsbigchase and 9linda.
cypher: MATCH (u1:User {name: 'itsbigchase'})-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)<-[:PLAYS]-(u2:User {name: '9linda'}) MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g) RETURN s

question: List three products that are in the 'Dairy Products' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'}) RETURN p.productName LIMIT 3

question: List the intermediary names that have the same address as 'MICHAEL PAPAGEORGE, MR.'
cypher: MATCH (i1:Intermediary {name: 'MICHAEL PAPAGEORGE, MR.'})-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) MATCH (i2:Intermediary)-[:registered_address]->(a) RETURN DISTINCT i2.name AS IntermediaryName

question: List the top 3 most controversial adult films based on their overview.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.overview IS NOT NULL RETURN a.title, a.overview ORDER BY a.vote_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies that have been produced by 'Pixar Animation Studios' and have a budget over 50 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'}) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 directors have directed the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d2:Director) WHERE d1 <> d2 WITH m, collect(d1.name) AS directors WHERE size(directors) >= 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, directors LIMIT 5

question: List the usernames of users who are moderators of streams with over 1,000,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: "Which actor pairs were the most popular with directors?"
cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Person), (p2:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN p1.name, p2.name, count(DISTINCT d) AS directorCount ORDER BY directorCount DESC

question: List the first 3 users who follow 'neo4j' and have been mentioned in tweets by 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(follower:User) WHERE exists {     MATCH (neo4j)-[:POSTS]->(:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(follower) } RETURN follower LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies that have been rated exactly 5 times?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS ratingCount WHERE ratingCount = 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 products have the lowest unit price in the category 'Beverages'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 highest rated movies by users?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movie, avgRating AS Average_Rating

question: What are the first 3 movies released after 2010 with a budget over 100 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year > 2010 AND m.budget > 100000000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.year ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies that have been released in exactly three different countries?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.countries) = 3 RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS releaseDate ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Show the first 3 orders for the product 'Chai'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Chai'})-[:ORDERS]->(o:Order) RETURN o ORDER BY o.orderDate LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have acted in movies that grossed over 1 billion dollars?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 1000000000 RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: List the top 5 users who have mentioned 'neo4j' in their tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN u.screen_name AS user, count(t) AS mentions ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the streams that have a moderator who also moderates a stream with the language "ru" and has more than 5,000 followers and have the language "en".
cypher: MATCH (stream1:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(language1:Language {name: "en"}) MATCH (stream1)<-[:MODERATOR]-(moderator:User) MATCH (moderator)-[:MODERATOR]->(stream2:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(language2:Language {name: "ru"}) WHERE moderator.followers > 5000 RETURN DISTINCT stream1

question: List the first 3 adult films with a specific tagline, e.g., 'Trust Will Get You Killed'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult {tagline: 'Trust Will Get You Killed'}) RETURN a.title, a.release_date, a.tagline ORDER BY a.release_date LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers have products with a minimum unitsInStock of 50?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock >= 50 RETURN s.companyName

question: Find the top 5 products that are part of the 'Confections' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which production company has the highest average gross profit for its movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WITH pc, m.revenue - m.budget AS grossProfit WITH pc, avg(grossProfit) AS averageGrossProfit ORDER BY averageGrossProfit DESC RETURN pc.name AS productionCompanyName, averageGrossProfit LIMIT 1

question: "What is the average imdb rating of movies published in 2020?"
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2020 RETURN AVG(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating

question: List the top 3 people with the most crew roles in movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(r) AS crew_roles ORDER BY crew_roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS person_name, crew_roles

question: Which 3 games are played by streams with the highest ratio of followers to total view counts?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, g, (toFloat(s.followers) / s.total_view_count) AS ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS game, ratio

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders shipped in the month of June 1997?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shippedDate STARTS WITH '1997-06' WITH o, toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * rel.quantity AS revenue RETURN sum(revenue) AS totalRevenue

question: Name the top 5 directors born in the USA.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: 'USA'}) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.born DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the location of the country with code "CHN"?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {code: "CHN"}) RETURN c.location

question: What are the names of teams associated with streams created before 2018?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE s.createdAt < datetime('2018-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN DISTINCT t.name

question: "Which actor worked with the same actor who played Ron Burgundy?"
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(ronActor:Person {name: "Ron Burgundy"}) WITH actor, ronActor MATCH (actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActor:Person) WHERE coActor = ronActor RETURN DISTINCT actor.name

question: What are the first 3 filings with the most number of concerns?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, count{(f)-[:CONCERNS]->(:Entity)} AS concernsCount ORDER BY concernsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f

question: Which movies are associated with more than one production company?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WITH m, count(pc) AS num_companies WHERE num_companies > 1 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, num_companies AS NumberOfProductionCompanies

question: List the first 3 movies that have a poster path ending in '.jpg'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path ENDS WITH '.jpg' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Which products have a reorder level of exactly 10?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 10 RETURN p.productName AS productName, p.reorderLevel AS reorderLevel

question: What are the top 5 movies that have a genre of 'Comedy' and are rated above 6?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) WHERE m.average_vote > 6 RETURN m.title, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 languages spoken in adult films with a vote count over 10?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE a.vote_count > 10 RETURN l.name AS language, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the filings where the originator bank country is 'Singapore' and the end_date is 'Sep 25, 2015'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.end_date = 'Sep 25, 2015' RETURN f

question: List all movies that have a runtime greater than 150 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 150 RETURN m.title, m.runtime

question: Find the actors who have starred in movies with a runtime shorter than their age.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, m,  m.year - date(a.born).year  AS age, m.runtime AS runtime WHERE runtime < age RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Which person reviewed the movie with the lowest rating?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, m, r ORDER BY r.rating ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: Which officers have been involved with entities since 1999?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[r:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE r.start_date >= '1999-01-01' RETURN o.name AS OfficerName, e.name AS EntityName, r.start_date AS StartDate

question: Find streams that have VIP relationships with more than three users.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 3 RETURN s

question: Which movies have a rating higher than 90?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: List the first 3 users who interact most frequently with 'Neo4j' based on the INTERACTS_WITH relationship.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, COUNT(*) AS interaction_count ORDER BY interaction_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders have been placed for products with a unit price within a specific range (e.g., between $10 and $20)?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice >= 10 AND p.unitPrice <= 20 WITH DISTINCT p MATCH (p)-[:ORDERS]->(order:Order) RETURN count(DISTINCT order) AS orderCount

question: List the registered addresses for entities that were incorporated in March 2006.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE e.incorporation_date STARTS WITH '23-MAR-2006' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, a.address AS registered_address

question: Which machines are running services that listen on port 80?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(s:Service)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN m.name AS MachineName, s.name AS ServiceName

question: Who are the first 5 moderators for the stream with the highest total view count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WITH s, u ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(moderator:User) RETURN moderator.name LIMIT 5

question: List the filings where the amount is greater than 100000 and the originator entity is located in the same country as the beneficiary entity.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 100000 MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c) RETURN f.id

question: "What are the ages of the actors in the movie with a title containing the word \"mail\""
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS "mail" RETURN p.name AS ActorName, (date().year - p.born) AS ActorAge

question: What is the incorporation date of the Entity with internal ID "1000914"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: "1000914"}) RETURN e.incorporation_date

question: List the top 5 countries where the most adult films have been produced.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(a) AS NumberOfAdultFilms ORDER BY NumberOfAdultFilms DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the contact name of the supplier with supplierID '1'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier { supplierID: '1' }) RETURN s.contactName

question: What is the total box office revenue of movies starring Leonardo DiCaprio?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Leonardo DiCaprio"})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue RETURN totalRevenue

question: What is the name of the movie with the longest title in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY size(m.title) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the URL of the stream with the highest total view count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.url ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first 3 movies that were both written and reviewed by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseYear, p.name AS PersonName LIMIT 3

question: How many streams have a description containing the word 'strategy'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'strategy' RETURN count(s) AS numberOfStreams

question: List the streams that have VIP users with less than 10,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers < 10000 RETURN s

question: What is the runtime of the movie "Boxtrolls, The"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Boxtrolls, The'}) RETURN m.runtime

question: What are the first 3 movies directed by a director born in Nebraska?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn CONTAINS "Nebraska" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseDate ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 suppliers who supply the most products that have been discontinued.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = true WITH s, COUNT(p) AS discontinuedProducts ORDER BY discontinuedProducts DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, discontinuedProducts

question: List the top 5 movies with a release date on or before December 31, 1990.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date <= date('1990-12-31') RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the follower counts for streams named 'summit1g'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {name: 'summit1g'}) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.followers AS follower_count

question: Who are the top 3 users that have interacted the most with 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, COUNT(*) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the first 3 people born before 1970 who produced a movie released after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1970 AND m.released > 2000 RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 3

question: List the top 10 beneficiary banks with the highest average amount received from filings.
cypher: MATCH (filing:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity) WITH beneficiary.name AS beneficiaryName, avg(filing.amount) AS averageAmount ORDER BY averageAmount DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN beneficiaryName, averageAmount

question: List all teams that have at least one stream with more than 50,000 followers and use the Russian language.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 50000 AND l.name = "ru" WITH DISTINCT s MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name

question: How many streams are both moderated by and have VIPs who are the same user?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User), (s)-[:VIP]->(u) RETURN count(DISTINCT s)

question: What is the most common source used by users who have interacted with "Neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: "neo4j"})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) MATCH (user)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:USING]->(source:Source) WITH source.name AS source_name, count(*) AS source_count ORDER BY source_count DESC RETURN source_name, source_count LIMIT 1

question: Which categories have products with a unitPrice greater than 50?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.unitPrice > 50 RETURN DISTINCT c.categoryName

question: What are the names of the top 3 originator banks that have initiated the most filings with a beneficiary in 'USA'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {code: 'USA'}) RETURN e.name AS originator_bank, COUNT(f) AS filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names and IPs of all switches in zone 4?
cypher: MATCH (s:Switch)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) MATCH (r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(s) WHERE r.zone = 4 RETURN s.name AS switchName, i.ip AS switchIP

question: Which 3 genres do the most movies belong to?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 5 machines that run the OS 'RHEL' and have a type with RAM greater than 256.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(os:OS {name: 'RHEL'}),       (m)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.ram > 256 RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 videos have the highest average vote and are in the 'Released' status?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.status = 'Released' RETURN v.title, v.average_vote ORDER BY v.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which movies have been directed by a person born in 1970 and what are their titles?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {born: 1970})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which person has the most relationships of any type in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p, count{(p)--()} AS totalRelationships ORDER BY totalRelationships DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which people were born in the 1960s and have acted in movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1960 AND p.born < 1970 RETURN p, collect(m) AS movies

question: List all products that have been ordered by 'Vins et alcools Chevalier'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE c.companyName = 'Vins et alcools Chevalier' RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, p.productID AS ProductID

question: Which Filings have a beneficiary bank in 'China'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.name = 'China' RETURN f

question: What is the average rating of movies released in the year 2002?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 2002})<-[r:REVIEWED]-() RETURN avg(r.rating)

question: What is the total revenue of movies released by Universal Pictures?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE "USA" IN m.countries RETURN sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue

question: What is the average total view count for streams that have the language "ru"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'ru'}) WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS averageViewCount RETURN averageViewCount

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most detailed biographies of their directors?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, d, size(d.bio) AS bioLength ORDER BY bioLength DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, d.name AS DirectorName, d.bio AS DirectorBio

question: Find the names of all directors who were born in France.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.bornIn = "France" RETURN d.name

question: What are the top 3 most profitable movies, considering the difference between revenue and budget?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, (m.revenue - m.budget) AS profit ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS title, profit

question: What is the average IMDB rating of movies based on books?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: What are the top 5 sources used in tweets that mention 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})<-[:MENTIONS]-(t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source) RETURN s.name AS source, COUNT(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 collections that include movies with a poster path containing '/rhIRbceoE9lR4veEXuwCC2wARtG.jpg'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WHERE m.poster_path = '/rhIRbceoE9lR4veEXuwCC2wARtG.jpg' RETURN c LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 3 filings with the latest end dates.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f ORDER BY f.end DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f

question: Which countries have entities that are both originators and beneficiaries in filings?
cypher: MATCH (originator:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity) WHERE originator.id = beneficiary.id WITH DISTINCT originator MATCH (originator)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS CountryName

question: Which people have reviewed the same movie and what were their review summaries?
cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[r1:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie)<-[r2:REVIEWED]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1 <> p2 RETURN m.title AS movie, p1.name AS reviewer1, r1.summary AS summary1, p2.name AS reviewer2, r2.summary AS summary2 ORDER BY m.title, p1.name, p2.name

question: What is the description of the stream with the most recent creation date?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.description ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many streams have a name that is a substring of the stream's description?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS s.name RETURN count(*)

question: What is the average vote for the movie "Toy Story"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'}) RETURN m.average_vote

question: Which 3 countries have the highest average amounts in filings where they are listed as originator?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH c.name AS country, AVG(f.amount) AS avg_amount RETURN country, avg_amount ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the highest revenue and were released in the 'United States of America'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "United States of America"}) RETURN m.title AS title, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the application that the process with pid 8966 is an instance of?
