cypher: MATCH (h:Hashtag {name: 'education'})<-[:TAGS]-(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(other:Hashtag) WITH other, count(t) AS count RETURN other.name AS hashtag, count ORDER BY count DESC

question: List the top 5 movies that are rated by the most users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS user_count ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, user_count AS NumberOfRatings

question: Find all tweets by 'Neo4j' that were posted on or after '2021-01-01'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.created_at >= datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN t

question: Which customers (return their `customerID` and `companyName`) have placed orders that include the product with `productName` 'Aniseed Syrup'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Aniseed Syrup'})<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)<-[:PURCHASED]-(c:Customer) RETURN c.customerID, c.companyName

question: Name the top 3 users who are moderators in the stream with the highest follower count.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WITH s, u ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) RETURN u.name AS moderator_name ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the top 5 movies with the most IMDb votes released after 2010.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year > 2010 RETURN m.title AS title, m.imdbVotes AS votes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the movie with the highest ratio of votes to its release year.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, m.votes / m.released AS ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC RETURN m.title, ratio LIMIT 1

question: Which genres have the highest average revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, avg(m.revenue) AS averageRevenue ORDER BY averageRevenue DESC RETURN g.name AS genre, averageRevenue

question: List the names of games played by streams that have chatters also listed as VIPs.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE exists {   (s)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User)   WHERE exists {     (u)-[:VIP]->(s)   } } RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: What are the first 3 movies with the most diverse taglines?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.tagline DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 products with the lowest units on order and not discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = false RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder ASC LIMIT 5

question: Name the movies that have posters ending with 'w5Lctmkc1yah215Luxmci4djaiW.jpg'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster ENDS WITH 'w5Lctmkc1yah215Luxmci4djaiW.jpg' RETURN m.title

question: List all movies with a released year divisible by 10.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released % 10 = 0 RETURN m.title, m.released

question: Which 3 movies have been rated exactly 5 times?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE count{(u:User)-[:RATED]->(m)} = 5 RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most significant difference between budget and revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, m.revenue - m.budget AS profit ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 orders with a required date before '1997-06-01' and a freight cost over $200.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate < '1997-06-01' AND toFloat(o.freight) > 200 RETURN o.orderID, o.requiredDate, o.freight ORDER BY o.requiredDate LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 5 actors who have starred in both a movie and an adult film?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE EXISTS {   (p)-[:CAST_FOR]->(:Adult) } RETURN p.name LIMIT 5

question: How many users are VIPs of more than one stream?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS streamCount WHERE streamCount > 1 RETURN count(u)

question: What is the average number of Intermediaries linked to Entities with a "service_provider" of "Mossack Fonseca"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: 'Mossack Fonseca'})-[:intermediary_of]->(i:Intermediary) WITH e, count(i) AS num_intermediaries RETURN avg(num_intermediaries) AS average_intermediaries

question: What is the average number of followers for streams that are created after 2020 and have "ru" as a language and are part of a team and are moderated by a user who is also a VIP?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.createdAt > datetime('2020-01-01') MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'ru'}) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User)-[:VIP]->(s) WITH avg(s.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: Find the screen names of the top 3 users with the most followers who follow the user with screen name "neo4j".
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) MATCH (follower:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u) WITH follower, u ORDER BY follower.followers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN follower.screen_name

question: List all the movies reviewed with the summary 'An amazing journey'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'An amazing journey' RETURN m.title

question: Which movies have a budget less than 10 million but a revenue greater than 100 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 10000000 AND m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN m

question: What is the average rating given to movies by people born in each decade?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH floor(p.born / 10) * 10 AS decade, r.rating AS rating RETURN decade, avg(rating) AS average_rating ORDER BY decade

question: What is the total number of distinct originator banks that filed transactions benefiting "Barclays Bank Plc"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = "Barclays Bank Plc" MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) RETURN count(DISTINCT e.name) AS total_originator_banks

question: What are the first 3 highest budget movies that were released?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' AND m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 adult films sorted by runtime in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) RETURN a.title, a.runtime ORDER BY a.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movie has the lowest number of votes and what is its tagline?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 1 RETURN m.title AS movie, m.tagline AS tagline

question: "What actors are available in the database?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: What are the top 5 products with the highest discount given in an order?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH p.productName AS productName, r.discount AS discount ORDER BY toFloat(discount) DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN productName, discount

question: What is the name of the data center that contains the machine running the application "logstash"?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: "logstash"})-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine)-[:HOLDS]-(rack:Rack)-[:CONTAINS]-(dc:DataCenter) RETURN dc.name

question: What are the first 3 languages spoken by streams with over 1 million total views?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN l.name AS Language LIMIT 3

question: Find movies with the tagline 'Welcome to the Real World'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {tagline: 'Welcome to the Real World'}) RETURN m

question: What are the top 3 beneficiary countries of filings filed between 2015-03-25T00:00:00Z and 2015-09-25T00:00:00Z?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin_date_format >= "2015-03-25T00:00:00Z" AND f.begin_date_format <= "2015-09-25T00:00:00Z" WITH f.beneficiary_bank_country AS beneficiaryCountry, count(*) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN beneficiaryCountry, filingCount

question: List the suppliers who have products that have been ordered by customers from all regions.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WITH DISTINCT s, c.region AS customerRegion RETURN s.companyName AS supplierCompanyName, collect(DISTINCT customerRegion)

question: List the top 3 movies with the least votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 3

question: Who has directed more than one movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS movies_directed WHERE movies_directed > 1 RETURN p.name, movies_directed

question: Which entity has benefited from the highest amount in a single filing?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name AS entity_name, f.amount AS amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 languages are least common among streams with more than 10,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 10000 WITH l, count(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN l.name, stream_count

question: What are the top 3 languages spoken in movies that have a revenue greater than $100 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN l.name, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies that have the tagline 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!'
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline = 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!' RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 streams with moderators who are users and have a follower count above 2000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 2000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which three countries are most frequently listed as the originator bank country in filings during 2010?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin.year = 2010 RETURN f.originator_bank_country AS Country, count(f) AS Filings ORDER BY Filings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users are chatters in streams with a description containing 'inclusive'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'inclusive' RETURN u.name

question: Which tweets contain links and have more than 100 favorites?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) WHERE t.favorites > 100 RETURN t, l

question: List the top 5 streams that have chatters with a total view count over 10,000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WHERE u.total_view_count > 10000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 3 filings in terms of amount that concern entities in Singapore.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "Singapore"}) RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, f.amount AS amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 orders with the latest required dates.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o ORDER BY o.requiredDate DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which three directors have directed movies with the most diverse set of languages?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, count(DISTINCT m.languages) AS languageDiversity ORDER BY languageDiversity DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name, languageDiversity

question: Identify the top 5 users who are followed by 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, user.followers ORDER BY user.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 packages provide access to the most genres?
cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre) WITH p, count(g) AS genres_count RETURN p.name, genres_count ORDER BY genres_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies where someone born in 1996 acted?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born = 1996 RETURN m.title AS movie_title ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 directors who have also acted in movies.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie), (d)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT d.name LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the top 5 most recent tweets.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 streams by total view count that also have a team?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.total_view_count AS total_views ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of roles played by actors in movies released in 2005?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 2005})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH size(p.roles) AS roleCount RETURN avg(roleCount)

question: Which entities filed a report in March 2015 with an amount exceeding 500000?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.begin_date_format STARTS WITH "2015-03" AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN e.name AS EntityName, f.sar_id AS ReportID, f.amount AS Amount

question: Who are the first 3 people to have written and directed the same movie and what are those movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie LIMIT 3

question: List the products that are in the 'Produce' category and have a discontinued status.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Produce'}) WHERE p.discontinued = TRUE RETURN p.productName, p.productID

question: "Which adult movie has most vote count?"
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) RETURN a.title, a.vote_count ORDER BY a.vote_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of users who are VIPs in more than 3 streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 3 RETURN u.name AS UserName

question: Who are the first 3 people to have produced a movie with more than 500 votes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 500 RETURN p.name ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actor has acted in movies directed by both Quentin Tarantino and David Fincher?
cypher: MATCH (d1:Director {name: "Quentin Tarantino"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (d2:Director {name: "David Fincher"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie) MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1) MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Which 3 products have been ordered by the most distinct customers?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH p, count(DISTINCT c) AS distinctCustomers ORDER BY distinctCustomers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.productName, distinctCustomers

question: What are the first 3 locations where the most users are based?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.location IS NOT NULL RETURN u.location, count(u) AS num_users ORDER BY num_users DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 highest-grossing movies of 2014.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2014 AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title AS movie, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 5 most frequently ordered products.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(:Order) WITH p, count(*) AS ordersCount ORDER BY ordersCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.productName, ordersCount

question: What is the average number of followers for users who are VIPs of streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH u, avg(u.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: List the first 3 videos with a budget greater than 100000 USD.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.budget > 100000 RETURN v ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 3 movies with the shortest runtime and a revenue over 100 million dollars.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime LIMIT 3

question: List the names of the games played by streams that are chatted in by users who are also moderators of other streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH DISTINCT u MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(s2:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: List the top 5 tweets that 'Neo4j' has mentioned and were created after January 2021.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(:User) WHERE t.created_at > datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which movie genre has the highest average revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g.name AS genre, AVG(m.revenue) AS averageRevenue ORDER BY averageRevenue DESC RETURN genre, averageRevenue LIMIT 1

question: Provide the list of all machines that run the application named 'webapp'.
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webapp'})<-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine) RETURN machine.name

question: List the first 5 filings where the beneficiary bank is located in the country with code "CHN", the amount is greater than 1000000, and the originator bank is located in a different country.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(bc:Country) WHERE bc.code = "CHN" AND f.amount > 1000000 MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(oc:Country) WHERE oc.code <> bc.code RETURN f.sar_id, b.name AS beneficiary_bank, o.name AS originator_bank LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have an average vote greater than 8 and have been produced in 'France'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'France'}) WHERE m.average_vote > 8 RETURN m.title, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the different types of services running on machines in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(service:Service) RETURN DISTINCT service.name AS ServiceType

question: Which movies have been released with a status of 'In Production'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'In Production' RETURN m.title

question: List the orders placed by customer 'ALFKI' that include a product with a unit price greater than 20.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: 'ALFKI'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(p.unitPrice) > 20 RETURN DISTINCT o.orderID

question: Which movies have a popularity less than 5 and more than 2?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.popularity > 2 AND m.popularity < 5 RETURN m.title, m.popularity

question: List the top 5 users with the highest betweenness.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.betweenness IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name, u.betweenness ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 processes that listen on port 80?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port {port: 80}) RETURN p.name, p.pid, p.startTime ORDER BY p.startTime DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actor has the highest average rating for their directed movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, avg(m.rating) AS average_rating ORDER BY average_rating DESC RETURN p.name AS director_name, average_rating LIMIT 1

question: What is the `shipCity` of the order with the earliest `orderDate`?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH o ORDER BY o.orderDate LIMIT 1 RETURN o.shipCity

question: List all users who have rated more than 50 movies.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, count(r) AS num_ratings WHERE num_ratings > 50 RETURN u.name AS user, num_ratings

question: List the top 5 suppliers with products in more than three categories.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT c.categoryID) AS categoryCount WHERE categoryCount > 3 RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, categoryCount ORDER BY categoryCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the start times of all processes running on machines in zone 2.
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone {zone: 2})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface)<-[:ROUTES]-(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) RETURN p.startTime AS ProcessStartTime

question: What are the top 3 movies with the most distinct actors in the ACTED_IN relationship?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, count(DISTINCT p) AS numActors ORDER BY numActors DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have been acted in by persons born before 1900?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < date("1900-01-01") RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS ActorName

question: List all suppliers who are from cities starting with 'L'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.city STARTS WITH 'L' RETURN s

question: Name the games played by streams that have a follower count over 2 million.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 2000000 RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS game_name

question: List entities that have a company type of 'FOREIGN FORMED CORPORATION' and their jurisdiction.
cypher: MATCH (e:Other) WHERE e.type = 'FOREIGN FORMED CORPORATION' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.jurisdiction AS jurisdiction

question: List the first 5 users who are moderators in streams that play 'Grand Theft Auto V'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Grand Theft Auto V'}) RETURN u LIMIT 5

question: Show the first 3 originator countries by the total amount sent in transactions.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS originator_country, SUM(f.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN originator_country, total_amount

question: List the movies directed by the director of "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: "Toy Story"}) MATCH (toyStory)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Director) MATCH (director)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) RETURN movie.title

question: Show the first 5 entities that have filed the most number of transactions involving multiple countries.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE exists {     MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(origin:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(originCountry:Country),           (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(benefit:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(benefitCountry:Country)     WHERE originCountry.code <> benefitCountry.code } RETURN e, count(f) AS transactions ORDER BY transactions DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which orders were placed before '1997-01-01' and have a freight greater than 100?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.orderDate < '1997-01-01' AND toFloat(o.freight) > 100 RETURN o.orderID, o.orderDate, o.freight

question: Who are the actors in the movie with the highest number of votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN p.name AS actor_name

question: Who are the 3 persons with the most directed movies that have a tagline?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL WITH p, COUNT(m) AS directedMovies ORDER BY directedMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS directorName, directedMovies

question: Find the product that has the highest difference between its unit price and the average unit price of products in the same category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryID AS categoryID, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avgPrice MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryID: categoryID}) WITH p, avgPrice, abs(p.unitPrice - avgPrice) AS priceDiff  ORDER BY priceDiff DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.productName, priceDiff

question: List the top 5 movies with the longest runtime.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies with the lowest revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue ASC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (n:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) <-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:User) MATCH (follower)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-() RETURN DISTINCT tweet.id_str, tweet.text

question: Which 3 movies have the most detailed plot descriptions (longest text)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY size(m.plot) DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies released in the 1990s.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('1990-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('1999-12-31') RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date ASC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most detailed plots (assuming plot length can be measured)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY size(m.plot) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all actors who have acted in movies that have been released on New Year's Day.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released ENDS WITH "-01-01" RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: List the first 3 actors who have a tmdbId but no imdbId.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE a.tmdbId IS NOT NULL AND a.imdbId IS NULL RETURN a LIMIT 3

question: Show me the movies released between 1990 and 2000 with a tagline containing the word "Houston".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 AND toLower(m.tagline) CONTAINS 'houston' RETURN m.title

question: Which 3 streams have the most users as chatters?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount

question: List the top 3 streams that have the most chatters.

question: What are the first 5 streams created in 2021?

question: What are the first 3 movies that have a revenue greater than 100 million USD and are in the genre 'Action'?

question: List all the movies that have been both directed and acted in by the same person.

question: Which streams have the highest number of unique games played?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS uniqueGames RETURN s.id, s.name, uniqueGames ORDER BY uniqueGames DESC

question: Show the top 3 movies with the lowest number of votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack {zone: 3}) RETURN rack.name

cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:INSTANCE]->(v:Version {name: '7.1'}) RETURN p

cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed.screen_name AS user, followed.followers AS follower_count ORDER BY follower_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers supply products with a unitsInStock value above 80?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock > 80 RETURN s.companyName

question: What are the top 5 movies with a tagline containing the word 'Houston'?

question: Name the top 5 movies with the most diverse cast in terms of roles.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[ai:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, size(collect(distinct ai.roles)) AS role_diversity RETURN m.title AS movie, role_diversity ORDER BY role_diversity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average runtime of action movies?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WHERE g.name = 'Action' RETURN avg(m.runtime) AS averageRuntime

question: Name the top 5 movies that were released after 2010 and have a budget over 100 million USD.

question: What are the URLs of the first 3 streams with the most languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH s, count(l) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.url AS StreamURL

question: What are the first 3 movies that received a review with a rating less than 50?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the products that have a higher unit price than all products in the 'Grains/Cereals' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'}) WITH max(p.unitPrice) AS max_grain_price MATCH (p2:Product) WHERE p2.unitPrice > max_grain_price RETURN p2.productName AS productName, p2.unitPrice AS unitPrice

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'GoldenEye'}) MATCH (m)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) RETURN c.name

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(DISTINCT r.roles) AS diversity ORDER BY diversity DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title, diversity

question: What are the top 3 countries producing the most comedies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: "Comedy"}),        (m)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS country, COUNT(m) AS comedy_count ORDER BY comedy_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 streams that have chatters with more than 5000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 5000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which services started between timestamps 1605733619064 and 1606597376483 and listen to port 80?
cypher: MATCH (s:Service)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port) WHERE s.startTime >= 1605733619064 AND s.startTime <= 1606597376483 AND p.port = 80 RETURN s.name, s.startTime

question: List the first 3 zones by IP address in ascending order.
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone) RETURN z.ip ORDER BY z.ip ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 directors have the most distinct movies directed?

question: What is the name of the data center that contains the machine running the application "webserver"?

question: List the top 3 users with the highest number of streams they are chatters of that have the language "en" and have at least one moderator and have at least one VIP.

question: What are the first 3 categories in which 'Exotic Liquids' supplies products?

question: Which 3 users have rated the most movies with an imdbRating below 5.0?

question: Which actors were born after 1970 and acted in movies released before 2000?

question: List the first 3 movies that have an original language of 'es' and are in the 'Released' status.

question: Which directors have worked with the same actors in multiple movies?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WITH d, a, count(m) AS sharedMovieCount WHERE sharedMovieCount > 1 RETURN d.name AS Director, a.name AS Actor, sharedMovieCount ORDER BY sharedMovieCount DESC

question: What is the name of the entity that filed the filing with the highest amount?

cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE c.categoryName IN ['Beverages', 'Seafood'] WITH s, collect(DISTINCT c.categoryName) AS categories WHERE ALL(cat IN ['Beverages', 'Seafood'] WHERE cat IN categories) RETURN s

question: Which filings concern entities located at a latitude greater than 50?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.location.latitude > 50 RETURN f

question: Who are the officers serving as intermediaries for more than one entity?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WITH o, COUNT(DISTINCT e) AS entityCount WHERE entityCount > 1 MATCH (o)-[:intermediary_of]->(e2:Entity) RETURN o.name AS OfficerName, COLLECT(DISTINCT e2.name) AS Entities

question: List all routers connected to interfaces in zone 3.

question: List the first 3 movies with an average vote greater than 8.0.

cypher: MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a)

question: Which 3 keywords are most frequently associated with movies having a budget over $200 million?

question: Find the movie with the highest difference in the number of votes between any two movies the same actor has worked on.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) WHERE m1 <> m2 WITH m1, m2, abs(m1.votes - m2.votes) AS vote_diff WITH max(vote_diff) AS max_vote_diff MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) WHERE m1 <> m2 AND abs(m1.votes - m2.votes) = max_vote_diff RETURN m1.title, m2.title, max_vote_diff

question: List the top 3 beneficiary banks by the number of filings involving transactions over $2 million.

question: Identify the top 3 beneficiary banks that have received funds in filings where the originator bank is 'Barclays Bank Plc'.

question: What is the total number of filings where the originator entity, beneficiary entity, and filer organization are all located in the same country?

question: List the top 3 directors born in the USA.

question: What is the original language of the movie "Ward 13"?

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released < 2000 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: How many different software versions are available for the software named RHEL?

question: Identify the top 5 filings that ended in the year 2014 and involve an originator bank from 'United Kingdom'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.end >= datetime('2014-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end < datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z')   AND c.name = 'United Kingdom' RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 directors have the longest cumulative runtime of all movies they've directed?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, SUM(m.runtime) AS totalRuntime ORDER BY totalRuntime DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN d.name AS directorName, totalRuntime

question: List the three entities with the most filings involving a beneficiary bank in 'United Kingdom' and an originator bank in 'Singapore'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' AND f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: What is the average number of roles played by actors in each movie?
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH m, avg(size(r.roles)) AS average_roles RETURN m.title AS movie_title, average_roles

question: What are the first 3 streams that have a language set to 'en' and a VIP who is a user?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'en'}) MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(u:User) RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 actors in the movie titled 'Speed Racer'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name AS actor_name, r.roles AS roles LIMIT 3

question: Find all entities that have a registered address with a country code that is different from the country code of the entity.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[r:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE e.country_codes <> a.country_codes RETURN DISTINCT e.name

question: List the top 3 users who have given the highest average ratings.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.userId, u.name, avgRating

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention a user who follows "Neo4j" and contain a link to a specific domain that has been shared by a user who has a similarity score greater than 0.7 with them?
cypher: MATCH (n:User {screen_name: "Neo4j"}) <-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:User) <-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet) MATCH (tweet)-[:POSTS]-(tweeter:User)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(similarUser:User) WHERE s.score > 0.7 MATCH (similarUser)-[:POSTS]-(domainTweet:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(link:Link) WHERE link.url CONTAINS 'your_specific_domain' WITH avg(tweet.favorites) AS averageFavorites RETURN averageFavorites

question: Which 3 orders have the largest quantity of a single product ordered?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, r.quantity AS quantity ORDER BY r.quantity DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers have products with a reorder level equal to 0?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 0 MATCH (p)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: Which 5 actors have the most roles listed as uncredited?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) WHERE r.role CONTAINS 'uncredited' RETURN a.name AS actor, count(r) AS uncreditedRoles ORDER BY uncreditedRoles DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have the highest popularity but the least revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.popularity IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.popularity, m.revenue ORDER BY m.popularity DESC, m.revenue ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 orders that have a shipped date exactly one week after the order date.

question: Which movies have been reviewed as "An amazing journey"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(:Person) WHERE r.summary = "An amazing journey" RETURN m.title

question: Which actors have acted in movies from at least three different countries?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, size(collect(distinct m.countries)) AS numCountries WHERE numCountries >= 3 RETURN a.name AS actor, numCountries

question: List the first 3 production companies that have produced movies with a budget exceeding 200 million dollars.

question: What is the name of the actor who has acted in movies with the highest total box office revenue?

question: What is the most common status for Entities registered in Hong Kong?

question: Find all tweets by 'Neo4j' that tag a hashtag and mention a user.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag),       (t)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, t.created_at AS tweet_date, h.name AS hashtag, m.screen_name AS mentioned_user

question: List the orders placed by customers who have placed orders for products in all categories except 'Grains/Cereals'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'}) WITH c.categoryID AS excludedCategory MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WHERE cat.categoryID <> excludedCategory WITH DISTINCT cat.categoryID AS categoryID WITH collect(categoryID) AS allOtherCategories MATCH (cust:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WITH cust, collect(DISTINCT cat.categoryID) AS customerCategories, allOtherCategories WHERE customerCategories = allOtherCategories MATCH (cust)-[:PURCHASED]->(order:Order) RETURN DISTINCT order.orderID

question: Find the tweets posted by users who have more than 10000 followers and have been retweeted by 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)  WHERE u.followers > 10000 MATCH (u)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) MATCH (t)<-[:RETWEETS]-(:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(user:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN DISTINCT t

question: List the top 5 movies with the highest number of different actors involved.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, count(p) AS num_actors ORDER BY num_actors DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the users who are VIPs of streams with more than 1,000,000 total view count and have a moderator who also moderates a stream with the game "Rust".

question: What is the average rating given by people who follow Keanu Reeves?
cypher: MATCH (kr:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(follower:Person) WITH follower MATCH (follower)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN avg(r.rating) AS average_rating

question: What is the average number of movies directed by directors born in each decade?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH floor(d.born / 10) * 10 AS decade, count(DISTINCT m) AS totalMovies, count(DISTINCT d) AS totalDirectors RETURN decade, totalMovies / totalDirectors AS averageMovies ORDER BY decade

question: Which movies have a runtime greater than 120 minutes and less than 180 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 AND m.runtime < 180 RETURN m

question: Find the top 5 streams that are playing the game 'Rust'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) RETURN s.name, s.url, s.followers, s.total_view_count ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all movies directed by people born before 1950 limited to top 5.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 movies with the most user ratings.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(u) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, numRatings AS NumberOfRatings

question: List the first 3 adult films that were released in the year 2000 or later.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') RETURN a.title, a.release_date ORDER BY a.release_date LIMIT 3

question: Can you list the names of entities with multiple relationships types like 'same_as' and 'registered_address'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE exists {   (e)-[:same_as]->(:Entity) } AND exists {   (e)-[:registered_address]->(:Address) } RETURN e.name

question: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies released after 2010?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= '2010-01-01' AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the 5 customers who have ordered the most distinct categories of products.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WITH c, COUNT(DISTINCT cat) AS distinctCategories ORDER BY distinctCategories DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.companyName, distinctCategories

question: What is the `categoryName` of the category with the highest average `discount` applied to its products?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[ord:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, avg(toFloat(ord.discount)) AS averageDiscount ORDER BY averageDiscount DESC RETURN c.categoryName AS categoryName, averageDiscount LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 users have rated the oldest movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, m ORDER BY m.year ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName, m.title AS movieTitle, m.year AS movieYear

question: Which Intermediaries are associated with Entities that have a 'Defaulted' status?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {status: 'Defaulted'}) <-[:intermediary_of]-(i:Intermediary) RETURN DISTINCT i.name

question: What are the first 3 collections that contain more than 5 movies?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection)<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) WITH c, count(m) as movieCount WHERE movieCount > 5 RETURN c.name AS collectionName, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of dependencies for all the Processes?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[d:DEPENDS_ON]->() WITH p, count(d) AS num_dependencies WITH avg(num_dependencies) AS average_dependencies RETURN average_dependencies

question: Which 3 countries have the least number of movies produced in them?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(m:Movie) WITH c, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS country, movieCount

question: List the first 3 streams that have a game and team name starting with the same letter.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH substring(t.name, 0, 1) RETURN s.id AS StreamID, s.name AS StreamName, g.name AS GameName, t.name AS TeamName LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the year 1999?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 1999}) WITH avg(m.votes) AS average_votes RETURN average_votes

question: List the product names of the first 3 products that have a unitPrice greater than 20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice > 20 RETURN p.productName ORDER BY p.productID LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 entities with a sourceID of 'Panama Papers'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.sourceID = 'Panama Papers' WITH e LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name

question: List the first 3 movies in which 'Tom Hanks' has acted.

question: List the top 3 actors by the number of IMDb votes they've received for their movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbVotes IS NOT NULL RETURN a.name, sum(m.imdbVotes) AS totalVotes ORDER BY totalVotes DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of intermediaries that are linked to entities with a status of 'Defaulted'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:intermediary_of]-(i:Intermediary) WHERE e.status = 'Defaulted' RETURN DISTINCT i.name AS IntermediaryName

question: Display the top 3 services by PID running in Data Center DC1.

question: Name the first 5 movies that have a homepage listed.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.homepage ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 5

question: Which users have moderated the most streams, and list the top 3.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS moderated_streams ORDER BY moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user_name, moderated_streams

question: List the persons who have written, directed, and produced the same movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) MATCH (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN p.name AS person_name, m.title AS movie_title

question: What is the name of the game that is played by the stream that is moderated by the user with the most total view count?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, sum(s.total_view_count) AS totalViews ORDER BY totalViews DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN g.name

question: List the first 3 discontinued products and their categories.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.discontinued = true RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, c.categoryName AS CategoryName LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 egress routes from DataCenter 'DC1'.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(e:Egress)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN e.name AS EgressName, i.ip AS InterfaceIP ORDER BY e.name LIMIT 5

question: What is the name of the product with productID '2'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productID: '2'}) RETURN p.productName

question: Which users are VIPs on at least two different streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(distinct s) as num_vip_streams WHERE num_vip_streams >= 2 RETURN u.name as user, num_vip_streams

question: What are the prices of the packages named 'Gold' and 'Platinum'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Package) WHERE p.name IN ['Gold', 'Platinum'] RETURN p.name, p.price

question: List the 3 directors who have directed the most movies of a single genre.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, g, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN d.name AS Director, g.name AS Genre, movieCount

question: Find all people who directed movies with a rating below 60.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating < 60 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Find the top 5 movies with the highest votes released after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 AND m.votes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average rating given by the user with userId "1"?
cypher: MATCH (u:User { userId: "1" })-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN avg(r.rating)

question: List the top 5 suppliers based on the number of products they supply.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, count(p) AS products_supplied ORDER BY products_supplied DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.companyName, products_supplied

question: List the streams that are moderated by users with more than 10,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 RETURN s

question: List the top 5 movies with a released year before 1985.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1985 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all movies where the director has directed more than 5 movies.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 5 MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN d.name AS Director, m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which 3 users have VIP status on the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS vip_count ORDER BY vip_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, vip_count

question: What is the source ID for the relationship connecting an Officer to an Entity with the same name as another Officer?
cypher: MATCH (o1:Officer)-[r:officer_of]->(e:Entity)<-[:same_name_as]-(o2:Officer) RETURN DISTINCT r.sourceID

question: What are the top 5 adult films with the highest number of votes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) RETURN a.title, a.vote_count ORDER BY a.vote_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of followers for users who are moderators of streams with the language "en"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" WITH s MATCH (s)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User) WITH u.followers AS followers RETURN avg(followers)

question: List the first 3 orders shipped to 'France' with a ship via code '1'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'France' AND o.shipVia = '1' RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName, o.shipCity, o.shipPostalCode, o.shipAddress, o.shipCountry, o.shipVia ORDER BY o.orderDate LIMIT 3

question: Find the 3 streams with the most distinct languages used.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN s.name AS stream, collect(DISTINCT l.name) AS languages, count(DISTINCT l) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 Countries where the Filings' beneficiary banks are located?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(f) AS NumberOfFilings ORDER BY NumberOfFilings DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average quantity of each product ordered by customers in each country?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c.country AS country, p.productName AS productName, AVG(toFloat(o.quantity)) AS averageQuantity RETURN country, productName, averageQuantity

question: Which streams have the highest number of unique games played?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, count(distinct g) as numGames ORDER BY numGames DESC RETURN s.name as stream, numGames LIMIT 10

question: Identify 5 streams where users are both VIPs and moderators.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:VIP]-(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url, u.name AS user_name LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have the most expensive poster paths registered?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.poster_path ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all customers who have purchased products with a unit price greater than 50.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(r.unitPrice) > 50 RETURN DISTINCT c.companyName AS customerName, c.contactName AS contactName, c.contactTitle AS contactTitle, c.phone AS phone, c.city AS city, c.country AS country

question: Which categories have products with a unit price greater than 100?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.unitPrice > 100 RETURN DISTINCT c.categoryName

question: Which movie has the most crew members?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[crewRel:CREW_FOR]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(p) AS crewCount ORDER BY crewCount DESC RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, crewCount LIMIT 1

question: What is the average total view count for streams that have "en" as their language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_view_count RETURN average_view_count

question: What are the top 3 most recent types of connection available in the schema?
cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN DISTINCT r.link AS connection_type, r.valid_until ORDER BY r.valid_until DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which directors have both acted in and directed the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT d.name

question: What are the top 5 genres by the number of movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, count(m) as movieCount RETURN g.name as genre, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 3 users based on the number of users they interact with?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(other:User) WITH u, COUNT(other) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.screen_name AS user, interactions

question: What are the names of users who have moderated other users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User) RETURN DISTINCT u.name AS ModeratorNames

question: "Give me all the movies directed by Lana Wachowski, sorted in reverse chronological order"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Lana Wachowski"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC

question: Which person has acted in the most movies and what are those movies titles?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, collect(m.title) AS movies, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS person, movies

question: What are the names of the top 3 oldest actors and the movies they have produced?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, m.title ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 streams that have been in the same team since their creation and still active?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE s.createdAt >= t.createdAt RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url, s.createdAt AS stream_created_at ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the first 3 people who reviewed a movie titled 'Apollo 13'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie {title: 'Apollo 13'}) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 videos with the highest average vote.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) RETURN v.title, v.average_vote ORDER BY v.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN count(DISTINCT g.name) AS total_games

question: Which suppliers have a companyName that contains the word 'Exotic'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.companyName CONTAINS 'Exotic' RETURN s

question: Which suppliers provide products to more than one region?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) WHERE o.shipRegion IS NOT NULL WITH s, COLLECT(DISTINCT o.shipRegion) AS regions WHERE SIZE(regions) > 1 RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, regions

question: "which actor played in the same movie they had directed, written, and produced?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) AND (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) AND (p)-[:WROTE]->(m) RETURN p.name, m.title

question: List the top 3 streams with the highest ratio of total view count to followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WITH s,  CASE WHEN s.followers > 0 THEN toFloat(s.total_view_count) / s.followers ELSE 0.0 END AS ratio RETURN s.name AS stream_name, ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the different types of machines that can run in a rack located in zone 4?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {zone: 4})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN DISTINCT t.type AS MachineType

question: Who are the first 3 directors of movies with a budget less than $5 million?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.job = "Director" AND m.budget < 5000000 RETURN p.name AS Director, m.title AS MovieTitle ORDER BY r.credit_id LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies that have been rated by users more than 1000 times.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count > 1000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.vote_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers have a home page listed? Provide names for the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.homePage IS NOT NULL RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 countries with the most filings as an originator in 2012?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.begin.year = 2012 RETURN c.name AS Country, count(f) AS Filings ORDER BY Filings DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 countries with the most videos produced.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(v) AS NumberOfVideos ORDER BY NumberOfVideos DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (s:Service {name: 'java'})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(a:Application) RETURN count(a) AS numberOfDependentApplications

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:VIP]-(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) WITH avg(s.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: List all movies that have been produced in both the USA and Canada.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c1:Country {name: 'United States of America'}) MATCH (m)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c2:Country {name: 'Canada'}) RETURN m.title

question: What are the first 5 adult films with the highest average vote?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.average_vote IS NOT NULL RETURN a.title, a.average_vote ORDER BY a.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the productID of the product included in the order with orderID '10248'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order {orderID: '10248'})-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productID

question: What are the first 3 movies produced by persons born before 1960 with a rating over 90?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(reviewer:Person) WHERE p.born < 1960 AND r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Who are the persons that have written and also acted in the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN p.name AS personName, m.title AS movieTitle

question: What are the first 3 movies that were produced in the United States and have a vote count greater than 5000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "United States of America"}) WHERE m.vote_count > 5000 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.vote_count AS VoteCount ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with a plot mentioning 'zombie'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'zombie' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 genres associated with the video titled 'Electrical Girl'?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video {title: 'Electrical Girl'})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 customers have ordered products from the most categories?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WITH c, COUNT(DISTINCT cat) AS numCategories ORDER BY numCategories DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.companyName, numCategories

question: Which movies have a plot description longer than 150 characters?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot IS NOT NULL AND size(m.plot) > 150 RETURN m.title, m.plot

question: Which Ports are exposed by the Interface with IP '10.0.0.254'?
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface {ip: '10.0.0.254'})-[:EXPOSES]->(p:Port) RETURN p

question: Provide the names of all officers from South Korea.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer) WHERE o.countries = "South Korea" RETURN o.name

question: List the first 5 originator bank names for filings where the beneficiary country is "United States".
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = "United States" WITH DISTINCT f.originator_bank AS originatorBankName LIMIT 5 RETURN originatorBankName

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention users who have a similarity score greater than 0.4 to the user with screen name "neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) MATCH (u)-[sim:SIMILAR_TO]->(similarUser) WHERE sim.score > 0.4 MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(similarUser) WITH avg(t.favorites) AS averageFavorites RETURN averageFavorites

question: Find all movies that have the same languages as "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: "Toy Story"})-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre:Genre) WITH toyStory, collect(genre.name) AS toyStoryGenres MATCH (otherMovie:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre) WHERE genre.name IN toyStoryGenres AND otherMovie.title <> "Toy Story" RETURN DISTINCT otherMovie.title

question: List the top 5 users with the most tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WITH u, count(tweet) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.screen_name, tweet_count

question: Which 3 movies have the most distinct languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH m, count(DISTINCT l) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title, num_languages

question: List all suppliers who have a product with a quantity per unit greater than '10 boxes' and also supply a product with a quantity per unit less than '5 pieces'.
cypher: MATCH (p1:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p1.quantityPerUnit > '10 boxes' WITH collect(DISTINCT s.supplierID) AS suppliers_high_quantity MATCH (p2:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p2.quantityPerUnit < '5 pieces' WITH suppliers_high_quantity, collect(DISTINCT s.supplierID) AS suppliers_low_quantity WITH apoc.coll.intersection(suppliers_high_quantity, suppliers_low_quantity) AS common_suppliers MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.supplierID IN common_suppliers RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: What is the highest 'betweenness' score among all users in the database?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN max(u.betweenness)

question: Find all actors who have starred in a movie with a character that has the same name as them. (first 3)

question: Which 5 actors have acted in movies released in the most distinct years?

question: "show me Movies Directed, and Starring the Same Person"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS PersonName, m.released AS ReleaseYear

question: Which movies have been produced in the United States of America?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'United States of America'}) RETURN m.title

question: List the orderIDs of orders that contain more than 5 different products.

question: List the first 3 movies that have been rated exactly by 3 different users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount WHERE userCount = 3 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 3

question: How many streams have a description containing the word 'strategy'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'strategy' RETURN count(s) AS NumberOfStreams

question: List the first 3 actors who have acted in a movie with a budget over 50 million USD.

question: Which entity has benefited from the highest amount in a single filing?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e, f.amount AS amount ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS Movie, r.rating AS Rating ORDER BY r.rating ASC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 genres of movies that have a budget less than 50 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.budget < 50000000 RETURN g.name AS genre, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.countries) > 5 RETURN m.title, m.countries

question: List the names of the users who are moderators of streams that are part of a team and are chatted in by users who are also VIPs.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(:Team) WITH s MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(moderator:User) WITH s, moderator MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(vip:User) WITH s, moderator, vip MATCH (s)-[:CHATTER]->(chatter:User) WHERE chatter = vip RETURN DISTINCT moderator.name

question: Find the top 5 categories with the most expensive products on average.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS Category, AVG(p.unitPrice) AS AvgPrice ORDER BY AvgPrice DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN Category, AvgPrice

question: Which customer has the highest average order value?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c, o, sum(toFloat(orders.unitPrice) * orders.quantity) AS totalOrderValue WITH c, avg(totalOrderValue) AS averageOrderValue RETURN c.companyName, averageOrderValue ORDER BY averageOrderValue DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 games by the number of languages they are streamed in.

question: Name the top 5 videos that were released in the year 2010 or later.

question: What is the name of the Application that listens to the Port with the lowest port number?

question: How many streams have a total view count that is equal to the average total view count of all streams?

question: List all users who follow 'neo4j'.

question: What are the top 3 games played by streams that also have a moderator relationship with a user?

question: What is the average 'betweenness' centrality of users who have retweeted tweets that mention users who have interacted with 'Neo4j'?

question: Who are the top 3 actors with roles in the most diverse genres (based on taglines)?

question: What are the top 3 locations where the most active users are based?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.statuses IS NOT NULL RETURN u.location AS Location, count(u) AS NumberOfUsers ORDER BY NumberOfUsers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have been created after 2018 and are part of a team created before 2015?

question: Show the top 5 people by the number of movies they have produced.
