question: What are the first 3 keywords associated with the movie 'Toy Story'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) RETURN k.name LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 genres where the most movies have been produced.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average `freight` cost of orders placed by customers located in 'Germany' and shipped to 'France'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND o.shipCountry = 'France' WITH avg(toFloat(o.freight)) AS averageFreight RETURN averageFreight

question: What is the average amount of filings where the filer organization is located in the country with code "CHN"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:FILED]->(org:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country)  WHERE c.code = "CHN" WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: What are the jurisdictions described for entities with a jurisdiction of 'SAM'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.jurisdiction = 'SAM' RETURN DISTINCT e.jurisdiction_description

question: List the movies that have been rated by user '1'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {userId: '1'})-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, r.rating

question: What is the average 'amount' of filings where the originator entity and beneficiary entity are different?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity) MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WHERE o.id <> b.id WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: Which Machines in DataCenter 'DC1' are running an Application named 'webserver'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application {name: 'webserver'}) RETURN m

question: What are the names of the types with a CPU count greater than 16?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.cpu > 16 RETURN t.name

question: Show all hashtags that have appeared in more than 5 tweets mentioning 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})<-[:MENTIONS]-(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WITH h, count(t) AS tweetCount WHERE tweetCount > 5 RETURN h.name AS hashtag, tweetCount

question: List the top 3 languages with the most number of movies spoken in them.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH l, count(*) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN l.name, movieCount

question: "What is the range of age of the actors"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) WITH MAX(p.born) AS maxYear, MIN(p.born) AS minYear RETURN 2023 - minYear AS maxAge, 2023 - maxYear AS minAge

question: What are the top 3 highest-grossing movies directed by a person named 'Tom Hanks'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of words in movie taglines?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH size(split(m.tagline, ' ')) AS words RETURN avg(words)

question: List the actors who have starred in movies that have been nominated for the Best Foreign Language Film Oscar. (first 3)
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of actors who have acted in more than five movies?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 5 RETURN a.name AS actorName

question: What is the tagline for the movie with an imdb_id of "tt0114709"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {imdb_id: "tt0114709"}) RETURN m.tagline

question: Find the entities that are registered at the address with country_codes 'WSM' and valid_until 'The Panama Papers  data is current through 2015'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address {country_codes: 'WSM', valid_until: 'The Panama Papers  data is current through 2015'}) MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a) RETURN e.name

question: What is the average budget of historical dramas?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: "History"})<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.budget) AS average_budget RETURN average_budget

question: What is the average discount applied to products in orders shipped to 'Austria'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'Austria' WITH avg(toFloat(rel.discount)) AS averageDiscount RETURN averageDiscount

question: What are the highest discount rates applied to any products?
cypher: MATCH (:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(:Product) RETURN MAX(r.discount) AS HighestDiscount

question: What are the top 3 movies with the longest runtime?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find streams that are moderated by users who are also chatters.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(s) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url, u.name AS user_name

question: What are the names of suppliers who supply products in the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName AS SupplierName

question: List all movies with more than one role listed in the 'ACTED_IN' relationship.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE size(r.roles) > 1 RETURN m.title, collect(p.name) AS actors, r.roles

question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest number of countries represented in their languages list?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.languages IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.languages, size(m.countries) AS num_countries ORDER BY num_countries DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all Officers who have an "officer_of" relationship with an Entity that shares the same "ibcRUC" as another Entity linked to an Intermediary with the name "LOYAL PORT LIMITED".
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {name: "LOYAL PORT LIMITED"})-[]-(e1:Entity) WITH DISTINCT e1.ibcRUC AS sharedIbcRUC MATCH (e2:Entity {ibcRUC: sharedIbcRUC}) WITH DISTINCT e2 MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e2) RETURN DISTINCT o

question: What is the most common language among movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) UNWIND m.languages AS l WITH l, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC RETURN l AS language, count LIMIT 1

question: Name 3 persons who have reviewed the most movies released before 2000.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 2000 WITH p, count(r) AS numReviews ORDER BY numReviews DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS reviewer

question: "how many movies did tom hanks played"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN COUNT(m) AS NumberOfMoviesTomHanksPlayedIn

question: Find all suppliers in the 'NULL' region.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.region = 'NULL' RETURN s.companyName, s.contactName, s.phone, s.address, s.city, s.country, s.postalCode

question: Which genre has the most movies with a male lead?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[cf:CAST_FOR]-(p:Person {gender: 2}) WITH m, cf, p MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN g.name AS mostPopularGenre, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 most followed streams that are linked to the language 'en'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'en'}) RETURN s.name, s.followers ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 5 beneficiary bank countries for filings with amounts greater than 10000000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 10000000 RETURN DISTINCT f.beneficiary_bank_country AS country LIMIT 5

question: Which category (`categoryName`) has the highest average `unitPrice` for its products?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS categoryName, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avgUnitPrice ORDER BY avgUnitPrice DESC RETURN categoryName LIMIT 1

question: Find the top 5 filings with the highest amounts.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all the languages that have only one movie associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH l, count(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount = 1 RETURN l.name

question: Which movies have been reviewed by more than 3 different people?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(DISTINCT p) AS reviewers_count WHERE reviewers_count > 3 RETURN m.title AS Movie, reviewers_count

question: Find all movies where Nancy Meyers was involved either by acting, directing, producing, or writing.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Nancy Meyers'})-[:ACTED_IN|DIRECTED|PRODUCED|WROTE]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie

question: What are the names of the entities that originated filings where the beneficiary bank is located in the United Kingdom?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = "United Kingdom" MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT o.name

question: Which suppliers have the most products currently on order?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 0 RETURN s.companyName, COUNT(p) AS productsOnOrder ORDER BY productsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 products are most frequently ordered together?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, collect(p.productID) AS products UNWIND products AS product1 UNWIND products AS product2 WITH product1, product2, count(*) AS frequency WHERE product1 < product2 RETURN product1, product2, frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of entities with a service provider 'Mossack Fonseca' and struck off in 2013?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' AND e.struck_off_date CONTAINS '2013' RETURN e.name

question: Which director has the lowest total gross revenue for all their movies?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue ORDER BY totalRevenue ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN d.name AS directorName, totalRevenue

question: Name the top 5 actors who acted in a movie released in 1999.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 1999 RETURN p.name as actor, count(*) as appearances ORDER BY appearances DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 directors born after 1960.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 3

question: What is the average box office revenue for movies based on Stephen King novels?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: "Stephen King"}) WITH avg(m.revenue) AS averageRevenue RETURN averageRevenue

question: What is the total number of filings where the originator entity's country is 'CHN' and the beneficiary entity's country is 'GBR'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(oe:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(oc:Country),       (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(be:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(bc:Country) WHERE oc.code = 'CHN' AND bc.code = 'GBR' RETURN count(DISTINCT f.id) AS totalFilings

question: Which actors have never acted in a movie released after 2010?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE NOT EXISTS {     MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)     WHERE m.year > 2010 } RETURN a.name

question: What movies have a runtime longer than 120 minutes and were released after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 AND m.released >= '2000-01-01' RETURN m

question: Which 3 processes are running on the machine named 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'})-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) RETURN p.name AS process_name, p.startTime AS start_time, p.pid AS process_id LIMIT 3

question: What is the average rating of movies directed by Anthony Stacchi?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: 'Anthony Stacchi'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: What is the total number of interfaces that are being routed by the egress router?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(egress:Egress)-[:ROUTES]->(interface:Interface) RETURN count(interface) AS totalInterfaces

question: What are the names of the top 3 streams that have a VIP user?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) RETURN s.name AS StreamName ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users mentioned in 'neo4j' tweets have more following than 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentioned:User) WHERE mentioned.following > neo4j.following RETURN mentioned

question: What is the average start time of all processes running on machines that also run the application 'logstash'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application {name: 'logstash'}) WITH m MATCH (m)-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) RETURN avg(p.startTime)

question: What are the first 3 tweets posted by 'Neo4j' that include a source named 'Buffer'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source {name: 'Buffer'}) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 most viewed streams that have a language set to 'en'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'en'}) RETURN s.name, s.total_view_count ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 streams that have the most chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-() RETURN s.name AS stream, count(*) AS chatter_count ORDER BY chatter_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average rating given by users to movies with a runtime greater than 150 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WHERE m.runtime > 150 WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: Identify all services that started before timestamp 1606200000000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Service) WHERE s.startTime < 1606200000000 RETURN s.name, s.startTime

question: Which streams have been created after 2018 and are part of a team created before 2015?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE s.createdAt > datetime('2018-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.createdAt < datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s

question: What are the first 3 products with the highest units on order in the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which country has produced the most movies with a runtime shorter than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 UNWIND m.countries AS country WITH country, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN country, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 products with the highest units on order in the 'Produce' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Produce'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 5

question: List 5 adult videos with a tagline containing the word 'sex'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.tagline CONTAINS 'sex' RETURN a LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have been directed by actors.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseDate ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Which products are part of the 'Meat/Poultry' category and have a reorder level above 20?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Meat/Poultry'}) WHERE p.reorderLevel > 20 RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel

question: List the top 5 filings where the originator bank country is 'Singapore' and the amount is between 500000 and 2000000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.amount >= 500000 AND f.amount <= 2000000 RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 videos with a budget greater than 100000 USD.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.budget > 100000 RETURN v.title, v.budget ORDER BY v.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 directors have worked on the highest-grossing movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS director, sum(m.revenue) AS total_revenue ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average budget of movies in the "Adventure" genre?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'})<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.budget) AS averageBudget RETURN averageBudget

question: Which Others have a "same_name_as" relationship with an Entity and are both linked to an Address located in the same "countries" as their "jurisdiction_description"?
cypher: MATCH (o:Other)-[:same_name_as]->(e:Entity) MATCH (o)-[:registered_address]->(oa:Address) MATCH (e)-[:registered_address]->(ea:Address) WHERE oa.countries = o.jurisdiction_description AND ea.countries = o.jurisdiction_description RETURN DISTINCT o.name AS other_name, e.name AS entity_name, oa.countries AS address_countries

question: Who are the top 5 followers of 'neo4j' by number of followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})<-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:User) RETURN follower ORDER BY follower.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the movies released in the 1980s with an IMDB rating below 5.0.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 1980 AND m.year <= 1989 AND m.imdbRating < 5.0 RETURN m.title, m.year

question: Identify the top 3 entities that have filed the least amount of filings but have the highest amounts in those filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings, SUM(f.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY num_filings ASC, total_amount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings, total_amount

question: List the top 5 movies that made the least revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue LIMIT 5

question: Which users have posted tweets with more than 100 favorites?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorites > 100 RETURN u

question: List the first 5 production companies that have produced the most adult films.
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(a:Adult) WITH c, count(a) AS adultCount ORDER BY adultCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.name AS productionCompany, adultCount

question: List the top 3 most reordered products.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 most common languages used by streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS Language, count(s) AS StreamCount ORDER BY StreamCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all the movies that have the summary "A solid romp".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(:Person) WHERE r.summary = "A solid romp" RETURN m.title

question: What are the top 5 countries producing the most movies with a tagline that includes the word 'love'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE toLower(m.tagline) CONTAINS 'love' RETURN c.name AS country, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 persons have the most distinct roles in the ACTED_IN relationship?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, collect(distinct r.roles) AS roles RETURN p.name, size(apoc.coll.flatten(roles)) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average revenue of movies in the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'})<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) RETURN avg(m.revenue)

question: Which person has produced the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS producer, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which director has the highest average revenue per movie?
cypher: MATCH (person:Person)-[crew:CREW_FOR]->(movie:Movie) WHERE crew.job = 'Director' WITH person, sum(movie.revenue) AS totalRevenue, count(movie) AS movieCount WITH person, totalRevenue / movieCount AS averageRevenue ORDER BY averageRevenue DESC RETURN person.name AS director, averageRevenue LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 5 languages spoken in movies that have a budget over $50 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which products from 'Exotic Liquids' have been ordered in quantities of less than 10?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: "Exotic Liquids"})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[o:ORDERS]->(ord:Order) WHERE o.quantity < 10 RETURN p.productName, o.quantity

question: What are the first 3 countries that have the most entities with filings in the database?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) AS entity_count ORDER BY entity_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN country, entity_count

question: What is the total view count of all streams that use the English language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: "en"}) RETURN sum(s.total_view_count)

question: List the top 5 tweets by 'Me' that were created between January and February 2021.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WHERE tweet.created_at >= datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND tweet.created_at < datetime('2021-03-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN tweet ORDER BY tweet.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers have a product named 'Chai' in their product list?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product {productName: 'Chai'}) RETURN s.companyName

question: Which filings originated from entities in 'Singapore' and ended in 2015? Limit to top 5 results.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'Singapore'}) MATCH (e)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.end_date_format CONTAINS '2015' RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 actors by number of movies acted in from 1990 to 2000.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 WITH p, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, numMovies

question: Who are the first 3 actors by number of roles in videos with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[c:CAST_FOR]->(v:Video) WHERE v.status = 'Released' WITH p, count(c) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC RETURN p.name, roles LIMIT 3

question: Find the streams that have "en" as a language and are part of a team created before 2015.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt < datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00.000000000Z') RETURN DISTINCT s.name

question: Display the first 3 tweets by 'neo4j' that use the source 'Buffer'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source {name: 'Buffer'}) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: Identify all 'Other' nodes with a jurisdiction of 'AW' and their types.
cypher: MATCH (o:Other) WHERE o.jurisdiction = 'AW' RETURN o.name AS name, o.type AS type

question: Which three users have posted the most about 'education'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) WITH u, count(t) AS tweets_about_education ORDER BY tweets_about_education DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name, tweets_about_education

question: List the top 3 customers by the number of orders placed.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.companyName, count(o) AS NumberOfOrders ORDER BY NumberOfOrders DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all the streams created in the year 2020, ordered by their creation date in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.createdAt >= datetime('2020-01-01T00:00:00.000000000Z')    AND s.createdAt < datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00.000000000Z') RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC

question: List the top 5 movies directed by a person named 'Graham Annable'.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: 'Graham Annable'})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS IMDbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest budget that has not yet been released?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status <> "Released" WITH max(m.budget) AS max_budget MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status <> "Released" AND m.budget = max_budget RETURN m.title

question: Who are the people who have not acted in any movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT exists{ (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN p

question: List all tweets by 'neo4j' that have more than 200 favorites and show the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorites > 200 RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the tweets that 'neo4j' has retweeted from users with a lower follower count.
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(retweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(original:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(otherUser:User) WHERE neo4j.followers > otherUser.followers RETURN original AS TweetRetweeted, otherUser AS OriginalPoster

question: Which games does the user with id "129004176" play?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {id: "129004176"})-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN g.name

question: What are the top 5 users with the highest betweenness scores?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.betweenness IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name, u.betweenness ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 longest Filings in terms of duration from the begin to the end date.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin IS NOT NULL AND f.end IS NOT NULL RETURN f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS Duration ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify entities with the same ID as other entities.
cypher: MATCH (e1:Entity)-[:same_id_as]->(e2:Entity) RETURN e1, e2

question: List the addresses that have been registered after 2010 in the Panama Papers.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address)-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity) WHERE e.sourceID = "Panama Papers" AND a.valid_until > "2010" RETURN a.address

question: Which 3 languages are most frequently used in videos with a runtime over 100 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE v.runtime > 100 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(*) AS frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the top 5 countries with the most filings where they are both originator and beneficiary in transactions involving multiple currencies.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e1:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c1:Country),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e2:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c2:Country) WHERE c1.code = c2.code WITH c1.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, filings_count

question: What are the first 3 streams that are part of a team with the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH t, count(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t) RETURN s.name AS streamName LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies directed by people born in the 1960s and their release years?
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE director.born >= 1960 AND director.born < 1970 RETURN movie.title AS title, movie.released AS release_year ORDER BY movie.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: Display the top 5 movies that have been reviewed with the summary 'Dark, but compelling'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'Dark, but compelling' RETURN m.title, r.rating ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the names of the first 3 movies directed by a person born in 1949?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born = 1949 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 categories have the least number of products supplied by 'Exotic Liquids'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: 'Exotic Liquids'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS category, COUNT(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN category, productCount

question: Which entities benefited from filings where the originator entity is located in China?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.code = "CHN" WITH distinct f MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity) RETURN beneficiary.name

question: List the top 3 highest grossing movies of 2013.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2013 RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 3 entities that are concerned in filings where the amount is above 500000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.amount > 500000 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, COUNT(f) AS filing_count ORDER BY filing_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 users followed by 'neo4j' who have posted a tweet with more than 50 favorites.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WHERE tweet.favorites > 50 RETURN followed.screen_name, tweet.text, tweet.favorites ORDER BY tweet.favorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name 3 persons who have acted in movies with the most distinct titles.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m.title) AS distinctTitles ORDER BY distinctTitles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS PersonName, distinctTitles

question: List the top 5 oldest movies in the database.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 5

question: Find the `supplierID` and `contactName` of suppliers who supply only products with a `unitPrice` lower than 20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p.unitPrice < 20 WITH s, collect(p) AS suppliedProducts WHERE all(product IN suppliedProducts WHERE product.unitPrice < 20) RETURN s.supplierID, s.contactName

question: What is the name of the entity with node_id 10000002?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {node_id: 10000002}) RETURN e.name

question: Which 3 production companies have the most films with an original language of 'en'?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.original_language = 'en' RETURN c.name AS company, count(*) AS num_films ORDER BY num_films DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which three genres have the least number of movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount

question: List the screen names of the top 5 users followed by the most number of other users.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(:User) WITH u, COUNT(*) AS followersCount ORDER BY followersCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.screen_name AS screen_name

question: Which zone has the most networks routed through it?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) WITH z, count(i) AS interfacesCount RETURN z.zone AS Zone, interfacesCount ORDER BY interfacesCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Identify streams with more than 10 VIP relationships.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[r:VIP]->(:User) WITH s, COUNT(r) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 10 RETURN s.name AS streamName, vipCount

question: What is the 'name' of the entity that benefited from the filing with the highest 'amount'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name, f.amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first 5 orders that included products from at least three different categories.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH o, count(DISTINCT c) AS numCategories WHERE numCategories >= 3 RETURN o LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 filings by amount?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) RETURN f.sar_id, f.amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with the highest number of genres associated?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, count(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movie, genreCount

question: Show the first 5 officers with the sourceID 'Panama Papers'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer) WHERE o.sourceID = 'Panama Papers' RETURN o LIMIT 5

question: Find all movies where the lead actor's age at the time of filming is known and list them with the actor's age.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[ai:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) WHERE date(a.born) < date(m.released)  AND date(a.died) > date(m.released) WITH m, a, duration.inDays(a.born, date(m.released)).years AS age RETURN m.title, a.name, age

question: List the first 3 filings made by entities located in countries with the top-level domain '.de'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {tld: 'DE'})<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN f ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: What are the combined total votes of all movies Joel Silver produced?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN sum(m.votes) AS TotalVotes

question: Find the top 5 entities that have the most filings concerning entities in their own country.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH e, c MATCH (e)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(concerned:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name AS EntityName, filingsCount

question: List all movies with more than 2000 votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 2000 RETURN m

question: List the titles of the movies with an IMDb rating below 5.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating < 5 RETURN m.title

question: What is the most common hashtag used in tweets that mention 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WITH t MATCH (t)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WITH h.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC RETURN hashtag, count LIMIT 1

question: Find the top 5 streams with the highest total view count that have a VIP who also is a VIP of a stream with the language "en" and have at least one moderator.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(v1) WHERE (v1)-[:VIP]->(:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(:Language {name: 'en'}) AND EXISTS((s)-[:MODERATOR]->()) WITH s, sum(s.total_view_count) AS total_views ORDER BY total_views DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, total_views

question: What is the total quantity of products ordered by customers in 'France' that are currently in stock?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {country: 'France'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock > 0 WITH sum(rel.quantity) AS totalQuantity RETURN totalQuantity

question: "divorce을 다룬 영화에 대해 소개해줘"
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE k.name = 'divorce' RETURN m.title, m.tagline, m.overview, m.release_date, m.revenue, m.budget, m.runtime, m.popularity, m.vote_count, m.average_vote

question: Find users whose 'screen_name' starts with 'neo'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.screen_name STARTS WITH 'neo' RETURN u.screen_name

question: Which 5 products have the highest units on order and are still active (not discontinued)?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = false AND p.unitsOnOrder IS NOT NULL RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 languages spoken in the videos with a budget greater than 500,000 dollars?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE v.budget > 500000 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(v) AS video_count ORDER BY video_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 collections contain the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection)<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) RETURN c.name AS collection, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 country codes associated with Officers.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer) RETURN DISTINCT o.country_codes LIMIT 3

question: What is the total amount of filings originated by entities located in the same country as "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp." where the beneficiary bank is "Barclays Bank Plc"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."})-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c MATCH (c)<-[:COUNTRY]-(originator:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing {beneficiary_bank: "Barclays Bank Plc"}) WITH sum(f.amount) AS total RETURN total

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention users who follow users followed by Neo4j?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user1:User)<-[:FOLLOWS]->(user2:User) WITH DISTINCT user2 MATCH (user2)<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet) WITH avg(tweet.favorites) AS average_favorites RETURN average_favorites

question: What is the average 'discount' applied to products in each category?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS category, toFloat(rel.discount) AS discount WITH category, avg(discount) AS averageDiscount RETURN category, averageDiscount

question: List the actors who have acted in movies directed by "Graham Annable".
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: "Graham Annable"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actorName

question: What are the names of the directors who have directed movies in more than 3 different genres?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g.name) AS genreCount WHERE genreCount > 3 RETURN d.name AS directorName

question: Identify the streams with more than 3 VIP users.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 3 RETURN s

question: What are the names of games played by streams with more than 1 million total views?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: What is the average runtime of action comedies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Action'}) MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN avg(m.runtime)

question: List the first 3 products in the 'Confections' category with the most units on order.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have the most number of keywords associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[r:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, count(r) AS num_keywords RETURN m.title AS movie, num_keywords ORDER BY num_keywords DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the top 3 collections with the most movies included.
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection)<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) RETURN c.name AS collection, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 products that have been reordered the least times?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:ORDERS]->(o:Order) WITH p, count(o) AS reorderCount ORDER BY reorderCount ASC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.productName, reorderCount

question: How many entities are registered with the service provider 'Mossack Fonseca'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' RETURN count(e)

question: Which movies feature music by a person named 'John Williams' as a crew member?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'John Williams'})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Composer'}]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.release_date AS ReleaseDate

question: What are the first 3 movies where Nancy Meyers was involved as a writer and their release years?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Nancy Meyers'})-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.released AS year ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List all teams associated with streams having more than 50000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE s.followers > 50000 RETURN t

question: Which applications are listening on ports higher than 1024?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) WHERE port.port > 1024 RETURN app.name AS ApplicationName

question: What is the average budget of movies produced in foreign languages?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.id <> 'en' RETURN avg(m.budget)

question: How many genres has each movie been classified under?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, COUNT(g) AS genreCount

question: What are the top 5 most recent movies in the database and their genres?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN m.title AS movie, m.year AS year, collect(g.name) AS genres ORDER BY m.year DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which movies have a runtime that is exactly 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime = 90 RETURN m.title

question: How many movies has Keanu Reeves acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN count(m) AS numberOfMovies

question: List the top 5 streams with the lowest follower count that play the game 'Rust'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the movies that have a runtime longer than 2 hours and a budget greater than 100 million.

question: What are the first 3 highest voted movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.vote_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users have 'Neo4j' mentioned in its tweets the most?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN u.screen_name AS user, COUNT(t) AS mention_count ORDER BY mention_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the 3 users who have given the lowest average ratings.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.userId, u.name, avgRating

question: Which tweets have been retweeted by 'neo4j' and contain a hashtag?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(retweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(original:Tweet) MATCH (original)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag:Hashtag) RETURN original.id_str AS tweet_id, original.text AS tweet_text, collect(hashtag.name) AS hashtags

question: Which intermediaries have the same name as entities?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:same_name_as]->(e:Entity) RETURN i.name AS IntermediaryName, e.name AS EntityName

question: What is the average runtime of movies in the 'Adventure' genre?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) MATCH (g)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH avg(m.runtime) AS averageRuntime RETURN averageRuntime

question: Identify intermediaries that share the same address with other intermediaries.
cypher: MATCH (i1:Intermediary)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(i2:Intermediary) WHERE i1.node_id <> i2.node_id RETURN i1.name AS Intermediary1, i2.name AS Intermediary2, a.address AS SharedAddress

question: Name the top 5 movies with the longest runtime.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 links contained in tweets posted by 'Me'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(link:Link) RETURN link.url ORDER BY tweet.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the keyword 'jealousy'?

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'magic' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: How many movies released before 2005 have "dark" in their review summary?

question: List the movies released in the 2000s with an IMDB rating above 8.0.

question: Name 3 directors who have directed movies with the least number of votes.

question: What is the total quantity of products ordered for the order with `orderID` '10248'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order {orderID: '10248'})- [line:ORDERS]->() WITH sum(line.quantity) AS totalQuantity RETURN totalQuantity

question: List the top 3 most controversial adult films based on their overview.

question: List the `productName` and `supplierID` for the top 3 products with the highest `unitsOnOrder`.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WITH p ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.productName, p.supplierID

question: Which suppliers provide products that are not discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = false RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: List all persons who have produced more than 3 movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS moviesProduced WHERE moviesProduced > 3 RETURN p.name, moviesProduced

question: Who are the first 3 actors in the movie with the tagline 'Speed has no limits'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {tagline: 'Speed has no limits'})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Show all products in stock that are part of the 'Condiments' category.

question: What is the `original_name` of the entity with `internal_id` '1001263'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.internal_id = '1001263' RETURN e.original_name

question: List the top 3 tweets that mention 'Neo4j' and have more than 100 favorites.

question: What are the top 5 products with the lowest unit price in the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice ASC LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE g.name = "Animation" AND m.release_date > date("2010-01-01") RETURN avg(m.budget)

question: What are the names of the top 3 originators of filings?

question: Which movies have a higher average vote than "Toy Story"? (first 3)

question: What are the names of the top 3 originator banks that have initiated the most filings with a beneficiary in 'USA'?

question: Show the top 5 tweets with the most favorites that were posted using 'Buffer'.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source {name: 'Buffer'}) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many filings are associated with the entity 'The Bank of New York Mellon Corp.' as both originator and beneficiary?

question: What are the top 3 tweets by number of retweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, count{(t)<-[:RETWEETS]-(:Tweet)} AS retweets ORDER BY retweets DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the top 5 beneficiary banks in filings that have an amount greater than 200000?

question: What is the `lastEditTimestamp` of the address with `icij_id` 'F969D23B2EDF91CAEBE119A675B61AAB'?
cypher: MATCH (a:Address {icij_id: 'F969D23B2EDF91CAEBE119A675B61AAB'}) RETURN a.lastEditTimestamp

question: What is the average discount applied to orders placed in '1996'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) -[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.orderDate STARTS WITH '1996' WITH o, toFloat(r.discount) * toFloat(r.unitPrice) AS discount_per_product WITH o, sum(discount_per_product) AS total_discount RETURN avg(total_discount) AS average_discount

question: What are the movies that have been produced in 'China'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(:Country {name: 'China'}) RETURN m.title

question: Who wrote and acted in the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie

question: List the top 5 movies that have a runtime longer than 150 minutes and were released before 2010.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 150 AND m.release_date < date('2010-01-01') RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average rating of movies released in the year 2005?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 2005})<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: Which game has the fewest streams playing it, listing the first 3 streams?
cypher: MATCH (g:Game)<-[:PLAYS]-(s:Stream) WITH g, count(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount LIMIT 1 MATCH (g)<-[:PLAYS]-(s:Stream) RETURN g.name AS game, s.name AS stream LIMIT 3

question: Find the supplier who has the most products with a reorder level greater than 15.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p.reorderLevel > 15 WITH s, count(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName, productCount LIMIT 1

question: Which tweets mention 'Neo4j' and were created after '2021-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.name = 'Neo4j' AND t.created_at > datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN t.id_str AS tweet_id, t.text AS tweet_text, t.created_at AS created_at

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most genres associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, COUNT(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, genreCount

question: What are the movies directed by Lana Wachowski?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Lana Wachowski"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which 3 languages are most common in movies with a budget over $30 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.budget > 30000000 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the description of the stream that is VIPed by the user with the most followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) RETURN s.description ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 movies have Tom Hanks in the cast?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

question: What are the most common roles played by actors in movies from the 1990s?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released < 2000 UNWIND r.roles AS role RETURN role, COUNT(role) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which three genres have the lowest average IMDb rating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL WITH g.name AS genre, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating RETURN genre, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating LIMIT 3

question: What is the `categoryName` of the category with the highest average discount applied to its products?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[part_of:PART_OF]->(c:Category)<-[:PART_OF]-(otherProducts:Product), (o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(otherProducts) WITH c, avg(toFloat(orders.unitPrice) * toFloat(orders.discount)) AS averageDiscount ORDER BY averageDiscount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN c.categoryName AS categoryName

question: What are the names of streams with the oldest creation dates and their associated games?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, g ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 1 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, g.name AS game_name

question: List the 'ip' addresses of the first 3 'Interface' nodes connected to the 'Router' named "DC1-RE".
cypher: MATCH (r:Router {name: "DC1-RE"})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) WITH i LIMIT 3 RETURN i.ip

question: List the officers who are officers of entities that have been struck off and have a registered address in the same country as the entity.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.struck_off_date IS NOT NULL MATCH (e)-[:officer_of]-(o:Officer) MATCH (e)-[:registered_address]-(a:Address) WHERE e.countries = a.countries RETURN DISTINCT o.name

question: Which hashtags are used by users who have a high number of 'statuses' and a high 'followers' count?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE u.statuses > 5000 AND u.followers > 10000 RETURN DISTINCT h.name

question: List the top 5 beneficiary banks by the total amount received from filings.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name AS BeneficiaryBank, sum(f.amount) AS TotalAmountReceived ORDER BY TotalAmountReceived DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most extended release dates range within a collection?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WITH c, max(m.release_date) AS maxDate, min(m.release_date) AS minDate ORDER BY maxDate - minDate DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.name AS CollectionName, minDate, maxDate, maxDate - minDate AS DateRange

question: Identify the top 5 types of machines by CPU power available in the system.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN t.name AS typeName, t.cpu AS cpuPower ORDER BY t.cpu DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the users who are moderators of streams with more than 1,000,000 total view count and have a VIP who also plays "Rust".
cypher: MATCH (moderator:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(stream:Stream) WHERE stream.total_view_count > 1000000 MATCH (stream)-[:VIP]->(vip:User)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(game:Game) WHERE game.name = "Rust" RETURN DISTINCT moderator.name

question: Find all games played by streams that have at least one chatter who is also a moderator for a stream with more than 10,000 followers and uses the English language.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(user:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(ms:Stream) WHERE ms.followers > 10000 MATCH (ms)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(lang:Language) WHERE lang.name = 'en' MATCH (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: Which users have the highest 'similarity score' to users who have been retweeted by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(retweetedUser:User) WITH retweetedUser MATCH (retweetedUser)-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similarUser:User) WITH similarUser, MAX(similarUser.score) as maxSimilarityScore  ORDER BY maxSimilarityScore DESC RETURN similarUser.screen_name, maxSimilarityScore

question: List 5 movies that have a runtime longer than 120 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN m.title, m.runtime LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers have a home page listed? Provide names for the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.homePage IS NOT NULL AND s.homePage <> 'NULL' RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 5

question: Which users have a profile picture that is not the default Twitter profile picture?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.profile_image_url IS NOT NULL RETURN u.screen_name

question: What are the top 5 products with the highest reorder levels in the 'Meat/Poultry' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Meat/Poultry'}) RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel ORDER BY p.reorderLevel DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all movies released between 1990 and 2000 that have more than 100 votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 AND m.votes > 100 RETURN m

question: List the first 3 tweets posted by 'Neo4j' using the source 'Buffer'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source {name: 'Buffer'}) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which Intermediaries are connected to Entities through the "intermediary_of" relationship?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT i.name

question: Which racks contain machines running application named 'logstash'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(a:Application {name: 'logstash'}) RETURN r.name AS RackName

question: Find the top 5 users who have retweeted tweets made by 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(rt:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(retweeter:User) RETURN retweeter, count(rt) AS retweets ORDER BY retweets DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 movies were produced by Pixar Animation Studios?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'}) RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

question: How many filings have a beneficiary bank in 'United Kingdom'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN count(f) AS NumberOfFilings

question: Which entity has the most recent lastEditTimestamp?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.name, toInteger(e.lastEditTimestamp) AS lastEditTimestamp ORDER BY lastEditTimestamp DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which filings have the longest duration from begin to end date?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin IS NOT NULL AND f.end IS NOT NULL RETURN f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS Duration ORDER BY Duration DESC

question: Find the top 5 customers who have ordered the same product multiple times.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c, p, COUNT(o) AS orderCount WHERE orderCount > 1 RETURN c.companyName AS customer, COUNT(DISTINCT p.productID) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List 5 movies that have a poster path containing '/rh'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path CONTAINS '/rh' RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

question: What is the categoryName of the category that the product with productName equal to 'Chang' belongs to?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Chang'})-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) RETURN c.categoryName

question: Who are the top 5 users with the highest betweenness?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 entities by incorporation date?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date IS NOT NULL RETURN e ORDER BY e.incorporation_date LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 actors to have starred in at least 3 movies from the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'}) WITH p, count(m) AS num_movies WHERE num_movies >= 3 RETURN p.name ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 orders have the highest number of distinct products ordered?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, COUNT(DISTINCT p.productID) AS distinctProductCount ORDER BY distinctProductCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN o.orderID, distinctProductCount

question: Which actor has acted in the most movies with a budget greater than 250 million?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 250000000 WITH a, count(m) AS movieCount RETURN a.name, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 languages based on the number of movies originally in that language.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH l.name AS language, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN language, movie_count

question: List all the sources used by 'neo4j' for tweeting.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:USING]->(source:Source) RETURN DISTINCT source.name

question: Which 3 categories have the most products with a reorder level above 15?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.reorderLevel > 15 WITH c.categoryName AS category, COUNT(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN category, productCount

question: What are the first 5 adult films that have a runtime over 100 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.runtime > 100 RETURN a.title, a.runtime ORDER BY a.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 products with units in stock less than 10.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsInStock < 10 RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Find all suppliers that are from the 'UK' and supply products to more than one category.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE s.country = 'UK' WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT c.categoryID) AS categoryCount WHERE categoryCount > 1 RETURN s.companyName AS SupplierName, categoryCount

question: Which 3 actors have played roles in both acting and directing for the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r1:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[r2:DIRECTED]-(a) RETURN a.name, collect(m.title) AS movies, count(m) AS numberOfMovies ORDER BY numberOfMovies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 countries where the entities have filed the least number of filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount ASC LIMIT 5 MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS CountryName, filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount ASC

question: What is the average amount of filings where the originator entity is located in 'SGP'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.country = 'SGP' RETURN avg(f.amount)

question: What are the first 5 movies in the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'}) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 5

question: Which entities have benefited from filings where the originator bank is located in a country with a location point having a longitude greater than 0?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(ob:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(oc:Country) WHERE oc.location.longitude > 0 WITH f MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(be:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT be.name

question: Find the `customerID` and total number of distinct products they ordered.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c.customerID AS customerID, COLLECT(DISTINCT p.productID) AS distinctProducts RETURN customerID, size(distinctProducts) AS totalDistinctProducts ORDER BY totalDistinctProducts DESC

question: What are the top 5 teams by number of associated streams with over 10,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) WHERE s.followers > 10000 WITH t, count(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN t.name, streamCount

question: List the 3 movies with the lowest average ratings in the REVIEWED relationship.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH m, AVG(r.rating) AS avgRating RETURN m.title, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 teams were created most recently and have at least one stream associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) WITH t, MAX(s.createdAt) AS latestStreamDate WHERE latestStreamDate IS NOT NULL RETURN t.name, t.createdAt ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers do not have a homePage listed?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.homePage = 'NULL' RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName

question: Name 3 movies that have been reviewed with a summary containing 'romp'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'romp' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 movies by the number of roles available in the ACTED_IN relationship?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, count(r.roles) AS total_roles ORDER BY total_roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the `name`s of the entities that have filed (`FILED`) more than 3 times?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingCount WHERE filingCount > 3 RETURN e.name

question: Which three users have rated the most diverse set of movies in terms of genres?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH u, COUNT(DISTINCT g.name) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName, genreCount

question: What is the valid_until date for the entity with node_id 10000001?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {node_id: 10000001}) RETURN e.valid_until

question: What are the top 5 suppliers based on the number of different cities they have shipped to?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) WITH s, o.shipCity AS city WHERE city IS NOT NULL WITH s, COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS cityCount RETURN s.companyName AS supplier, cityCount ORDER BY cityCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 directors have directed at least 5 movies with an IMDb rating above 7.0?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 7.0 WITH d, count(m) AS moviesDirected WHERE moviesDirected >= 5 RETURN d.name, moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of total_view_count for streams with the language "en"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_views RETURN average_views

question: List the first 3 adult films with a specific tagline, e.g., 'Trust Will Get You Killed'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.tagline = 'Trust Will Get You Killed' RETURN a.title LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 5 movies that have a main character named 'Charlie Wilson'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.character = 'Charlie Wilson' RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle ORDER BY r.order LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 tweets that retweet content from Neo4j.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(originalTweet:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(retweet:Tweet) RETURN retweet.text AS retweetText, retweet.created_at AS retweetDate, retweet.favorites AS retweetFavorites ORDER BY retweet.favorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 packages that provide access to the genre 'Animation'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre {name: 'Animation'}) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies that were released in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE 'USA' IN m.countries RETURN m ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Which supplier supplies the product with the highest quantity per unit?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName,  toInteger(split(p.quantityPerUnit, " ")[0])  as quantity ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 1

question: "who are the directors that the actors in their films also appear in the film Jumanji"
cypher: MATCH (:Movie {title: "Jumanji"})<-[:CAST_FOR]-(actor:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(movie:Movie)<-[:CREW_FOR {job: "Director"}]-(director:Person) RETURN DISTINCT director.name

question: What are the 5 most recent movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 AND m.released IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies where someone named 'Carrie-Anne Moss' acted.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Carrie-Anne Moss'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 tweets that 'Neo4j' has mentioned and were created after January 2021.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(user:User) WHERE tweet.created_at > datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN tweet.id_str AS tweet_id, tweet.text AS tweet_text, tweet.created_at AS created_at ORDER BY tweet.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 entities with a 'service_provider'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider IS NOT NULL WITH e, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC RETURN e.name, count LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users have moderated the most streams and users combined?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:MODERATOR]->(s) WITH u, count(r) AS moderation_count ORDER BY moderation_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, moderation_count

question: What are the first 5 movies to have a poster URL containing 'face'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster CONTAINS 'face' RETURN m.title LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers supply products with a unitPrice greater than 20?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p.unitPrice > 20 RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: What are the top 5 movies directed by directors born in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn = "USA" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS Rating ORDER BY Rating DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the movies with taglines that start with 'Everything'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline STARTS WITH 'Everything' RETURN m.title, m.tagline, m.released

question: Which tweets by 'neo4j' have the highest number of favorites?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) RETURN tweet.text, tweet.favorites ORDER BY tweet.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies that have been directed by directors born in Nebraska?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE d.bornIn CONTAINS "Nebraska" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS IMDBRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all movies that have been reviewed by more than one person.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH m, count(DISTINCT r) AS reviewCount WHERE reviewCount > 1 RETURN m.title

question: Find the entities that have been incorporated on '23-MAR-2006'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date = '23-MAR-2006' RETURN e.name, e.countries, e.service_provider, e.status, e.jurisdiction_description

question: List the top 3 entities based on the number of filings they originated with an amount over 2,000,000.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 2000000 WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: Who are the first 3 actors with roles in both movies and adult films?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:CAST_FOR]->(a:Adult) WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount, COUNT(DISTINCT a) AS adultCount WHERE movieCount > 0 AND adultCount > 0 RETURN p.name AS actorName ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the three most common teams that streams belong to?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name, count(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the `customerID` and `companyName` of customers who have placed orders that were shipped to the same city they are located in.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.city = o.shipCity RETURN c.customerID, c.companyName

question: List the names of the first 3 genres that have the most movies associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genreName

question: What is the `productName` of the product with the highest `unitsOnOrder` that is supplied by a supplier from 'UK'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.country = 'UK' MATCH (s)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH max(p.unitsOnOrder) AS maxUnitsOnOrder MATCH (p1:Product) WHERE p1.unitsOnOrder = maxUnitsOnOrder RETURN p1.productName

question: Find the `customerID` and `contactName` of customers who have placed orders that were shipped to a different country than the one they are located in.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.country <> o.shipCountry RETURN c.customerID, c.contactName

question: What are the names of the top 3 routers in DataCenter 'DC1'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Router) RETURN r.name ORDER BY r.name LIMIT 3

question: List all genres that have been accessed by the 'Ultimate' package.
cypher: MATCH (p:Package {name: 'Ultimate'})-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS genre_name

question: Identify the top 3 processes by PID that depend on the 'java' service.
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(s:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN p.name, p.pid ORDER BY p.pid DESC LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the top 5 tweets with the most favorites.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 users who mostly tweet about 'education'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) RETURN u.name AS UserName, count(t) AS TweetCount ORDER BY TweetCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have been both highly rated and have high revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count > 1000 AND m.revenue > 1.0E8 RETURN m.title, m.average_vote, m.revenue ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC, m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the top 5 tweets that 'Me' has replied to.

question: Which people have reviewed the movie with the highest votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (p:Person)-[:REVIEWED]->(m) RETURN p.name

question: "What is the highest reviewed movie?"
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS Movie, m.released AS Released, MAX(r.rating) AS HighestRating ORDER BY HighestRating DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the types of companies found in the 'Other' node category.
cypher: MATCH (o:Other) RETURN DISTINCT o.type AS company_types

question: Which customer (`customerID`) has an order with the highest `freight` cost?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH max(toFloat(o.freight)) AS maxFreight MATCH (o:Order) WHERE toFloat(o.freight) = maxFreight MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o) RETURN c.customerID

question: What is the name of the video with the highest average vote?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WITH v ORDER BY v.average_vote DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN v.title

question: Name the top 5 movies with the most keywords associated.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, COUNT(k) AS keyword_count ORDER BY keyword_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, keyword_count

question: Which 3 suppliers supply products with a unit price less than $10?

question: Which suppliers provide products to more than one region?

question: Which entities have a note stating 'Closed date stands for Cancelled date.'?

cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webserver'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency) RETURN dependency LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.screen_name, u.followers ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 filings have the most significant difference in latitude between originator and beneficiary banks?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f,       toFloat(f.origin_lat) AS origin_lat,       toFloat(f.beneficiary_lat) AS beneficiary_lat,       abs(toFloat(f.origin_lat) - toFloat(f.beneficiary_lat)) AS lat_diff ORDER BY lat_diff DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, f.originator_bank AS originator_bank, f.beneficiary_bank AS beneficiary_bank, lat_diff

question: Which sources are used in the top 5 most favorited tweets?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source) RETURN s.name AS SourceName, t.favorites AS Favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the 3 oldest movies produced by someone born after 1960?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WITH s, (toFloat(s.followers) / s.total_view_count) AS ratio RETURN s.name, s.url, ratio ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average length of movie titles released after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 WITH size(m.title) AS title_length RETURN avg(title_length) AS average_length

question: Show all products with a 'unitPrice' above 20 and a 'reorderLevel' below 5.
