question: What is the total number of filings where the 'originator_bank' is the same as the 'beneficiary_bank'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = f.beneficiary_bank WITH count(f) AS filingCount RETURN filingCount

question: What are the top 5 movies with a release date on or after '2000-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the first 3 actors in the cast list of 'Toy Story'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})<-[:CAST_FOR]-(p:Person) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 genres associated with the highest average movie budget.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, avg(m.budget) AS avg_budget ORDER BY avg_budget DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre, avg_budget

question: List the top 3 originator banks that have initiated filings with beneficiary banks located in Singapore.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "Singapore"}) RETURN f.originator_bank AS OriginatorBank, COUNT(f) AS NumberOfFilings ORDER BY NumberOfFilings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the first 3 filings with a beneficiary bank country of 'Singapore' and an amount greater than 200000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.amount > 200000 RETURN f ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 keywords associated with movies that have a poster path ending in '.jpg'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.poster_path ENDS WITH '.jpg' RETURN DISTINCT k.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of the first 3 Types with a RAM size less than 64?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.ram < 64 RETURN t.name ORDER BY t.ram LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 switches that route through interfaces with an IP starting with '10.3'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Switch)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) WHERE i.ip STARTS WITH '10.3' RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 applications that depend on the service 'java'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(service:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN app.name ORDER BY app.startTime LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 products have the highest units on order and are not discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = false RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movie has the most genres associated with it?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(genres) WITH m, count(genres) AS genreCount RETURN m.title, genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 products have been reordered the most times?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 movies with the lowest IMDb votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbVotes IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbVotes ASC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 youngest producers in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 most recent movies in the 'Toy Story Collection'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'}) RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users with the highest betweenness have tweeted about 'education'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE h.name = 'education' RETURN u.screen_name, u.betweenness ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 adult films with a budget under $10,000.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.budget < 10000 RETURN a ORDER BY a.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies with the highest IMDb rating.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 orders include the most number of products?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, COUNT(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN o.orderID, productCount

question: Show the first 3 types of machines by RAM size in descending order.
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) RETURN t.name, t.ram ORDER BY t.ram DESC LIMIT 3

question: "What is the distribution of entity jurisdictions?"
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.jurisdiction AS Jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS NumberOfEntities ORDER BY NumberOfEntities DESC

question: Identify the first 3 streams that have chatters who are streams created before 2017.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(c:Stream) WHERE c.createdAt < datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.createdAt AS stream_createdAt ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 streams that have chatters with a total view count over 10,000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WHERE u.total_view_count > 10000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.total_view_count AS stream_views ORDER BY s.total_view_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which adult films have been released with the status 'In Production'?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.status = 'In Production' RETURN a.title AS Title, a.release_date AS ReleaseDate, a.status AS Status

question: Which 3 filings have the longest duration from beginning to end date and involve an originator bank from 'USA'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {code: 'USA'}) WITH f, duration.inDays(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS SAR_ID, f.begin AS BeginDate, f.end AS EndDate, duration

question: List the movies where the actors were born before 1950.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS ActorName

question: List the first 5 Intermediaries that are intermediaries of the same Entity.
cypher: MATCH (i1:Intermediary)-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity)<-[:intermediary_of]-(i2:Intermediary) WHERE id(i1) < id(i2) RETURN i1.name, i2.name LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 languages in which movies are made based on the 'languages' property of movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) UNWIND m.languages AS language WITH language, COUNT(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN language, count

question: What are the top 3 movies with the highest imdbRating that were released in 1995?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released STARTS WITH '1995' AND exists((m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre)) RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many movies has Keanu Reeves acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN count(m) AS NumberOfMovies

question: What are the top 3 most common games played by streams created before 2010?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.createdAt < datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN g.name, count(s) AS streams_count ORDER BY streams_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 producers of movies with a tagline including 'Speed'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Speed' RETURN p.name AS producer, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest revenue and featuring a predominantly black cast?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which director has the highest average gross profit per movie?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, m.revenue - m.budget AS profit WITH d, avg(profit) AS averageProfit ORDER BY averageProfit DESC RETURN d.name AS director, averageProfit LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 followers of 'Neo4j' based on betweenness centrality?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(m:Me {name: 'Neo4j'}) RETURN u.name, u.betweenness ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies with the largest budgets released before 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.year < 2000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the first 3 streams that have a language set to 'ru' and a moderator with a follower count above 5000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(:Language {name: 'ru'}) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(m:User) WHERE m.followers > 5000 RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 products with a unit price between 10 and 20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice >= 10 AND p.unitPrice <= 20 RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have more than 5000 votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.votes > 5000 RETURN m.title

question: Which are the first 5 streams that have more than one language associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH s, COUNT(l) AS languageCount WHERE languageCount > 1 RETURN s.name, s.id, s.createdAt ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 5

question: List all machines that run processes with a PID less than 500.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) WHERE p.pid < 500 RETURN m.name

question: What are the top 3 countries producing the most adult films with a runtime over 60 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE a.runtime > 60 RETURN c.name AS country, count(*) AS adultFilmCount ORDER BY adultFilmCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the entities that filed filings as originators where the beneficiary entity is located in the same country and the amount is greater than 100000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(oe:Entity) MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(be:Entity) MATCH (oe:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) MATCH (be:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.amount > 100000 RETURN DISTINCT oe.name

question: What are the first 3 languages spoken in movies with a budget over $50 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN l.name AS language ORDER BY language LIMIT 3

question: What is the average total view count for streams that have at least 3 moderators and 2 VIPs and use the English language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'en'}) WHERE size([(s)-[:MODERATOR]->() | s]) >= 3 AND size([(s)-[:VIP]->() | s]) >= 2 WITH avg(s.total_view_count) AS average_view_count RETURN average_view_count

question: Who are the first 3 actors who have starred in both comedies and dramas?
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(comedy:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(comedyGenre:Genre {name: "Comedy"}),       (actor)-[:CAST_FOR]->(drama:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(dramaGenre:Genre {name: "Drama"}) RETURN DISTINCT actor.name LIMIT 3

question: Find all actors who have appeared in more than 10 movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 10 RETURN p.name AS actorName, movieCount

question: List the first 5 Officers who are officers of Entities registered in the same country as the entity with the name "TIANSHENG INDUSTRY AND TRADING CO., LTD.".
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity { name: "TIANSHENG INDUSTRY AND TRADING CO., LTD." }) WITH e.country_codes AS target_country_code MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e1:Entity { country_codes: target_country_code }) RETURN o.node_id, o.name LIMIT 5

question: Name the Racks in Zone 1 that hold more than 3 Machines.
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone {zone: 1})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface)-[:CONNECTS]->(i2:Interface)<-[:ROUTES]-(r:Rack) WHERE count{(r)-[:HOLDS]->(:Machine)} > 3 RETURN r.name

question: List 5 genres that have the least number of movies associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount ASC LIMIT 5 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount

question: What are the names of the first 3 products with a quantity per unit of '48 - 6 oz jars'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.quantityPerUnit = '48 - 6 oz jars' RETURN p.productName ORDER BY p.productName LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 highest-grossing movies of 2006.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2006 AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title AS movie, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have the tagline 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline = 'Roll the dice and unleash the excitement!' RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.id LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(reviewer:Person) WITH p, m, max(r.rating) AS maxRating ORDER BY maxRating DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS producer, m.title AS movie, maxRating AS rating

question: Provide the names of officers who act as shareholder of entities incorporated on '19-NOV-1999'.

question: List the creation dates of all users who are chatters of the stream "maximilian_dood".
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {name: "maximilian_dood"})-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) RETURN u.createdAt

question: What are the names of the top 5 users interacting most frequently with others?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]->(other) RETURN u.name AS name, count(i) AS interactions  ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the names of the people who wrote and also acted in the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person

question: What are the top 5 oldest movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date ASC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 actors are born on or before 1900 and have acted in at least one movie?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE a.born <= date('1900-01-01') AND exists{ (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN a.name, a.born LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the first 3 filings where the beneficiary bank country is 'United Kingdom' and the beneficiary iso is 'GBR'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' AND f.beneficiary_iso = 'GBR' RETURN f LIMIT 3

question: What is the average amount of filings filed by entities with the name 'The Bank of New York Mellon Corp.'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: 'The Bank of New York Mellon Corp.'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: Which users have been mentioned in tweets that also mention "Neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) MATCH (neo4j)<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(otherUser:User) RETURN DISTINCT otherUser

question: What is the link value for the relationship connecting an Other node to an Officer with the same name?
cypher: MATCH (o:Other)-[r:same_name_as]->(of:Officer) WHERE o.name = of.name RETURN r.link

question: Which 3 actors have the most roles in comedy movies?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN a.name AS actor, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find all movies that have a higher revenue than their budget.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > m.budget RETURN m.title

question: List all the languages spoken in the movie 'Jumanji'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Jumanji'})-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS SpokenLanguages

question: Which are the three entities with filings originating from banks in 'Singapore' and concerned with banks in 'United Kingdom'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity),       (f)-[:CONCERNS]->(concerned:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN originator, concerned LIMIT 3

question: Which entities have a 'former_name' property that is not empty and have an 'intermediary_of' relationship with an intermediary?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.former_name IS NOT NULL AND e.former_name <> '' MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:intermediary_of]->(e) RETURN e.name

question: Show the first 3 people who have reviewed more than one movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(r) AS reviewCount WHERE reviewCount > 1 RETURN p.name AS reviewerName, reviewCount ORDER BY reviewerName LIMIT 3

question: Name genres in which Harold Lloyd has directed movies.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: "Harold Lloyd"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS Genre

question: What are the names of the entities that benefited from filings filed between 2015-03-25T00:00:00Z and 2015-09-25T00:00:00Z?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin_date_format = "2015-03-25T00:00:00Z" AND f.end_date_format = "2015-09-25T00:00:00Z" MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name

question: What is the name of the category with categoryID '1'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category { categoryID: '1' }) RETURN c.categoryName

question: What are the top 5 filings by amount that involve 'The Bank of New York Mellon Corp.' as the filer?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List top 3 entities with the incorporation date '27-MAR-2006'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date = '27-MAR-2006' RETURN e.name, e.incorporation_date ORDER BY e.name LIMIT 3

question: Find the users who are chatters of streams that have a total view count greater than 1,000,000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Show the first 3 products with the lowest units in stock in the 'Confections' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock ORDER BY p.unitsInStock ASC LIMIT 3

question: Show the first 5 originator entities by the total number of transactions they initiated.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS transactions ORDER BY transactions DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e, transactions

question: List the names of entities where 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.' is an officer.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {name: 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.'}) MATCH (o)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name

question: List the first 3 suppliers who supply products in the 'Dairy Products' category.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 newest games introduced to streams.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN g.name, MAX(s.createdAt) AS latestStreamDate ORDER BY latestStreamDate DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which products are discontinued and have less than 10 units in stock?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = true AND p.unitsInStock < 10 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock

question: What are the first 5 routers located in zone 2?
cypher: MATCH (r:Router) WHERE r.zone = 2 RETURN r.name LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 production companies have produced films with a runtime longer than 180 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 RETURN c.name AS company, count(*) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 3 movies with the most number of genres associated.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, COUNT(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, genreCount

question: What are the top 3 beneficiary entities in transactions from Asia?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank_country IN ["Singapore", "China", "Japan", "South Korea", "India", "Indonesia", "Malaysia", "Philippines", "Thailand", "Vietnam"] RETURN e.name AS BeneficiaryEntity, COUNT(f) AS TransactionCount ORDER BY TransactionCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 countries by the number of entities they host.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(e) AS entity_count ORDER BY entity_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, entity_count

question: What is the average runtime of movies released in the 1990s?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE 1990 <= m.year <= 1999 RETURN avg(m.runtime) AS average_runtime

question: List the 5 most recent movies that have been added to the 'Toy Story Collection'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'}) RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 5 streams that have a team and a game that both have the letter 'E' in them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team), (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE t.name CONTAINS 'E' AND g.name CONTAINS 'E' RETURN s.name AS stream_name, t.name AS team_name, g.name AS game_name LIMIT 5

question: List all customers from 'Berlin' who have ordered more than three times.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE c.city = 'Berlin' WITH c, count(o) as orderCount WHERE orderCount > 3 RETURN c.companyName, c.contactName, c.contactTitle, c.phone, c.address, c.postalCode, c.country

question: Which movies have been acted in by persons born before 1900?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < date('1900-01-01') RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS actor, p.born AS birthDate

question: Which genres have the highest average movie budget?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, avg(m.budget) AS averageBudget RETURN g.name AS genre, averageBudget ORDER BY averageBudget DESC

question: "Which actors played in the most movies?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, count(m) as movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the first 5 actors who acted in movies released in the year 2014.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {year: 2014}) RETURN a.name AS actor, m.title AS movie LIMIT 5

question: What is the address linked to the 'registered_address' relationship for entity node_id 10000002?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {node_id: 10000002})-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) RETURN a.address AS Address

question: Which applications listen on port 80?
cypher: MATCH (p:Port {port: 80})<-[:LISTENS]-(a:Application) RETURN a.name

question: Which 3 users gave the highest ratings to the movie titled 'Toy Story'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) RETURN u.name AS user, r.rating AS rating ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of users who have rated each movie?
cypher: MATCH (user:User)-[:RATED]->(movie:Movie) WITH movie, count(user) AS userCount RETURN movie.title, userCount

question: Which movies have been directed by directors who have also acted in movies?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (d)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS MovieTitle

question: List the top 5 people who have produced the most number of movies with their birth years.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS producer, p.born AS birthYear, count(m) AS numberOfMovies ORDER BY numberOfMovies DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 5 production companies by the number of genres they produce movies in?
cypher: MATCH (pc:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH pc, count(DISTINCT g) AS genres_count RETURN pc.name, genres_count ORDER BY genres_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 ports that the process with PID 8966 listens to?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process {pid: 8966})-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN port.port ORDER BY port.port LIMIT 3

question: Identify streams where the same user is both a chatter and a moderator.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream), (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) RETURN s.name AS streamName, u.name AS userName

question: Provide the list of entities that have a connection to 'Top Games Holdings Inc.'
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: 'Top Games Holdings Inc.'})-[:connected_to]->(connectedEntities:Entity) RETURN connectedEntities

question: Which officers have a valid until date through 2015?

question: List the top 3 addresses that have a 'valid_until' date.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address) WHERE a.valid_until IS NOT NULL WITH a, count(*) AS count RETURN a.address, count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the 3 persons who have appeared in the most REVIEWED movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-() WITH p, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS reviewedMoviesCount ORDER BY reviewedMoviesCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS personName, reviewedMoviesCount

question: Which person has the most followers?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p, count{(p)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(:Person)} AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the top 5 adult films with a poster path containing '/tzVK7nTnzUiVeFSZhOAIHmrgXUS.jpg'.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.poster_path = '/tzVK7nTnzUiVeFSZhOAIHmrgXUS.jpg' RETURN a.title, a.poster_path, a.average_vote ORDER BY a.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 suppliers supply the most products with a unit price over $20?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice > 20 WITH s, count(p) AS products_count ORDER BY products_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName, products_count

question: What are the top 3 movies by average vote in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average unit price of products supplied by suppliers who do not have a fax number listed?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.fax IS NULL RETURN avg(p.unitPrice)

question: List the top 3 countries by the number of entities registered there.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(e) AS NumberOfEntities ORDER BY NumberOfEntities DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which tweets have been retweeted by 'neo4j' and contain a hashtag?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(retweetedTweet:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(:Hashtag) RETURN retweetedTweet

question: List the first 5 streams that have a team and a game that both have the letter 'E' in them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team), (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE t.name CONTAINS 'E' AND g.name CONTAINS 'E' RETURN s.name AS stream, t.name AS team, g.name AS game LIMIT 5

question: What is the name of the type of machine that has a RAM size of 1024?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type) WHERE t.ram = 1024 RETURN t.name AS machine_type_name

question: Show the top 5 filings with the most entities involved as originators from the same country.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH f, c, count(e) AS numEntities ORDER BY numEntities DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f, c.name AS Country, numEntities

question: List the three entities with the most filings during 2015.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime("2015-01-01T00:00:00Z") AND f.end <= datetime("2015-12-31T23:59:59Z") WITH e, count(f) AS filing_count ORDER BY filing_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, filing_count

question: What are the first 3 countries with the most movies produced in the genre 'Drama'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN c.name AS country, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have the most followers but fewer than 1 million total views?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL AND s.total_view_count < 1000000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC

question: List the first 3 actors who have acted in movies with a revenue of over 500 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 RETURN a.name AS actorName, m.title AS movieTitle, m.revenue AS movieRevenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top five movies that were directed by someone born before 1960 and have a vote count less than 100?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1960 AND m.votes < 100 RETURN m ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the dependencies for the process named '8966'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process {name: '8966'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(s:Service) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(proc:Process) RETURN p.name AS ProcessName, collect(s.name) AS DependentServices, collect(proc.name) AS DependentProcesses

question: Find the top 5 filings where the originator bank's country is 'Angola' and the amount is over 100,000 USD.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'Angola'}) WHERE f.amount > 100000 RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Can you list entities that have a note mentioning 'Closed date stands for Liquidation date.'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Other) WHERE e.note = 'Closed date stands for Liquidation date.' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.note AS note

question: What is the total 'amount' of filings filed by entities located in countries with 'tld' equal to 'US'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {tld: 'US'}) WITH c MATCH (c)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity) WITH e MATCH (e)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount

question: What are the 5 most recent movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which entities have a node_id less than 80000012 and their names?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.node_id < 80000012 RETURN e.node_id, e.name

question: Show the first 3 adult films that are spoken in Italian.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'Italian'}) RETURN a LIMIT 3

question: What is the average latitude (`origin_lat`) of filings originating from the country with `code` "DEU"?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {code: "DEU"})<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN avg(toFloat(f.origin_lat)) AS average_latitude

question: What are the names of the first 3 people who have produced, directed, and written the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p)-[:WROTE]->(m) RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: List all movies that have been acted in by an actor who has also directed a movie.
cypher: MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) MATCH (actor)-[:DIRECTED]->(directedMovie:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT movie.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which 3 people have acted in the most number of videos?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(v:Video) WITH p, COUNT(v) AS videoCount ORDER BY videoCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS personName, videoCount

question: Identify the first 3 streams that have moderators with a follower count over 1000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE s.followers > 1000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 countries by the number of adult films produced?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(a:Adult) RETURN c.name AS country, count(a) AS adultFilmCount ORDER BY adultFilmCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify entities with a country code of 'HKG' and provide their incorporation dates.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.country_codes = 'HKG' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.incorporation_date AS incorporation_date

question: What are the first 3 `incorporation_date`s of entities with `country_codes` 'HKG'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.country_codes = 'HKG' WITH e.incorporation_date AS incorporation_date, e ORDER BY incorporation_date RETURN DISTINCT incorporation_date LIMIT 3

question: Which entities have been closed on '28-NOV-2012'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.closed_date = '28-NOV-2012' RETURN e

question: Find all actors who have appeared in more than 10 movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 10 RETURN p, movieCount

question: What is the average `unitPrice` of products in the 'Seafood' category?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Seafood'})-[:PART_OF]->(p:Product) WITH avg(p.unitPrice) AS averagePrice RETURN averagePrice

question: Which movies have been acted in and directed by the same person?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS person

question: What are the common movies acted in by people who were born in the same decade?
cypher: MATCH (p1:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p2:Person) WHERE p1.born >= 1920 AND p1.born < 2000 AND p2.born >= 1920 AND p2.born < 2000 AND toInteger(p1.born / 10) = toInteger(p2.born / 10) RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS CommonMovie, toInteger(p1.born / 10) * 10 AS Decade ORDER BY Decade, CommonMovie

question: Which Machines are running OS named 'RHEL' in DataCenter 'DC1'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(os:OS {name: 'RHEL'}) RETURN m

question: What is the number of filings for each distinct 'end_date', sorted in descending order?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f.end_date AS end_date, count(f) AS filing_count RETURN end_date, filing_count ORDER BY filing_count DESC

question: Which 3 movies have been produced by 'Pixar Animation Studios' and have a runtime under 100 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'}) WHERE m.runtime < 100 RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: "Who played in Top Gun?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: "Top Gun"}) RETURN p.name

question: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m, m.revenue AS movie_revenue ORDER BY movie_revenue DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title, movie_revenue

question: What is the total revenue of movies directed by directors born in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: "USA"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue RETURN totalRevenue

question: Find the streams that have VIPs who are also moderators of different streams.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s2:Stream) WHERE s <> s2 RETURN DISTINCT s.name

question: What is the average IMDB rating of movies directed by female directors?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE toLower(d.bio) CONTAINS 'female' WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: List the "tax_stat_description" values of Entities that are linked to an Intermediary with a "status" of "INACTIVE" and have an "officer_of" relationship with an Officer located in Hong Kong.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {status: 'INACTIVE'})-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) MATCH (e)<-[:officer_of]-(o:Officer) WHERE o.countries = 'Hong Kong' RETURN DISTINCT e.tax_stat_description

question: List the first 5 beneficiary bank names for filings between 2013-01-01T00:00:00Z and 2013-12-31T00:00:00Z.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2013-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.begin <= datetime('2013-12-31T00:00:00Z') RETURN f.beneficiary_bank LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 most reviewed movies by the number of reviews.
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(r) AS reviewCount ORDER BY reviewCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, reviewCount

question: List the names of all directors who have directed a movie with an IMDB rating above 8.0.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.0 MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT d.name

question: List the top 3 filings with originator banks in 'Singapore' and amounts exceeding 1500000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.amount > 1500000 RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest budget that was a box office flop?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue < m.budget WITH m ORDER BY m.budget DESC RETURN m.title LIMIT 1

question: List all persons who have reviewed a movie with a rating less than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN p.name

question: What are the 'ip' addresses of the top 3 'Interface' nodes with the highest 'ip' address values?
cypher: MATCH (i:Interface) RETURN i.ip AS ip ORDER BY ip DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 actors by number of roles in videos with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(v:Video {status: 'Released'}) RETURN p.name AS actor, count(*) AS num_roles ORDER BY num_roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which directors have directed a movie that has been rated below 3.0?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WHERE r.rating < 3.0 RETURN DISTINCT d.name AS director, m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: List the first 3 links contained in tweets posted by 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) RETURN l.url LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 adult films with the highest popularity.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) RETURN a.title, a.popularity ORDER BY a.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the top five oldest directors of movies released after 1990.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 1990 RETURN p.name AS Director, p.born AS BirthYear ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 5

question: Which users follow 'Neo4j' and are from 'Graphs Are Everywhere'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(m:Me {name: 'Neo4j', location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'}) RETURN u

question: Which 3 streams have the most users as chatters?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) RETURN s.name AS stream, count(u) AS chatter_count ORDER BY chatter_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the names of the top 5 users who have the highest scores of being similar to 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m:Me {name: 'Neo4j'}) RETURN u.name AS UserName, s.score AS SimilarityScore ORDER BY s.score DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 countries where movies with a revenue greater than 100 million dollars were produced.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN c.name ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 3

question: Show the first 3 racks in zone 4 of DataCenter 'DC1'.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Rack {zone: 4}) RETURN r.name LIMIT 3

question: Which three users have rated the most diverse set of movies in terms of genres?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH u, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, genreCount AS distinctGenresRated

question: What is the average rating for movies released in 2003?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {released: 2003})<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH avg(r.rating) AS average_rating RETURN average_rating

question: Which zones have a size of 16?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone) WHERE z.size = 16 RETURN z

question: What are the creation dates of the top 3 most followed streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WITH s ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.createdAt

question: What are the roles played by actors in 'Speed Racer'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name, r.roles

question: Which actors have starred in movies with both Tom Hanks and Tim Allen?
cypher: MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie1:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(actor:Actor) MATCH (tim:Person {name: "Tim Allen"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie2:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(actor) WHERE movie1 = movie2 RETURN DISTINCT actor.name

question: List the first 5 products that have been ordered by customers in 'Berlin'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {city: 'Berlin'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName LIMIT 5

question: List all racks contained within the 'DC1' DataCenter.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack) RETURN rack.name

question: What are the top 5 tweets that link to URLs starting with 'https://' and were posted by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) WHERE l.url STARTS WITH 'https://' RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 streams that are part of a team with the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) WITH t, count(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (t)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(topStream:Stream) RETURN topStream LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 machines in DataCenter 'DC1' are of type 'm-4/16/25'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type {name: 'm-4/16/25'}) RETURN m.name LIMIT 3

question: List the product names of products ordered by every customer.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN DISTINCT c.companyName AS customerName, COLLECT(p.productName) AS productsOrdered

question: What is the total quantity of products ordered for each distinct category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(category:Category) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[o:ORDERS]-(:Order) WITH category.categoryName AS categoryName, SUM(toInteger(o.quantity)) AS totalQuantityOrdered RETURN categoryName, totalQuantityOrdered

question: List the top 3 processes that listen on port 80.
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port {port: 80}) RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies by revenue released in 1995?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 1995 RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which categories contain more than 5 products?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, count(p) AS productCount WHERE productCount > 5 RETURN c.categoryName, productCount

question: Which 3 users have rated the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN u.id, count(r) AS ratings_count ORDER BY ratings_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of unique games played by all streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN count(DISTINCT g)

question: Show the top 3 originator banks by the total number of transactions in 2014.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2014-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.begin <= datetime('2014-12-31T23:59:59Z') WITH e, count(f) AS transactions ORDER BY transactions DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS OriginatorBank, transactions

question: Identify the top 5 actors who have acted in more than 10 movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 10 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 adult films with a runtime longer than 60 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.runtime > 60 RETURN a.title, a.runtime ORDER BY a.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which production company has the highest number of movies with a positive critical reception?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WHERE m.average_vote > 7 WITH pc, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN pc.name, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: Which actors were born after 1970 and acted in movies released before 2000?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1970 AND m.released < 2000 RETURN p.name AS actor_name, m.title AS movie_title

question: Who are the top 3 customers based on the number of orders placed?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WITH c, COUNT(o) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, orderCount

question: "How many directors did Tom Hanks work with and list their names "
cypher: MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT director) AS NumberOfDirectors, COLLECT(DISTINCT director.name) AS DirectorNames

question: Identify the top 5 filings with the most distinct beneficiary banks involved.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, COUNT(DISTINCT f.beneficiary_bank) AS distinct_beneficiary_banks ORDER BY distinct_beneficiary_banks DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS FilingID, distinct_beneficiary_banks

question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest average review rating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movie, avgRating

question: Who are the customers with orders that have a shipVia of '3'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.shipVia = '3' RETURN c.companyName AS CustomerName

question: List the profile URLs of the top 3 users by betweenness.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.profile_image_url ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the three most recent movies that have a tagline?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.tagline, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 3 hashtags used in tweets.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the names of the first 5 users who are chatters in the stream 'summit1g'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {name: 'summit1g'})<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) RETURN u.name LIMIT 5

question: List the first 5 movies with a director who has also acted in a movie.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists {     MATCH (d)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: Identify the first 3 machines running the application 'webserver'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(a:Application {name: 'webserver'}) RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: Which users are moderators for more than one stream? List the top 3.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS streams_count WHERE streams_count > 1 RETURN u.name, streams_count ORDER BY streams_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Display movies that have been released in the 'United States of America'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'United States of America'}) WHERE m.status = 'Released' RETURN m

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster CONTAINS 'face' RETURN m

cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.closed_date < '2010' MATCH (e)-[r]-() RETURN DISTINCT r.sourceID

question: Identify the 5 suppliers with the highest average unit price of products supplied.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, AVG(p.unitPrice) AS avgUnitPrice ORDER BY avgUnitPrice DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.companyName, avgUnitPrice

question: Identify the top 3 largest disks by capacity in the DataCenter DC1.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN t.name AS typeName, t.disk AS diskCapacity ORDER BY t.disk DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the applications that are running on machines with a CPU count greater than 8.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE t.cpu > 8 MATCH (m)-[:RUNS]->(app:Application) RETURN DISTINCT app.name

question: Show the first 3 tweets mentioning 'Neo4j' that have been retweeted by 'Me'.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(retweetedTweet:Tweet) WHERE retweetedTweet.text CONTAINS 'Neo4j' RETURN retweetedTweet.text AS tweet_text LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 racks contained in DataCenter 'DC1'.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack) RETURN rack LIMIT 3

question: What is the average discount applied to orders placed by customers based in 'USA'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {country: 'USA'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH avg(toFloat(o.discount)) AS averageDiscount RETURN averageDiscount

question: Give me the 7 movies with the lowest number of votes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes ASC LIMIT 7

question: What are the 3 most common taglines found in the movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN m.tagline, count(*) AS tagline_count ORDER BY tagline_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which categories contain more than 5 products?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product) WITH c, count(p) as productCount WHERE productCount > 5 RETURN c.categoryName, productCount

cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, avg(toFloat(orders.unitPrice)) AS avgPrice MATCH (o)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(orders.unitPrice) > avgPrice WITH DISTINCT o.customerID AS customerID MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: customerID}) RETURN c.companyName

question: Which 5 movies have been directed by persons who also have an acting role in any movie?

cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, COUNT(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName, streamCount

question: List the top 3 people who have acted the most in released movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' RETURN p.name, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies released after 2010 with a budget over 100 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > '2010' AND m.budget > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.released, m.budget ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: "How many actors has Tom hanks work with?"
cypher: MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActors:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT coActors) AS NumberOfCoActors

question: Which movies have a status of 'Released' and a vote count of over 1000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.status = 'Released' AND m.vote_count > 1000 RETURN m.title, m.vote_count

question: "If the current year is 2024, who is the oldest director for a movie that has greater than 95 rating"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(r:Person) WHERE r.rating > 95 RETURN p.name AS Director, p.born AS BirthYear ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many streams are part of the 'ESO Stream Team'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: 'ESO Stream Team'}) RETURN count(s) AS NumberOfStreams

question: List the names of all processes that are running on machines that are of type "s" and are located in a rack with a zone of 3.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type), (r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m) WHERE t.type = "s" AND r.zone = 3 WITH m MATCH (m)-[:RUNS]->(p:Process) RETURN p.name

question: List the top 5 entities by the total amount they have been concerned in filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)<-[:CONCERNS]-(f:Filing) WITH e, SUM(f.amount) AS totalAmount ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name AS entityName, totalAmount

question: Display all movies that were released in the 1990s.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('1990-01-01') AND m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN m

question: Identify the officers linked to the entity with node id '12174285'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {node_id: 12174285})-[:officer_of]->(o:Officer) RETURN o

question: List the top 5 addresses that are linked to the highest number of entities.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[r:registered_address]->(a:Address) WITH a, count(e) AS entityCount ORDER BY entityCount DESC RETURN a.address, entityCount LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 movies have the most distinct countries of release listed?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, size(m.countries) AS numCountries ORDER BY numCountries DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 users with the highest number of streams they are moderators of that have the language "ru" and have at least one VIP.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'ru'}) WHERE (s)-[:VIP]->(:User) WITH u, count(s) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS userName

question: Find the entities that have 'officer_of' relationship with the officer with the name 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {name: 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.'}) MATCH (o)-[:officer_of]->(e) RETURN e.name

question: What are the top 5 movies with a single-country language setting and the highest imdbRating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.countries) = 1 AND size(m.languages) = 1 RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the first 3 users who are moderators for streams with a total view count exceeding 500,000.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000 RETURN u.name, u.id ORDER BY u.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: How many different types of software are running on machines in zone 4?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone {zone: 4})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface)<-[:ROUTES]-(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(s:Software) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) AS NumberOfSoftwareTypes

question: List the first 3 users that 'Neo4j' follows with the highest number of tweets.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(f:User) RETURN f ORDER BY f.statuses DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have a revenue greater than 300 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 300000000 RETURN m

question: What are the names of games played by streams with more than 100,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 100000 RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: What are the top 3 collections with the most movies included?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WITH c, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS collectionName, movieCount

question: Find the customer who has placed orders with the highest total freight cost.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WITH c, toFloat(o.freight) AS freightValue WITH c, sum(freightValue) AS totalFreightCost WITH max(totalFreightCost) AS maxFreightCost MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WITH c, sum(toFloat(o.freight)) AS totalFreightCost, maxFreightCost WHERE totalFreightCost = maxFreightCost RETURN c.companyName

question: List the first 5 countries associated with Entities that have a 'Defaulted' status.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {status: 'Defaulted'}) WITH e.countries AS countries RETURN collect(DISTINCT countries)[..5] AS country_list

question: Name 3 movies that Tom Hanks has a credit in as a crew member.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List all entities that have a jurisdiction of Samoa.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {jurisdiction: 'SAM'}) RETURN e

question: Identify the first 3 actors who have acted in movies with at least three different directors.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH a, m, count(DISTINCT d) AS numDirectors WHERE numDirectors >= 3 RETURN a.name, collect(m.title) AS movies ORDER BY a.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 movies by revenue released in 2014?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2014 AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 hashtags used in tweets posted by users from 'Graphs Are Everywhere'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name, count(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all movies that have a director who has also acted in a movie.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE exists {     MATCH (d)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) } RETURN m

question: Find the top 5 streams that have been active the longest based on the creation date.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 5

question: Show the top 5 oldest movies in the collection with the highest revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.release_date, m.revenue ORDER BY m.release_date, m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 movies with an imdbRating greater than 8.5?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.5 RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most associated genres?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, count(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title, genreCount

question: What are the names of the top 3 entities by number of filings they have originated?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) RETURN e.name, count(f) AS filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the company names of customers from Germany?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {country: "Germany"}) RETURN c.companyName

question: Which products have a 'productName' starting with 'C'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.productName STARTS WITH 'C' RETURN p

question: What is the average number of Addresses linked to Entities with a "service_provider" of "Appleby"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: "Appleby"}) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:registered_address]->(a:Address) WITH e, count(a) AS addressCount WITH avg(addressCount) AS averageAddressCount RETURN averageAddressCount

question: List all movies with a tagline containing 'end'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'end' RETURN m.title, m.tagline

question: List all applications that have dependencies on other applications.
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(:Application) RETURN DISTINCT app.name

question: List the top 3 movies with a released date on a Friday.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.released).dayOfWeek = 5 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 actors by number of roles in movies with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie {status: 'Released'}) RETURN p.name AS actor, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which application listens on port 80?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN app.name

question: What are the first 3 movies with a poster URL containing 'face'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster CONTAINS 'face' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 users who have an average rating less than 3.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating WHERE avgRating < 3 RETURN u.name AS user, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 directors who have died after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.died > date("2000-01-01") RETURN d ORDER BY d.died ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 streams with the least followers that still have moderators?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 hashtags used in the tweets that have been retweeted by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(retweetedTweet)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag:Hashtag) RETURN hashtag.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of followers for users who have mentioned "Neo4j" in their tweets and have used a specific hashtag that has been used by a user who follows them and has a similarity score greater than 0.7 with another user who has also mentioned "Neo4j" in their tweets?
cypher: MATCH (user1:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet1:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:User {screen_name: 'Neo4j'}) MATCH (user1)-[:FOLLOWS]->(user2:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet2:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag:Hashtag)<-[:TAGS]-(tweet3:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(user3:User)-[:SIMILAR_TO {score: {gt: 0.7}}]->(user4:User)-[:POSTS]->(:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m) WITH DISTINCT user2 RETURN avg(user2.followers) AS average_followers

question: List all movies with a tagline containing the word "Forever" and their respective release years.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS "Forever" RETURN m.title, m.released

question: List the first 5 movies that have been rated by users from more than 10 different countries.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, collect(distinct u) as users WHERE size(users) > 10 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 5

question: Which persons have reviewed movies with a rating of 100?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating = 100 RETURN p.name AS reviewer, m.title AS movie

question: "Match(n) Return n"
cypher: MATCH (n) RETURN n

question: List all suppliers that are based outside of 'USA' and 'UK'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.country <> 'USA' AND s.country <> 'UK' RETURN s.companyName AS SupplierName, s.country AS Country

question: What are the first 3 movies with the longest role lists in 'ACTED_IN' relationships?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) RETURN m.title AS movie, size(r.roles) AS roleCount ORDER BY roleCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 entities with the most recent 'incorporation_date' that are also 'intermediary_of' by an intermediary.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date IS NOT NULL WITH e ORDER BY e.incorporation_date DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e

question: List the top 5 beneficiary entities that received the highest number of filings from entities located in their own country.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e1:Entity) MATCH (b)-[:COUNTRY]->(c1:Country) MATCH (e1)-[:COUNTRY]->(c2:Country) WHERE c1.code = c2.code WITH b, count(*) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN b.name, filingCount

question: Find all movies where Joel Silver acted.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Joel Silver"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m

question: Which movies are associated with the production company 'Pixar Animation Studios'?
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany {name: 'Pixar Animation Studios'})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which 3 suppliers provide products in the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users are VIPs in the most number of different users' streams?
cypher: MATCH (vipUser:User)-[:VIP]->(stream:Stream) WITH vipUser, count(DISTINCT stream) AS streamCount ORDER BY streamCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN vipUser.name AS vipUserName, streamCount

question: What is the `name` of the entity with `internal_id` '1001263'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: '1001263'}) RETURN e.name

question: What are the top 3 reviewed movies with summaries mentioning 'fun'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'fun' RETURN m.title, count(r) AS reviews ORDER BY reviews DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show all products that are part of the 'Grains/Cereals' category and have 'unitsOnOrder' above 10.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'}) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 10 RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder

question: What is the average number of followers for users who are VIPs of streams with the language "en"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH avg(u.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: What are the first 3 streams that have a chatter with a description longer than 50 words?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WHERE size(split(u.description, ' ')) > 50 RETURN s.name, s.url LIMIT 3

question: List all switches in rack 1.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {rack: 1})-[:HOLDS]->(s:Switch) RETURN s.ip AS switch_ip

question: What are the first 3 zones with size 16 and IP starting with '10.2'?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone) WHERE z.size = 16 AND z.ip STARTS WITH '10.2' RETURN z LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 movies with a plot involving 'love' that have a runtime over 120 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'love' AND m.runtime > 120 RETURN m.title, m.plot, m.runtime ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the officer associated with the entity with internal_id '1001256'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: '1001256'})<-[:officer_of]-(o:Officer) RETURN o.name

question: List the first 3 filings where the beneficiary bank country is 'Spain' and the amount is over 5 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'Spain' AND f.amount > 5000000 RETURN f LIMIT 3

question: List all movies with a rating above 80 and their respective taglines.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 80 RETURN m.title, m.tagline

question: List the names of the languages used by streams that are moderated by users with a follower count greater than 100000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 100000 WITH DISTINCT s MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN DISTINCT l.name

question: How many products have a `quantityPerUnit` that includes the word 'jars'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.quantityPerUnit CONTAINS 'jars' WITH p RETURN count(p)

question: Identify the applications running on machine named DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'})-[:RUNS]->(app:Application) RETURN app.name AS ApplicationName

question: Show the streams that have the most teams associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH s, COUNT(t) AS teamCount ORDER BY teamCount DESC RETURN s.name AS streamName, teamCount LIMIT 10

question: List the first 3 movies that have a specific keyword 'adventure' and are in the 'Released' status.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'adventure'}) WHERE m.status = 'Released' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which Routers are located in zone 1?
cypher: MATCH (r:Router {zone: 1}) RETURN r

question: Which 3 suppliers have the most products with a reorder level of 0?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 0 RETURN s.companyName, count(p) AS NumberOfProducts ORDER BY NumberOfProducts DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the actors who have starred in movies with a budget lower than the cost of a cup of coffee.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 5 RETURN a.name

question: Which racks are in zone 1 and have more than 5 machines?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) WHERE r.zone = 1 WITH r, count(m) AS machineCount WHERE machineCount > 5 RETURN r.name AS rackName

question: What is the maximum 'size' value among all 'Network' nodes?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network) RETURN max(n.size)

question: Which users have retweeted 'neo4j''s tweets the most?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(retweet:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(retweeter:User) RETURN retweeter.screen_name AS retweeter, count(*) AS retweets ORDER BY retweets DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the first 3 products with a unit price between $10 and $20 and a discontinued status of true.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice >= 10 AND p.unitPrice <= 20 AND p.discontinued = true RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 filings ended the latest and concern entities in 'China'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'China'}) RETURN f ORDER BY f.end DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the minimum amount filed by entities located in the country with code "GBR"?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {code: 'GBR'})<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) RETURN min(f.amount) AS min_amount

question: What is the most common genre for movies released in the 1990s?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('1990-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('1999-12-31') WITH m MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN g.name AS mostCommonGenre LIMIT 1

question: List the first 3 movies released after 2010.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date > date('2010-01-01') RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of followers for users who have been mentioned in the same tweets as users who have replied to tweets mentioning users who have retweeted 'Neo4j's tweets?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(neo4jTweet:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]->(retweet:Tweet)<-[:REPLY_TO]->(replyTweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(repliedToUser:User) WITH DISTINCT repliedToUser MATCH (repliedToUser)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentionedTweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(mentionedUser:User) WITH DISTINCT mentionedUser RETURN avg(mentionedUser.followers) AS averageFollowers

question: Name the top 5 movies with the highest budget to revenue ratio.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue > 0 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, (toFloat(m.budget) / m.revenue) AS budgetToRevenueRatio ORDER BY budgetToRevenueRatio DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the streams with the most distinct teams associated.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH s, count(distinct t) as teamCount RETURN s.name as streamName, teamCount ORDER BY teamCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: Name the top 5 movies that have the keyword 'jealousy' associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'jealousy'}) RETURN m.title, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the `sar_id`s of filings where the `beneficiary_bank` is located in a country with a `name` that contains the word "Island".
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.name CONTAINS 'Island' WITH c MATCH (c)<-[:COUNTRY]-(b:Entity) WITH b MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b) RETURN f.sar_id

question: Which customers have a contact title of 'Sales Representative' and are located in 'Berlin'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.contactTitle = 'Sales Representative' AND c.city = 'Berlin' RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, c.contactName AS contactPerson

question: Show all products that are in the 'Seafood' category and have been ordered more than 5 times.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Seafood'}) MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p) WITH p, COUNT(r) AS orderCount WHERE orderCount > 5 RETURN p.productName, p.productID, orderCount

question: How many votes did the movie "Speed Racer" get?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie { title: "Speed Racer" }) RETURN m.votes

question: Which customers have purchased orders required in less than a month from the order date?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderDate IS NOT NULL AND        duration.between(date(o.orderDate), date(o.requiredDate)).days < 30 RETURN c

question: List the names of all racks contained within the data center 'DC1'.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack) RETURN rack.name

question: Find the top 5 games played by streams that also chatter with other streams.

question: Which streams have users with the role of both VIP and moderator?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:VIP]-(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) RETURN s.name AS streamName, s.url AS streamUrl, u.name AS userName

question: How many distinct addresses are associated with the entities?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WITH DISTINCT a RETURN count(a)

question: What are the names of applications running on machines in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(a:Application) RETURN a.name

question: Which switch is located in the highest rack number within DataCenter 'DC1'?

question: What is the total amount of filings where the beneficiary bank is located in a country with a name containing the letter "i"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country CONTAINS 'i' RETURN sum(f.amount) AS total_amount

question: Find the streams that are moderated by users who also chat in streams that play the game "Rust".

question: What are the three most common teams that streams belong to?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name AS team, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 actors who have died after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE a.died >= date('2000-01-01') RETURN a ORDER BY a.died ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which racks are contained within Data Center DC1 and are in zone 2?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(rack:Rack {zone: 2}) RETURN rack.name

question: List the names of the first 5 users who are chatters in the stream 'summit1g'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream {name: 'summit1g'}) RETURN u.name LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 genres by the number of movies?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS Genre, count(m) AS NumberOfMovies ORDER BY NumberOfMovies DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users have 'Neo4j' mentioned the most in tweets? List the top 3.

question: List all tweets that 'neo4j' has replied to.

question: What are the 5 most recent movies directed by directors born in the USA?

question: List the first 5 movies that have been associated with more than one genre.

question: Which entity has the latest struck_off_date?

question: List the countries that have both originator entities and beneficiary entities involved in filings.

question: Which 3 directors have the longest total runtime for all their directed movies?

question: Who are the first 3 actors by the number of different movies acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, numMovies

question: Find all movies that belong to the same collection as a movie with an average vote greater than 8.5. (first 3)

question: Which actors have the most roles in movies with a budget over 100 million dollars?

cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, r, u, datetime(m.released) AS releasedDate, datetime({epochSeconds: r.timestamp}) AS ratingDate WITH m, duration.between(releasedDate, ratingDate).days AS daysBetween ORDER BY daysBetween LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movie, daysBetween AS daysBetweenReleaseAndRating
