question: Find the 'pid' of the 'Process' with 'name' "7.1".
cypher: MATCH (p:Process {name: "7.1"}) RETURN p.pid

question: Which movies have a tagline containing the word 'excitement'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'excitement' RETURN m

question: What is the average unitPrice of products in the category with categoryName equal to 'Beverages'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c) WITH avg(p.unitPrice) AS averagePrice RETURN averagePrice

question: What are the first 3 movies that have a tagline containing the word 'adventure'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'adventure' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 services listen to port 80 in DataCenter 'DC1'?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(s:Service)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port {port: 80}) RETURN s.name LIMIT 3

question: Which packages provide access to the genre 'Animation'?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre {name: 'Animation'})<-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]-(p:Package) RETURN p.name AS PackageName

question: "Which users have moderated the same stream more than 3 times and also been a VIP in at least 2 different streams?"
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[m:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, s, COUNT(m) AS moderation_count WHERE moderation_count > 3 MATCH (u)-[v:VIP]->(s2:Stream) WITH u, COUNT(DISTINCT s2) AS vip_count WHERE vip_count >= 2 RETURN u.name, u.id

question: What is the total number of streams in the database?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN count(s) AS total_streams

question: Find all movies where the director's first and last names are the same.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WITH d, split(d.name, ' ') AS nameParts WHERE nameParts[0] = nameParts[size(nameParts) - 1] MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: List all routers in zone 1.
cypher: MATCH (r:Router) WHERE r.zone = 1 RETURN r.name

question: What are the follower counts for streams that have 'ru' as their language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'ru'}) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.followers AS follower_count

question: Which genres are associated with movies directed by 'Steven Spielberg'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Steven Spielberg'})-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS Genre

question: Which person has produced the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS producer, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find the streams that are moderated by users who are also moderators of other streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS moderatedStreamCount WHERE moderatedStreamCount > 1 MATCH (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(resultStreams:Stream) RETURN DISTINCT resultStreams

question: Which products have a reorder level greater than 15?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel > 15 RETURN p.productName

question: Which director has the lowest average IMDB rating for all their movies?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating ORDER BY averageRating ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN d.name AS director, averageRating

question: Which entities are served by the intermediary with node_id 11000001?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {node_id: 11000001})-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.node_id AS entity_node_id

question: Find all products that are both in 'Beverages' and 'Condiments' categories.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c1:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}),       (p)-[:PART_OF]->(c2:Category {categoryName: 'Condiments'}) RETURN p.productName, p.productID

question: Which customers have a contact title of 'Sales Representative'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {contactTitle: 'Sales Representative'}) RETURN c

question: Which 3 products have the highest units on order?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 countries with the most filings as a beneficiary in 2013.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2013-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2013-12-31T23:59:59Z') RETURN c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings ORDER BY filings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which entity with a 'Defaulted' status has the most officers?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {status: 'Defaulted'}) WITH e MATCH (e)<-[:officer_of]-(o:Officer) WITH e, count(o) AS officer_count RETURN e.name AS entity_name, officer_count ORDER BY officer_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 countries have the highest number of filings involving transactions above $2 million?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS|:CONCERNS|:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.amount > 2000000 WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count RETURN country, filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 ports that the process with PID 8966 listens to?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process {pid: 8966})-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN port.port LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 tweets by 'Neo4j' that have been retweeted by other users with more than 10000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WHERE tweet.text IS NOT NULL WITH me, tweet MATCH (tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(retweet:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(retweeter:User) WHERE retweeter.followers > 10000 RETURN tweet.text AS tweet_text, count{(tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-(:Tweet)} AS retweet_count ORDER BY tweet.created_at LIMIT 3

question: Find the names of all directors who were born in France.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {bornIn: "France"}) RETURN d.name

question: List the top 5 users based on betweenness centrality.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average freight cost of orders shipped to 'USA'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'USA' RETURN avg(toFloat(o.freight)) AS averageFreightCost

question: Which movies have been reviewed by more than two persons?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WITH m, count(p) AS reviewers WHERE reviewers > 2 RETURN m.title

question: Which products have been ordered by customers from Berlin?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE c.city = 'Berlin' RETURN DISTINCT p.productName

question: What is the average number of 'favorites' for tweets that contain links?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Link) RETURN avg(t.favorites) AS average_favorites

question: What is the originator_bank of the filing with sar_id "3297"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing {sar_id: "3297"}) RETURN f.originator_bank

question: Which 3 production companies have produced the most movies with a runtime longer than 120 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 WITH c, count(m) AS num_movies RETURN c.name AS company, num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the movies released between 1980 and 1990.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 1980 AND m.released <= 1990 RETURN m

question: Who are the first 3 actors by number of roles in videos with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(v:Video {status: 'Released'}) WITH p, COUNT(v) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor_name, role_count

question: Which languages are used by streams that have at least one VIP who is also a moderator for a stream with more than 1,000,000 total view count and uses the English language?
cypher: MATCH (s1:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s2:Stream) WHERE s2.total_view_count > 1000000 AND EXISTS {   MATCH (s2)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'en'}) } WITH DISTINCT s1 MATCH (s1)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name

question: What is the average 'amount' of filings where the 'beneficiary_bank' is 'Barclays Bank Plc'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = 'Barclays Bank Plc' RETURN avg(f.amount)

question: Identify the first 3 Applications running on Machine 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'})-[:RUNS]->(a:Application) RETURN a.name ORDER BY a.startTime LIMIT 3

question: Find persons who have acted in, directed, and produced different movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie),        (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie),        (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m3:Movie) WHERE m1 <> m2 AND m2 <> m3 AND m1 <> m3 RETURN p.name, m1.title AS ActedIn, m2.title AS Directed, m3.title AS Produced

question: Which 3 customers have the highest number of discontinued products ordered?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = true WITH c, COUNT(p) AS discontinuedProductCount ORDER BY discontinuedProductCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, discontinuedProductCount

question: Which routers route through interface with IP '10.1.0.254'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Router)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface {ip: '10.1.0.254'}) RETURN r.name

question: List the names of the teams that have streams with a total view count greater than 1 million.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT t.name

question: Identify the first 3 Services that are instances of 'java'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: What are the distinct roles played by Laurence Fishburne across all movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Laurence Fishburne'})-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) UNWIND r.roles AS role RETURN DISTINCT role

question: Name the top 5 videos with the most associated genres.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH v, COUNT(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN v.title AS videoTitle, genreCount

question: Which 3 movies have the most keywords associated?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, COUNT(k) AS keywordCount ORDER BY keywordCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, keywordCount

question: Find the top 5 movies with the highest votes released after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 5 Filings with the lowest number of transactions.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f ORDER BY f.number ASC LIMIT 5 RETURN f

question: What is the name of the entity that filed the filing with the earliest 'begin' date?
cypher: MATCH (earliestFiling:Filing) WITH earliestFiling ORDER BY earliestFiling.begin ASC LIMIT 1 MATCH (earliestFiling)<-[:FILED]-(filer:Entity) RETURN filer.name

question: What are the 3 most popular movies in the genre 'Thriller'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Thriller'}) RETURN m.title, m.popularity ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find officers linked to entities that were incorporated in 2007 and are still active.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date CONTAINS '2007' AND e.status = 'Active' RETURN o

question: Which intermediaries serve as officers of entities?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN i, e

question: "Which dependencies has the webapp application?"
cypher: MATCH (:Application {name: "webapp"})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency) RETURN dependency.name

question: Find the `supplierID` and `contactName` of suppliers who supply products with a `reorderLevel` equal to 0.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 0 MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p) RETURN s.supplierID, s.contactName

question: Which suppliers supply products to more than five different categories?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS numCategories WHERE numCategories > 5 RETURN s

question: Identify the first 3 streams that have chatters who are users with a follower count below 3000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WHERE u.followers < 3000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: Which three countries are most frequently listed as the originator bank country in filings during 2010?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2010-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.end <= datetime('2010-12-31T23:59:59Z') WITH f.originator_bank_country AS country, COUNT(f) AS frequency RETURN country ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most significant difference between budget and revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, abs(m.revenue - m.budget) AS difference ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 users that 'Neo4j' interacts with most frequently?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[i:INTERACTS_WITH]->(u:User) RETURN u.screen_name AS user, count(i) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the IP addresses of all interfaces that are connected to switches in rack 3.
cypher: MATCH (s:Switch {rack: 3})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN i.ip

question: Find all tweets from users located in 'Graphs Are Everywhere' and show the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE u.location = 'Graphs Are Everywhere' RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 originator banks that have originated filings with the highest average amounts.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH e.name AS originator_bank, avg(f.amount) AS avg_amount RETURN originator_bank, avg_amount ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which movies are part of a collection with a backdrop path containing '/9FBwqcd9IRruEDUrTdcaafOMKUq.jpg'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WHERE c.backdrop_path CONTAINS '/9FBwqcd9IRruEDUrTdcaafOMKUq.jpg' RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, c.name AS CollectionName

question: List the top 5 oldest directors in the database.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL RETURN d ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 5

question: How many products are in the 'Confections' category and have a unit price greater than 20?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) WHERE p.unitPrice > 20 RETURN count(p) AS NumberOfProducts

question: List the countries of origin for the top 5 filings with the highest amounts.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH f, c ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.name AS country_of_origin, f.amount

question: Which 3 movies have the most distinct languages spoken?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH m, count(distinct l) as numLanguages ORDER BY numLanguages DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title, numLanguages

question: Identify the top 5 networks by size within zone 3.
cypher: MATCH (n:Network) WHERE n.zone = 3 RETURN n.ip, n.size ORDER BY n.size DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which movies have a runtime longer than 180 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 180 RETURN m.title, m.runtime

question: List the names of the actors who were born in the same country as Harold Lloyd.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: 'Harold Lloyd'}) WITH d.bornIn AS country MATCH (a:Actor {bornIn: country}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actorName

question: What type of Machines are in Rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1' and have more than 16 GB RAM?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(machine:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(type:Type) WHERE type.ram > 16 RETURN machine.name AS MachineName, type.name AS TypeName, type.ram AS RAM

question: "Which game is most frequently played by streamers who are part of the PUBG Partners team?"
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: "PUBG Partners"}) RETURN g.name, COUNT(*) AS frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average IMDb rating of movies released in 1995?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {year: 1995}) WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: List the top 5 movies that have been part of at least one collection.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(:Collection) RETURN m ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 streams have the most users as VIPs?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS vipCount ORDER BY vipCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.id AS StreamID, s.name AS StreamName, vipCount

question: What are the first 3 movies that were released in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE "USA" IN m.countries RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS releaseDate ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 most stocked products in the 'Grains/Cereals' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'}) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock ORDER BY p.unitsInStock DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which language is most commonly associated with streams that have more than 500,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 500000 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which users are moderators for the stream with the name '9linda'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {name: '9linda'})<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User) RETURN u.name AS moderator_name

question: Find 3 languages spoken in streams with the highest number of followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name, sum(s.followers) AS total_followers ORDER BY total_followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies with an imdbId that starts with '07'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbId STARTS WITH '07' RETURN m.title, m.imdbId LIMIT 3

question: List the streams with the highest number of chatters who are also streamers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE exists {   (s)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream) } RETURN s, count{(s)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)} AS streamerChatters ORDER BY streamerChatters DESC

question: What are the names of the top 5 beneficiary banks that received the highest total `amount` from filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WITH b.name AS beneficiary_bank, sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN beneficiary_bank, totalAmount

question: Which suppliers are located in the same city as the supplier of 'Chai'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Chai'})-[:SUPPLIES]-(supplier:Supplier) WITH supplier.city AS supplierCity MATCH (otherSuppliers:Supplier) WHERE otherSuppliers.city = supplierCity RETURN DISTINCT otherSuppliers.companyName

question: Which 3 users have rated the most movies?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, count(r) AS num_ratings ORDER BY num_ratings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u, num_ratings

question: What are the names of actors who have acted in more than five movies?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(m) AS numMovies WHERE numMovies > 5 RETURN a.name

question: Which games are played by streams that have at least two different languages associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE exists {   (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(:Language)   WHERE NOT (l)-->(s) } RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS game

question: Which 5 directors have directed the most movies with budgets over 50 million?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN d.name AS Director, COUNT(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 most frequently shipped products to 'France'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)-[:PURCHASED]->(c:Customer) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'France' RETURN p.productName, count(o) AS shipments ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which customers have placed orders that include products from category '1'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryID: '1'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)<-[:PURCHASED]-(cust:Customer) RETURN DISTINCT cust.companyName

question: List the names of the teams that have streams moderated by users with more than 10000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 WITH DISTINCT s MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN t.name

question: What is the IP address of the switch in rack 1?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(s:Switch) RETURN s.ip

question: List the first 3 Routers contained in DataCenter 'DC1'.
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Router) RETURN r.name LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 genres are most common in movies with a runtime over 120 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN g.name AS genre, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which filings involve an entity with the id 'the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp' as both originator and beneficiary?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e1:Entity {id: 'the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp'}),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e2:Entity {id: 'the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp'}) RETURN f

question: Which 5 videos have a runtime under 60 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.runtime < 60 RETURN v.title, v.runtime ORDER BY v.runtime ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 streams by follower count.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Display the first 3 machines with type 'm' in their configurations.
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type {type: 'm'}) RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: List the entities that were incorporated in '2006' and have a service provider of 'Mossack Fonseca'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date CONTAINS '2006' AND e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' RETURN e

question: Which actors have more than 3 roles in a single movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE size(r.roles) > 3 RETURN p.name

question: List 3 movies with the tagline including the word 'real'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE toLower(m.tagline) CONTAINS 'real' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What is the average amount of filings originated by entities located in Singapore and the beneficiary bank is "Barclays Bank Plc"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing {beneficiary_bank: "Barclays Bank Plc"})-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.country = "SGP" WITH avg(f.amount) AS averageAmount RETURN averageAmount

question: List the top 3 movies where the homepage URL includes 'disney'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage CONTAINS 'disney' RETURN m ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the name of the Intermediary with the earliest lastEditTimestamp?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary) WITH min(i.lastEditTimestamp) AS minTimestamp MATCH (i:Intermediary {lastEditTimestamp: minTimestamp}) RETURN i.name

question: Which stream has the lowest total view count and what language is it using?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count IS NOT NULL RETURN s, l ORDER BY s.total_view_count ASC LIMIT 1

question: Name the top 5 highest-grossing movies.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the top 3 movies that have been rated by the oldest users.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, m, r ORDER BY u.born ASC RETURN m.title, m.year, m.imdbRating, collect(r.rating)[..3] AS ratings LIMIT 3

question: Which actor has collaborated with the most directors?
cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Person) WITH a, count(DISTINCT d) AS directorCount ORDER BY directorCount DESC RETURN a.name, directorCount LIMIT 1

question: Identify the first 3 tweets by 'Neo4j' that contain a link to an external website.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: What is the PID of the Service that listens to the Port with port number 80?
cypher: MATCH (p:Port {port: 80})<-[:LISTENS]-(s:Service) RETURN s.pid

question: What is the total number of streams that belong to teams created after 2018?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt >= datetime('2018-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS totalStreams

question: "Which director directed the least movies among the movies that the actor who acted in the most movies acted in?"
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH actor, count(m) AS moviesActed ORDER BY moviesActed DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) WITH director, count(m) AS moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN director.name AS leastProlificDirector, moviesDirected

question: Which 3 subscriptions will expire the soonest?
cypher: MATCH (s:Subscription) RETURN s ORDER BY s.expiresAt ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 countries by the number of entities located there.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, count(e) AS NumberOfEntities ORDER BY NumberOfEntities DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the summary of the lowest-rated review of 'Speed Racer'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN r.summary AS Summary ORDER BY r.rating ASC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 users that 'Neo4j' has amplified?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:AMPLIFIES]->(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, user.name ORDER BY user.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the movies with a vote count less than 50?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count < 50 RETURN m

question: List all movies that have a revenue greater than 100 million dollars and have been rated by more than 500 users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 100000000 AND m.imdbVotes > 500 RETURN m.title, m.revenue, m.imdbVotes

question: Which streams have a follower count between 10,000 and 50,000, listing the first 5?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers >= 10000 AND s.followers <= 50000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.followers ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 countries by the number of entities based on the [:COUNTRY] relationship.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(e) AS entity_count ORDER BY entity_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, entity_count

question: Which language is most commonly associated with streams that have more than 500,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 500000 RETURN l.name AS language, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 3 movies that have the highest revenue and were released in 2014.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released STARTS WITH '2014' AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 entities that originated the highest amount of filings.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH e.id AS entityId, e.name AS entityName, count(*) AS totalFilings ORDER BY totalFilings DESC RETURN entityId, entityName, totalFilings LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 tweets posted by the user with the screen name 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, t.favorites AS favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 countries by the number of originator banks they have.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)<-[:ORIGINATOR]-(f:Filing) WITH c, count(DISTINCT e) AS numOriginatorBanks ORDER BY numOriginatorBanks DESC RETURN c.name AS CountryName, numOriginatorBanks LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 most active users in terms of tweeting from 'Graphs Are Everywhere'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN u.screen_name AS user, count(t) AS num_tweets ORDER BY num_tweets DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the movies that were released before the year 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date.year < 2000 RETURN m.title

question: List all products that have been ordered in the month of July 1996.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) WHERE o.orderDate STARTS WITH '1996-07' RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, p.productID AS ProductID

question: What are the screen names of the top 3 users who have posted the most tweets?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WITH u, count(t) AS tweetsCount ORDER BY tweetsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.screen_name AS screen_name

question: Which 3 users rated the movie with the highest revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WITH m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m) RETURN u LIMIT 3

question: Show officers that are linked as 'Nominee Shareholder of' other entities.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer)-[r:officer_of {link: 'Nominee Shareholder of'}]->(e:Entity) RETURN o, r, e

question: Which 5 directors have directed at least 5 movies with an IMDb rating above 7.0?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbRating > 7.0 WITH d, count(m) AS numMovies WHERE numMovies >= 5 RETURN d.name AS director, numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the highest-rated movie Keanu Reeves acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WITH m, max(r.rating) AS max_rating MATCH (m)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating = max_rating RETURN m.title, max_rating

question: What are the birth years of people who have acted in movies released before 1980?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1980 RETURN DISTINCT p.born AS BirthYear

question: Which users are VIPs in more than one stream?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS streams_count WHERE streams_count > 1 RETURN u.name, streams_count

question: Find the top 5 Filings with the shortest duration between begin and end dates.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration ASC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS SAR_ID, f.begin AS BeginDate, f.end AS EndDate, duration AS Duration

question: Find the streams that have been chatted in by users who also moderate other streams.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s1:Stream) WITH u MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(s2:Stream) RETURN DISTINCT s2

question: Which Countries have the most beneficiary banks in Filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(f) AS filings_count RETURN country, filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the first 3 Addresses located in the Bahamas.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address) WHERE a.countries = 'Bahamas' RETURN a LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 adult videos have the most provocative poster paths?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.poster_path IS NOT NULL RETURN a.title, a.poster_path ORDER BY a.popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 filings with a duration of exactly one month from begin to end date.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE duration.inMonths(datetime(f.begin), datetime(f.end)).months = 1 RETURN f ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: What is the average 'amount' of filings where the beneficiary entity is located in the country with code 'GBR'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.code = 'GBR' WITH avg(f.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: Find the top 3 `originator_bank` values with the lowest total number of filings where the `beneficiary_bank_country` is "Cayman Islands" and the `amount` is less than 100000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = "Cayman Islands" AND f.amount < 100000 WITH f.originator_bank AS originator_bank, count(f) AS filing_count ORDER BY filing_count ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN originator_bank, filing_count

question: List the names of sources used in tweets posted by users who follow the user with screen name "neo4j".
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) <-[:FOLLOWS]-(follower:User) MATCH (follower)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) MATCH (tweet)-[:USING]->(source:Source) RETURN DISTINCT source.name

question: List the top 5 users with the highest number of streams they are VIPs of.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS vipCount ORDER BY vipCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN u.name AS userName, vipCount

question: List the top 5 movies with a plot containing the word 'adventure'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'adventure' RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which machines are held in rack 'DC1-RCK-4-9'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-4-9'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) RETURN m

question: Who are the 5 most frequent actors in the 'Adventure' genre?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) WITH a, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name AS actor, count

question: List all suppliers who supply products to customers in all regions of 'France'.
cypher: MATCH (customer:Customer {country: 'France'})-[:PURCHASED]->(order:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(product:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]->(supplier:Supplier) WITH DISTINCT supplier, order.shipRegion AS region WITH supplier, count(DISTINCT region) AS supplierRegions, size(collect(region)) AS totalRegions WHERE supplierRegions = totalRegions RETURN DISTINCT supplier.companyName AS supplierName

question: List all the tweets by 'neo4j' that reply to another tweet.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO]->(r:Tweet) RETURN t

question: Which 5 filings have the longest duration from begin to end date?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS SAR_ID, f.begin AS BeginDate, f.end AS EndDate, duration

question: What is the average similarity score between users who follow users followed by Neo4j and users followed by them?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user1:User) MATCH (user1)<-[:FOLLOWS]-(user2:User) MATCH (user2)-[sim:SIMILAR_TO]-(user1) WITH avg(sim.score) AS average_similarity RETURN average_similarity

question: Which 3 videos have the highest number of associated production companies?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WITH v, COUNT(pc) AS productionCompanyCount ORDER BY productionCompanyCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN v.title AS videoTitle, productionCompanyCount

question: Which entities have an inactivation date on '18-FEB-2013' and a struck off date on '15-FEB-2013'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.inactivation_date = '18-FEB-2013' AND e.struck_off_date = '15-FEB-2013' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.inactivation_date, e.struck_off_date

question: Name the people who have directed more than two movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS directedMovies WHERE directedMovies > 2 RETURN p.name AS DirectorName

question: Which processes are running on machines that run the 'webserver' application?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webserver'})<-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(process:Process) RETURN process.name AS processName, process.startTime AS processStartTime, process.pid AS processPID

question: List the movies with a title containing a punctuation mark.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title =~ ".*[[:punct:]].*" RETURN m.title

question: Which movie has the shortest runtime?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.runtime ASC LIMIT 1

question: List all software versions that are previous versions of the version named '7.1'.
cypher: MATCH (v:Version {name: '7.1'})<-[:PREVIOUS]-(prev:Version) RETURN prev.name AS previous_versions

question: Which Switches are connected to Interfaces routing through network '10.2'?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network {ip: '10.2'})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface)<-[:ROUTES]-(s:Switch) RETURN s.ip AS switch_ip

question: List all the links contained in tweets posted by 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) RETURN l.url AS LinkURL

question: What are the top 3 originator banks in filings from the United Kingdom?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "United Kingdom"}) WITH f.originator_bank AS bank, COUNT(f) AS filings_count RETURN bank ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the names of people who directed movies with a rating above 90.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(reviewer:Person) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Find the customers who placed orders that were shipped to the same country as the customer with 'customerID' 'ALFKI'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: 'ALFKI'}) WITH c.country AS customerCountry MATCH (o:Order {shipCountry: customerCountry}) MATCH (customer:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o) RETURN DISTINCT customer.customerID

question: List the names of the top 5 movies with the highest revenue.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, m.revenue AS revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 products from suppliers located in 'USA'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {country: 'USA'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Which entities have a different former name and current name?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.former_name IS NOT NULL AND e.name IS NOT NULL AND e.former_name <> e.name RETURN e

question: List the distinct 'originator_bank' values for filings where the 'beneficiary_bank' is "Azizi Bank".
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = "Azizi Bank" RETURN DISTINCT f.originator_bank

question: List the movies that have the keyword "jealousy" associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'jealousy'}) RETURN m.title

question: What is the average difference in days between the 'begin_date' and 'end_date' for filings where the 'originator_country' is the United States?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_country = "United States" WITH duration.inDays(f.end_date_format, f.begin_date_format) AS difference RETURN avg(difference) AS average_difference

question: Who are the suppliers for the 'Grains/Cereals' category?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName

question: List the first 3 directors born after 1960.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN p.name AS DirectorName, p.born AS BirthYear ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of followers for streams that have been played by users who also play "Rust"?
cypher: MATCH (rust:Game {name: "Rust"})<-[:PLAYS]-(user:User)-[:PLAYS]->(stream:Stream) WITH avg(stream.followers) AS average_followers RETURN average_followers

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders placed by customers located in the same country as the supplier of the most expensive product?
cypher: MATCH (mostExpensiveProduct:Product) WITH max(mostExpensiveProduct.unitPrice) AS maxPrice, mostExpensiveProduct MATCH (mostExpensiveProduct)-[:SUPPLIES]->(supplier:Supplier) WITH mostExpensiveProduct, supplier.country AS supplierCountry MATCH (customer:Customer {country: supplierCountry})-[:PURCHASED]->(order:Order) WITH order, customer MATCH (order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(product:Product) WITH order, sum(toFloat(orders.quantity) * toFloat(orders.unitPrice) * (1 - toFloat(orders.discount))) AS orderRevenue RETURN sum(orderRevenue) AS totalRevenue

question: What are the top 5 movies by budget size?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all the products ordered in the 'Confections' category.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product) MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p) RETURN DISTINCT p.productName AS ProductName

question: What are the top 5 orders in terms of quantity for the product 'Chai'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Chai'})<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, o.orderDate AS orderDate, o.shipName AS shipName, o.shipCity AS shipCity, o.shipCountry AS shipCountry, o.shipPostalCode AS shipPostalCode, o.shipAddress AS shipAddress, o.shipVia AS shipVia, o.shipRegion AS shipRegion, o.freight AS freight, o.requiredDate AS requiredDate, o.shippedDate AS shippedDate, o.customerID AS customerID, o.employeeID AS employeeID, o.unitPrice AS unitPrice, o.quantity AS quantity, o.discount AS discount ORDER BY o.quantity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the names of the top 5 users with the highest number of followers?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 filings with the highest number of transactions in a single filing.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) RETURN f ORDER BY f.number DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which entities are connected to 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: 'MOSSFON SUBSCRIBERS LTD.'})-[:connected_to]->(connectedEntities:Entity) RETURN connectedEntities

question: Who are the first 3 people to have written and directed the same movie and what are those movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:WROTE]-(p) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the movies where the plot mentions 'friendship' and the budget was under 20 million dollars.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'friendship' AND m.budget < 20000000 RETURN m.title, m.plot, m.budget

question: What is the total amount of filings where the originator entity is located in 'SGP' and the beneficiary entity is located in 'AFG'?
cypher: MATCH (originator:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(filing:Filing), (filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity) WHERE originator.country = 'SGP' AND beneficiary.country = 'AFG' WITH filing RETURN sum(filing.amount) AS total_amount

question: What is the total number of officers in the dataset?
cypher: MATCH (n:Officer) RETURN count(n) AS total_officers

question: What are the top 3 hashtags used in tweets posted by 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name, count(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have acted in movies with a rating lower than 50?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: List the first 3 services that started on applications named 'webserver'.
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webserver'})-[:RUNS]->(service:Service) RETURN service ORDER BY service.startTime LIMIT 3

question: List all movies with more than one person who has reviewed them.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WITH m, COUNT(p) AS reviewers WHERE reviewers > 1 RETURN m.title

question: What is the average number of filings per originator bank?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount RETURN avg(filingsCount) AS averageFilingsPerOriginatorBank

question: Find the streams that have "maximilian_dood" as a chatter and play "Resident Evil Village".
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: "maximilian_dood"})-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: "Resident Evil Village"}) RETURN s

question: Which users have the highest betweenness centrality among those who have mentioned "Neo4j" in their tweets?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'Neo4j' WITH u, u.betweenness AS bc ORDER BY bc DESC RETURN u.screen_name, bc

question: What are the names of the top 3 hashtags used in tweets by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(hashtag:Hashtag) RETURN hashtag.name AS hashtag, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What DataCenters are located in Iceland, Reykjavik?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {location: 'Iceland, Rekjavik'}) RETURN dc.name

question: What is the average discount applied to orders shipped to 'Brazil'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'Brazil' WITH avg(toFloat(rel.discount)) AS averageDiscount RETURN averageDiscount

question: What are the names of the top 3 beneficiary banks based on the number of different originator banks they have interacted with in filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WITH b, count(DISTINCT f.originator_bank) AS distinctOriginators ORDER BY distinctOriginators DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN b.name AS BeneficiaryBankName, distinctOriginators

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders shipped in the month of 'June'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shippedDate STARTS WITH '1996-06' WITH toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * rel.quantity * (1 - toFloat(rel.discount)) AS revenuePerProduct RETURN sum(revenuePerProduct) AS totalRevenue

question: What are the 'sar_id' values of filings where the 'originator_bank' and 'beneficiary_bank' are the same?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = f.beneficiary_bank RETURN f.sar_id

question: List the top 5 genres that have been accessed by the package named 'Platinum'.

question: List 3 movies with the tagline including the word 'real'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'real' RETURN m.title, m.tagline LIMIT 3

question: What is the average quantity of products per order?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o.orderID AS orderID, count(p) AS productsCount RETURN avg(productsCount) AS averageProductsPerOrder

question: What is the highest number of roles played by an actor in a single movie?
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) WITH size(r.roles) AS roles_count RETURN max(roles_count) AS max_roles

question: Which 3 movies with a tagline containing 'journey' were reviewed with a rating above 85?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[r:REVIEWED]->() WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'journey' AND r.rating > 85 RETURN m.title, m.tagline, r.rating ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 actors have acted in the most number of movies?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN a.name, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 production companies by the number of movies produced.
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WITH c, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS company, num_movies

question: What are the top 5 entities by number of filings where the beneficiary bank is 'HSBC'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = 'HSBC' RETURN e.name, count(f) AS filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which entities are connected to the officer with icij_id 'CB195B5424E13A74A6F3BC719050A2B9'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {icij_id: 'CB195B5424E13A74A6F3BC719050A2B9'})-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN e

question: Which products have a unit price lower than the average unit price of all products?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WITH avg(p.unitPrice) AS average_price MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < average_price RETURN p.productName AS productName, p.unitPrice AS unitPrice

question: What are the first 5 keywords most associated with movies that have a revenue above 1 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.revenue > 1000000 RETURN k.name, count(k) AS keyword_count ORDER BY keyword_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 products that are part of the 'Beverages' category and have been ordered more than 10 times.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p) WITH p, COUNT(r) AS orderCount WHERE orderCount > 10 RETURN p.productName AS productName, orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List 3 actors who have acted in movies with a tagline containing 'beginning'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'beginning' RETURN p.name AS actor LIMIT 3

question: Show the top 5 tweets that 'Me' has replied to.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO]->(repliedTo:Tweet) RETURN repliedTo, tweet ORDER BY tweet.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies that have been directed by more than one director.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH m, COUNT(d) AS directorCount WHERE directorCount > 1 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 3

question: What is the average total view count of streams that have "en" as a language and are moderated by users who are part of a team and are VIPs of other streams?

question: "What was the genre for the top rated movie with Harrison Ford in the cast?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Harrison Ford"})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS GenreName, m.title AS MovieTitle, m.average_vote AS Rating ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which users does 'neo4j' amplify the most and list the top 5?

question: Which users are amplified by 'Me'?

question: What are the top 5 movies that were directed by persons who were not primarily directors?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE NOT (p:Director) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS ReleaseDate ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 actors who have appeared in at least three movies with different original languages.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(DISTINCT m.original_language) AS num_languages WHERE num_languages >= 3 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 genres associated with the movie 'Nil Battey Sannata'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Nil Battey Sannata'})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g LIMIT 3

question: What are the top five movies where the person who directed the movie was born in the 1940s?
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE director.born >= 1940 AND director.born < 1950 RETURN movie.title AS title, movie.votes AS votes ORDER BY movie.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 genres associated with the movie 'Alex & Emma'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Alex & Emma'})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers provide products with a unit price less than $10?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice < 10 RETURN s.companyName, p.productName, p.unitPrice

question: List the first 3 adult films with the largest budget.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) RETURN a.title, a.budget ORDER BY a.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the names of the games played by streams that are moderated by users with more than 10000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 MATCH (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) MATCH (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: List the `name`s of the top 5 originator banks (`originator_bank`) with the highest total filing `amount`?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f.originator_bank AS originatorBank, sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN originatorBank, totalAmount

question: Find the movies that have at least one keyword in common with "Toy Story". (first 3)
cypher: MATCH (ts:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(keywords) MATCH (ts)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k)<-[:HAS_KEYWORD]-(otherMovies:Movie) WHERE otherMovies <> ts WITH DISTINCT otherMovies.title AS otherMoviesTitle RETURN otherMoviesTitle LIMIT 3

question: Which three genres have the least number of movies associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name, movieCount

question: Which products are supplied by suppliers with no listed fax number?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.fax IS NULL RETURN p.productName, p.productID

question: What are the names and IPs of the first 3 interfaces routed by the network with IP '10.2'?
cypher: MATCH (network:Network {ip: '10.2'})-[:ROUTES]->(interface:Interface) RETURN interface.name, interface.ip LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have a team created before 2015?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt < datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s.name AS stream_name, t.name AS team_name, t.createdAt AS team_created_at

question: List the movies that have been rated by more than 100 users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-() WITH m, count(r) AS ratingCount WHERE ratingCount > 100 RETURN m.title

question: Which movies have a plot that includes the word 'monster'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'monster' RETURN m

question: List 3 movies reviewed with the summary 'An amazing journey'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary = 'An amazing journey' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders placed by customers located in the same country as the supplier of the least expensive product?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WITH min(p.unitPrice) AS minPrice MATCH (p:Product {unitPrice: minPrice})-[:SUPPLIES]->(s:Supplier) MATCH (p:Product {unitPrice: minPrice})<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order)<-[:PURCHASED]-(c:Customer) WHERE s.country = c.country WITH o AS order MATCH (order)-[oi:ORDERS]->(product:Product) WITH order, oi, product RETURN sum(toFloat(oi.unitPrice) * toInteger(oi.quantity)) AS totalRevenue

question: Which 3 adult films have the longest runtime and are in the 'Released' status?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.status = 'Released' RETURN a.title, a.runtime ORDER BY a.runtime DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the movies produced by a person born in the 1950s.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born >= 1950 AND p.born < 1960 RETURN m.title AS movie

question: List the first 3 packages that provide access to the 'Drama' genre.
cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN p.name AS package LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 directors by the number of movies they have directed.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS directedMovies ORDER BY directedMovies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS Director, directedMovies

question: Which tweets mention 'Neo4j' and were created after '2021-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) WHERE u.name = 'Neo4j' AND t.created_at > datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN t

question: List the top 5 movies with the most user ratings.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(:User) RETURN m.title AS movie, count(r) AS numRatings ORDER BY numRatings DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the directors of the movie 'The Matrix'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie {title: 'The Matrix'}) RETURN p.name AS Director

question: Show entities that are connected to 'ANTAM ENTERPRISES N.V.'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:connected_to]-(o:Other {name: "ANTAM ENTERPRISES N.V."}) RETURN e.name AS EntityName

question: What is the average number of movies directed by a single director in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[cf:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE cf.job = 'Director' WITH p, count(m) AS moviesDirected RETURN avg(moviesDirected) AS averageMoviesPerDirector

question: What are the first 3 movies that have a plot mentioning 'adventure'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'adventure' RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Identify the racks that hold switches with IP starting with '10.1'.
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(switch:Switch) WHERE switch.ip STARTS WITH '10.1' RETURN DISTINCT rack.name

question: Find all paths of length 3 starting from the country with code "GBR" and ending at an Entity node.
cypher: MATCH (start:Country {code: "GBR"})-[*3]-(end:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT end

question: Which users have rated movies in the 'Adventure' genre?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) RETURN u.name AS userName, u.userId AS userId

question: Which 3 genres have the fewest movies associated with them in the database?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount

question: Which 5 filings have a beneficiary bank country of 'Singapore' and amount greater than 500000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'Singapore' AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN f LIMIT 5

question: Who are the first 3 users that a specific user identified by screen name 'neo4j' follows?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed LIMIT 3

question: Which users followed by 'neo4j' have the highest betweenness values?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(follower:User) RETURN follower.screen_name, follower.betweenness ORDER BY follower.betweenness DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show the first 3 users followed by 'neo4j' who also follow 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u1:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(u2:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u3:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN u2 LIMIT 3

question: List the games played by users who are chatters of streams with more than 1,000 followers and have a VIP who also plays "Rust" and have the language "en" and have at least one moderator.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)  WHERE s.followers > 1000  MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(:Language { name: "en" })  MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User)  MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s)  MATCH (s)-[:VIP]->(vip:User)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game { name: "Rust" })  MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game)  RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention users who have retweeted the user with screen name "neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: "neo4j"})-[:POSTS]->(tweet1:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(tweet2:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(user:User) WITH collect(DISTINCT user) AS retweeters UNWIND retweeters AS retweeter MATCH (tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(retweeter) WITH avg(tweet.favorites) AS average_favorites RETURN average_favorites

question: Show all products with a 'reorderLevel' of 25 or higher.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel >= 25 RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel

question: What is the average number of Interfaces per Egress?
cypher: MATCH (e:Egress)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) WITH e, count(i) AS numInterfaces RETURN avg(numInterfaces) AS averageInterfacesPerEgress

question: Name the first 3 interfaces exposed by Port 80.
cypher: MATCH (p:Port {port: 80})<-[:EXPOSES]-(i:Interface) RETURN i.ip LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 suppliers who supply products in the 'Dairy Products' category.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'}) RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: What is the total revenue generated by orders shipped in the year 1998?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shippedDate STARTS WITH '1998' WITH o, rel, p, toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * rel.quantity AS revenuePerOrder RETURN sum(revenuePerOrder) AS totalRevenue

question: List the top 5 categories with the most products on order.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 0 WITH c, count(p) AS ProductsOnOrder ORDER BY ProductsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN c.categoryName, ProductsOnOrder

question: What is the total number of filings where the 'originator_bank_country' is the United States and the 'beneficiary_bank_country' is China?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = "United States" AND f.beneficiary_bank_country = "China" WITH count(f) AS totalFilings RETURN totalFilings

question: List the first 3 streams with the oldest teams associated with them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH s, t ORDER BY t.createdAt ASC RETURN s.name AS stream_name, t.name AS team_name, t.createdAt AS team_createdAt LIMIT 3

question: Find all users who are 'MODERATOR' to streams that have a 'HAS_LANGUAGE' relationship with a language other than 'en'.
cypher: MATCH (l:Language) WHERE l.name <> 'en' MATCH (l)<-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]-(s:Stream) MATCH (s)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User) RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which 5 movies have been released in the most number of countries?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title, size(m.countries) AS country_count ORDER BY country_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 5 entities by the number of filings they filed.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name, filingsCount

question: What are the top 5 tweets that 'Neo4j' has amplified?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:AMPLIFIES]->(user:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) RETURN tweet.text, tweet.favorites ORDER BY tweet.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 users who have a similar betweenness to 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:SIMILAR_TO]-(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, user.betweenness ORDER BY abs(user.betweenness - me.betweenness) ASC LIMIT 5

question: What are the three entities that benefitted the most in terms of the amount from filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) RETURN e, SUM(f.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders have been shipped by each `shipVia` method?
cypher: MATCH (order:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->() WITH r.shipVia AS shipVia, count(order) AS orderCount RETURN shipVia, orderCount

question: List the products that have a 'reorderLevel' greater than the average 'reorderLevel' of all products.
cypher: MATCH (product:Product) WITH avg(product.reorderLevel) AS averageReorderLevel MATCH (product:Product) WHERE product.reorderLevel > averageReorderLevel RETURN product.productName

question: Find all users who mention 'neo4j' in their tweets and are located in 'Graphs Are Everywhere'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WHERE u.location = 'Graphs Are Everywhere' RETURN u

question: Which suppliers have a contact name starting with 'C'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier) WHERE s.contactName STARTS WITH 'C' RETURN s

question: Find the customer who has ordered the lowest quantity of products with a unit price less than 10.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(orders.unitPrice) < 10 WITH c, o, sum(orders.quantity) AS totalQuantityPerOrder WITH c, min(totalQuantityPerOrder) AS minQuantityForCustomer MATCH (c)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[orders:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE toFloat(orders.unitPrice) < 10 WITH c, minQuantityForCustomer, sum(orders.quantity) AS totalQuantityPerOrder WHERE minQuantityForCustomer = totalQuantityPerOrder RETURN c.companyName

question: Which Network routes through the Interface with IP '10.4.8.254'?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network)-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface {ip: '10.4.8.254'}) RETURN n

question: Show the top 5 movies with the most roles in their cast.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH m, COUNT(r.roles) AS role_count ORDER BY role_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movie_title, role_count

question: Which entities have a country code of HKG?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.country_codes = 'HKG' RETURN e.name, e.country_codes

question: What are the movies with a revenue exactly 76578911.0 USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue = 76578911.0 RETURN m

question: What are the top 3 locations where the most active users are based?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) WITH u.location AS location, COUNT(t) AS tweet_count RETURN location, tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 oldest directors based on their birth date.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL RETURN d ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 directors who have directed the most movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[cf:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE cf.job = 'Director' WITH p, count(m) AS moviesDirected ORDER BY moviesDirected DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS directorName, moviesDirected

question: List all movies directed by someone who has also acted in a movie.
cypher: MATCH (director:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) MATCH (director)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) RETURN movie.title AS MovieTitle, director.name AS DirectorName

question: What is the total number of games played by streams that have "en" as their language?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name = "en" MATCH (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH DISTINCT g RETURN count(g) AS total_games

question: Name the top 5 production companies that have produced the highest grossing movies.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) RETURN pc.name AS ProductionCompanyName, SUM(m.revenue) AS TotalRevenue ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all actors who have acted in movies with at least two different directors.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH a, m, count(DISTINCT d) AS numDirectors WHERE numDirectors >= 2 RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS ActorName

question: Which movies have a poster URL that contains 'face' and an IMDb rating above 8?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster CONTAINS 'face' AND m.imdbRating > 8 RETURN m

question: What are the movies directed by a person who has also acted in a movie?
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie)<-[:CAST_FOR]-(actor:Person) WHERE director = actor RETURN m.title AS movie, director.name AS director

question: What are the top 3 movies with the highest number of votes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 people born in 1964.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born = 1964 RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that are replies to tweets posted by users with a betweenness centrality greater than 1000?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO]->(reply_tweet:Tweet) MATCH (reply_tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(u:User) WHERE u.betweenness > 1000 WITH avg(t.favorites) AS average_favorites RETURN average_favorites

question: List the first 5 countries connected to entities that have filed more than 10 filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS filingsCount WHERE filingsCount > 10 MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS countryName LIMIT 5

question: Find all movies where Nancy Meyers was involved either by acting, directing, producing, or writing.

question: Which 3 videos have the most keywords associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH v, count(k) AS keywordCount RETURN v.title AS video, keywordCount ORDER BY keywordCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 directors have directed movies in more than one genre?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(distinct g) AS num_genres WHERE num_genres > 1 RETURN d.name AS director, num_genres ORDER BY num_genres DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 languages spoken in the highest-grossing movies.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN l.id, l.name, sum(m.revenue) as total_revenue ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which users are moderators for streams with more than 500,000 total views?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000 RETURN u

question: What is the highest number of favorites received by a tweet that mentions a user followed by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (n:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) WITH followed MATCH (followed)<-[:MENTIONS]-(t:Tweet) RETURN max(t.favorites) AS max_favorites

question: Can you find three suppliers who supply 'Chang'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Chang'})<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies by revenue in descending order?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which director has the most diverse portfolio of movie genres directed?

question: What are the top 5 hashtags used in tweets by 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) RETURN h.name, count(t) AS tweet_count ORDER BY tweet_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which suppliers have supplied products that have never been discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {discontinued: false})<-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: What is the average freight cost of orders placed by customers in each country?

question: Which people have directed movies with a historical theme?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: What are the top 5 languages used by streams with more than 10000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 10000 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 users are moderators for the most streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(s) AS num_moderated_streams ORDER BY num_moderated_streams DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS user, num_moderated_streams

question: List the names of intermediaries based in South Africa with an active status.
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {countries: "South Africa", status: "ACTIVE"}) RETURN i.name

question: List all the sources used by 'neo4j' for tweeting.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:USING]->(s:Source) RETURN DISTINCT s.name AS source_name

question: List the first 3 actors who have acted in historical movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE g.name = 'Historical' RETURN a.name LIMIT 3

cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.betweenness > 3.0E8 RETURN u.screen_name, u.betweenness

cypher: MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'freedom' RETURN a.name AS actor LIMIT 3

question: What is the average number of keywords associated with each movie?
