cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, avg(m.runtime) AS avgRuntime ORDER BY avgRuntime DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre_name

question: List the movies released in the same year as "The Matrix".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "The Matrix"}) WITH m.released AS matrixReleaseYear MATCH (otherMovies:Movie {released: matrixReleaseYear}) RETURN otherMovies.title

question: Who are the top 5 producers of the movie with the title 'Speed Racer'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie {title: 'Speed Racer'}) RETURN p.name AS producer_name ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 5

question: Find the first three people who produced a movie and have a name starting with 'J'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(:Movie) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH 'J' RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 keywords associated with the movie 'Waiting to Exhale'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Waiting to Exhale'})-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) RETURN k.name AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS frequency ORDER BY frequency DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who is the intermediary of 'HOTFOCUS CO., LTD.' and what is their status?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity {name: 'HOTFOCUS CO., LTD.'}) RETURN i.name AS IntermediaryName, i.status AS IntermediaryStatus

question: Who are the officers of entities that were incorporated on '06-JAN-2006'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:officer_of]-(o:Officer) WHERE e.incorporation_date = '06-JAN-2006' RETURN o.name AS officer_name, e.name AS entity_name

question: What is the popularity of the adult movie 'Erotic Nights of the Living Dead'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Adult {title: 'Erotic Nights of the Living Dead'}) RETURN m.popularity

question: Who are the top 5 users that a specific user named 'Neo4j' follows?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User) RETURN followed ORDER BY followed.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the top 3 users with the most statuses who follow 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(n:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) RETURN u.name, u.screen_name, u.statuses ORDER BY u.statuses DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find all tweets containing the hashtag 'education' and show the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) RETURN t LIMIT 5

question: Who has acted in the highest number of unique movies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS name, numMovies

question: What is the productName of the product with productID equal to '2'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product { productID: '2' }) RETURN p.productName

question: List the entities with a note mentioning 'Closed date stands for Liquidation date.'
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.note = 'Closed date stands for Liquidation date.' RETURN e

question: What are the first 5 streams that have a user who is both a moderator and a VIP?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:MODERATOR]-(u:User)-[:VIP]->(s) RETURN s.name AS stream, u.name AS user LIMIT 5

question: Name the first 5 streams with the lowest follower count and still active.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL RETURN s.name, s.followers ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 most frequently ordered products in the 'Dairy Products' category?
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN p.productName, COUNT(o) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 movies with the highest budget to revenue ratio?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title AS movie, m.budget / m.revenue AS budgetRevenueRatio ORDER BY budgetRevenueRatio DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of users who are VIPs for at least three different streams?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream) WITH u, size(collect(DISTINCT s)) AS num_streams WHERE num_streams >= 3 RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS vip_user_count

question: Show the top 5 genres of movies that have been rated by the most users.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g.name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT u) AS userCount ORDER BY userCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN genre, userCount

question: Which entities have a company number that starts with '240'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.company_number STARTS WITH '240' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.company_number AS company_number

question: What are the first 3 movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes and an imdbRating over 7?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 AND m.imdbRating > 7 RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 switches are held in Rack 'DC1-RCK-1-1'?
cypher: MATCH (rack:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1'})-[:HOLDS]->(switch:Switch) RETURN switch.ip LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of machines held in zone 4 racks?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone {zone: 4})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface)<-[:ROUTES]-(r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine) RETURN count(m) AS TotalMachinesInZone4

question: Who are 3 actors who have acted in movies released before 1980?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released < 1980 RETURN p.name AS actor LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 5 countries by the number of entities filed against.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filings ORDER BY filings DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, filings AS NumberOfFilings

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest box office revenue that was released in the 1990s?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year >= 1990 AND m.year <= 1999 WITH m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN m.title

question: List the first 3 movies with the highest number of directors.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.job = 'Director' WITH m, count(p) AS directorCount ORDER BY directorCount DESC RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, directorCount LIMIT 3

question: List the games played by streams that have more than 5 VIP relationships.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(:User) WITH s, COUNT(*) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 5 MATCH (s)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS game

question: List the URLs of the 3 newest streams in the database.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.url ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 3 addresses that are shared by multiple entities or officers.
cypher: MATCH (a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity) WITH a, COUNT(e) AS entityCount WHERE entityCount > 1 RETURN a.address AS sharedAddress UNION MATCH (a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(o:Officer) WITH a, COUNT(o) AS officerCount WHERE officerCount > 1 RETURN a.address AS sharedAddress LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have played in a movie and also directed a movie?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(a) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actorName

question: Which 3 countries have the most movies produced in them?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]-(m:Movie) RETURN c.name AS country, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 3 filings with the most entities involved as concerns from the same country?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH f, c, count(e) AS entitiesCount ORDER BY entitiesCount DESC RETURN f.id AS FilingID, f.begin_date AS BeginDate, f.end_date AS EndDate, c.name AS Country, entitiesCount LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have more than 5000000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers > 5000000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.followers

question: Find the top 5 streams by oldest to newest based on the 'createdAt' property.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) RETURN s.name, s.createdAt ORDER BY s.createdAt ASC LIMIT 5

question: Which orders were shipped to 'France' and required before '1997-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'France' AND o.requiredDate < '1997-01-01' RETURN o.orderID, o.shipName, o.requiredDate, o.shipCity, o.shipAddress, o.shipPostalCode, o.shipCountry

question: Which 3 movies have the highest number of associated languages?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN m.title, count(l) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the actors who have starred in movies with a budget greater than 100 million.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 MATCH (p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: Who are the first 5 moderators in streams that have changed games at least twice?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(m) WITH s, m, count{(s)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game)} AS gameChanges WHERE gameChanges >= 2 RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: What is the total revenue generated by movies in the "Toy Story Collection"?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection {name: "Toy Story Collection"})-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(m:Movie) RETURN sum(m.revenue) AS total_revenue

question: Which machines are running the application named 'crm'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'crm'})<-[:RUNS]-(machine:Machine) RETURN machine.name

question: Which users followed by 'Neo4j' have a URL starting with 'https'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user:User) WHERE user.url STARTS WITH 'https' RETURN user.screen_name, user.url

question: List the first 3 teams with the most streams playing 'Dota 2'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Dota 2'}) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WITH t, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN t.name AS team_name, stream_count

question: Which actors were born after 1970?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born > 1970 AND exists{(p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)} RETURN p.name, p.born

question: Which 5 tweets contain the hashtag 'education'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) RETURN t LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 movies have the most diverse cast in terms of countries of origin?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE p.bornIn IS NOT NULL WITH m, count(DISTINCT p.bornIn) AS numCountries ORDER BY numCountries DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movie, numCountries AS distinctCountriesRepresented

question: What is the average 'number' value for filings where the originator bank is 'Deutsche Bank AG'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = 'Deutsche Bank AG' RETURN avg(f.number) AS average_number

question: What is the total number of games played by users who are moderators of at least one stream?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(:Stream) WITH DISTINCT u MATCH (u)-[:CHATTER]->(:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH DISTINCT g RETURN count(g) AS totalGames

question: List all entities associated with 'Mossack Fonseca' that have an inactivation date on '16-FEB-2009'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: 'Mossack Fonseca', inactivation_date: '16-FEB-2009'}) RETURN e

question: Who are the top 5 actors by the number of movies they acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, count(m) AS movies_count ORDER BY movies_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 originator banks that have initiated filings with beneficiary banks located in Singapore.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "Singapore"}) RETURN originator.name AS OriginatorBank, count(f) AS NumberOfFilings ORDER BY NumberOfFilings DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which ports are listened by all instances of the application 'webserver'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'webserver'})-[:LISTENS]->(port:Port) RETURN DISTINCT port.port AS listened_ports

question: Name the first 5 streams that have no moderators and no VIPs.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE NOT (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User) AND NOT (s)-[:VIP]->(:User) RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url ORDER BY s.createdAt LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have the most associated genres?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, count(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS movie, genreCount

question: What are the entities that have both originated and been a beneficiary in filings?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WHERE exists {   MATCH (e)-[:BENEFITS]->(f) } RETURN DISTINCT e

question: Which 3 filings have the highest number of originator entities involved?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH f, count(e) AS originator_count ORDER BY originator_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, originator_count

question: Which 3 streams have the most complex descriptions based on word count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description IS NOT NULL RETURN s.name, s.description, size(split(s.description, ' ')) AS word_count ORDER BY word_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who has the highest average review rating?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, AVG(r.rating) AS avgRating RETURN p.name AS reviewer, avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the "country_codes" values of all Entities that are linked to an Officer with the "name" value containing "KIM".
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'KIM' MATCH (o)-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN DISTINCT e.country_codes

question: What are the top 5 most frequently purchased categories by customers in the USA?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(cat:Category) WHERE c.country = 'USA' WITH cat.categoryName AS category, COUNT(o) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN category, orderCount

question: Which users are chatters in more than 3 different streams? List the top 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:CHATTER]->(s:Stream) WITH u, count(DISTINCT s) AS streams_count WHERE streams_count > 3 RETURN u.name, streams_count ORDER BY streams_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 categories based on the number of products they contain.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c.categoryName AS category, COUNT(p) AS productCount RETURN category, productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the Intermediaries that have a "similar" relationship to another Intermediary and are also linked to an Entity with the service provider "Mossack Fonseca".
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary)-[:similar]->(i2:Intermediary) MATCH (i)-->(e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider = "Mossack Fonseca" RETURN DISTINCT i.name

question: List all suppliers that provide products with a unit price greater than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:SUPPLIES]-(s:Supplier) WHERE p.unitPrice > 50 RETURN DISTINCT s.companyName

question: What is the 'ip' address of the 'Zone' with 'zone' 4?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone) WHERE z.zone = 4 RETURN z.ip

question: Which movies have a plot mentioning 'war'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'war' RETURN m.title, m.plot

question: Which entities have filed filings that benefited entities located in the same country as "Caledonian Bank Limited"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "Caledonian Bank Limited"})-[:COUNTRY]->(country:Country) WITH country MATCH (country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(beneficiary:Entity)<-[:BENEFITS]-(filing:Filing) WITH DISTINCT filing MATCH (filer:Entity)-[:FILED]->(filing) RETURN DISTINCT filer.name

question: What are the first 3 directors who died after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.died > date("2000-01-01") RETURN d.name, d.died ORDER BY d.died LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 users who moderate streams with the highest average number of followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, avg(s.followers) AS averageFollowers ORDER BY averageFollowers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name AS moderatorName, averageFollowers

question: List the IP addresses of all switches in zone 3.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {zone: 3})-[:HOLDS]->(s:Switch) RETURN s.ip

question: What is the average `amount` of filings where the `originator_bank` and the `beneficiary_bank` are located within the same country?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = f.beneficiary_bank_country RETURN avg(f.amount) AS average_amount

question: What are the top 5 highest-rated movies by users, based on the average user rating?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title, avgRating

question: Find all movies that have a similar plot to 'Toy Story'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, collect(k.name) AS toyStoryKeywords MATCH (m2:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k2:Keyword) WHERE k2.name IN toyStoryKeywords AND m2.title <> 'Toy Story' RETURN DISTINCT m2.title AS similar_movie_titles

question: What are the names of the people who wrote and also acted in the same movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN p.name AS PersonName

question: What is the total number of interfaces that are connected to the switch with IP '10.1.1'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Switch {ip: '10.1.1'})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN size(collect(i)) AS total_interfaces

question: List the 'name' of the top 3 'Process' nodes with the highest 'pid' values.
cypher: MATCH (p:Process) RETURN p.name, p.pid ORDER BY p.pid DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 products have the highest units on order in the 'Meat/Poultry' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Meat/Poultry'}) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder IS NOT NULL RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder ORDER BY p.unitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 originator banks from 'Singapore'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'Singapore'}) RETURN e.name AS OriginatorBankName LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies with a plot mentioning 'family'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'family' RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 Entities with the country_codes "HKG".
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {country_codes: "HKG"}) WITH e ORDER BY e.node_id RETURN e.name LIMIT 3

question: Find the streams that are moderated by users who have a follower count greater than the average follower count of all users.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WITH avg(u.followers) AS average_followers MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers > average_followers MATCH (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) RETURN DISTINCT s.name

question: Which machines are running an application that listens on a port less than 500?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:LISTENS]->(p:Port) WHERE p.port < 500 MATCH (m:Machine)-[:RUNS]->(app) RETURN DISTINCT m.name

question: What is the name of the Process that has the most dependencies?
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->() WITH p, count(r) AS dependency_count ORDER BY dependency_count DESC RETURN p.name AS process_name, dependency_count LIMIT 1

question: What is the average amount of filings where the originator entity's name starts with "The Bank"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity) WHERE o.name STARTS WITH "The Bank" WITH avg(f.amount) AS averageAmount RETURN averageAmount

question: List the first 3 countries where movies with an average vote above 8 were produced.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE m.average_vote > 8 RETURN DISTINCT c.name LIMIT 3

question: What are the product IDs of products that have been marked as discontinued but have a reorder level of 10?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.discontinued = true AND p.reorderLevel = 10 RETURN p.productID

question: Which 3 genres are provided access to by the 'Gold' package?
cypher: MATCH (p:Package {name: 'Gold'})-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 entities have been the originator in the filings with the longest durations from beginning to end date?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH e, f, duration.inSeconds(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, duration

question: Find tweets that contain links and were posted by 'neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(l:Link) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, l.url AS link_url, t.created_at AS tweet_date

question: List the first 3 products with the highest discount in orders.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, r.discount ORDER BY r.discount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have also written a movie?
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) MATCH (actor)-[:WROTE]->(movie2:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT actor.name

question: What are the 3 oldest movies produced by someone born after 1960?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born > 1960 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies with an imdbId that starts with '07'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbId STARTS WITH '07' RETURN m LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 users who are moderators for streams playing 'Rust'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(:Game {name: 'Rust'}) RETURN u.name AS user, s.name AS stream LIMIT 3

question: Which production company has the highest number of movies with a PG-13 rating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WITH pc, count(m) AS movieCount WITH max(movieCount) AS maxMovieCount MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:ProductionCompany) WITH pc, count(m) AS movieCount, maxMovieCount WHERE movieCount = maxMovieCount RETURN pc.name

question: Which orders were required by a date earlier than '1997-01-01'?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate < '1997-01-01' RETURN o.orderID, o.requiredDate

question: Which 3 directors have the longest bios in the database?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.bio IS NOT NULL RETURN d.name, d.bio ORDER BY size(d.bio) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the first 3 languages associated with streams that have a description containing 'coverage'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'coverage' RETURN l.name LIMIT 3

question: Name the first 5 genres associated with the movie 'Toy Story'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 previous versions of the software named '7.1'?
cypher: MATCH (v:Version {name: '7.1'})-[:PREVIOUS*1..3]->(prev:Version) RETURN prev.name LIMIT 3

question: Find the first 3 movies where 'Keanu Reeves' acted.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: Which products have a 'reorder level' of 10 and are part of the 'Beverages' category?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Beverages'}) WHERE p.reorderLevel = 10 RETURN p.productName, p.productID, p.unitPrice

question: List all languages spoken on streams with a total view count over 500000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.total_view_count > 500000 RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS language

question: What is the name of the user who gave the movie "Toy Story" the highest rating?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: 'Toy Story'})<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WITH m, max(r.rating) AS maxRating MATCH (m)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) WHERE r.rating = maxRating RETURN u.name AS userName

question: Which movies were produced by Joel Silver?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Joel Silver'})-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title

question: Which 3 products are most often ordered by customers from Germany?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE c.country = 'Germany' RETURN p.productName, COUNT(o) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the customers who have placed orders that include products with a reorder level lower than the average reorder level of all products.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WITH avg(p.reorderLevel) AS avgReorderLevel MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE p.reorderLevel < avgReorderLevel RETURN DISTINCT c.companyName

question: Identify the top 5 machines held in rack 'DC1-RCK-1-10' and their types.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-10'})-[:HOLDS]->(m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN m.name AS MachineName, t.name AS TypeName LIMIT 5

question: List all movies with more than 3 roles listed in their ACTED_IN relationships.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE size(r.roles) > 3 RETURN m.title, r.roles

question: What are the total dependencies of the application 'crm' including indirect dependencies?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'crm'})-[:DEPENDS_ON*]->(dependency) RETURN DISTINCT dependency.name AS DependencyName

question: List all persons who have reviewed a movie with a rating less than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN p

question: Which entities have a service provider of 'Mossack Fonseca' and were incorporated in 2006?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' AND e.incorporation_date CONTAINS '2006' RETURN e

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most complex taglines?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.tagline, size(split(m.tagline, ' ')) AS word_count ORDER BY word_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the movies that have been rated by more than one user. (first 3)
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(u) AS ratings WHERE ratings > 1 RETURN m.title, ratings ORDER BY ratings DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the `begin_date` and `end_date` of the filing with the highest `amount`?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH max(f.amount) AS max_amount MATCH (f:Filing {amount: max_amount}) RETURN f.begin_date, f.end_date

question: Which products have a 'quantityPerUnit' specified as '10 boxes x 20 bags'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.quantityPerUnit = '10 boxes x 20 bags' RETURN p

question: Identify the streams with more than 3 VIP users.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE size([(s)<-[:VIP]-(:User) | 1]) > 3 RETURN s

question: Which country hosts the most entities that are originators in filings?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (e)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS Country, filingsCount

question: Which 3 genres have the most videos associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(v:Video) RETURN g.name AS genre, count(v) AS videoCount ORDER BY videoCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies are categorized under the genre 'Animation'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Animation'}) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle

question: List the top 5 streams with the most chatter interactions.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS chatterCount ORDER BY chatterCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.name AS streamName, chatterCount

question: Which customer (`customerID`) has placed the most orders?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(order:Order) WITH c.customerID AS customerID, count(order) AS orderCount ORDER BY orderCount DESC RETURN customerID, orderCount LIMIT 1

question: What are the top 3 most recent types of connection available in the schema?
cypher: MATCH (n)-[r]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT type(r) AS ConnectionType, max(r.lastEditTimestamp) AS MostRecent ORDER BY MostRecent DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the descriptions of the streams with the least followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WITH s ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN s.description

question: Name 3 persons who have produced movies but have not directed any.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) } RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Which users with over 10000 followers are located in 'Graphs Are Everywhere'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 AND u.location = 'Graphs Are Everywhere' RETURN u

question: Find the movies that have a tagline that contains the word "adventure".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'adventure' RETURN m

question: Which order (`orderID`) has the highest total order value (sum of `ORDERS.unitPrice` * `ORDERS.quantity`)?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[rel:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH o, sum(toFloat(rel.unitPrice) * rel.quantity) AS totalOrderValue ORDER BY totalOrderValue DESC RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, totalOrderValue LIMIT 1

question: List the 3 streams with the lowest follower count but with over 1 million total views.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL AND s.total_view_count > 1000000 RETURN s ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 teams were created most recently and have at least one stream associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) WITH t, count(s) AS stream_count WHERE stream_count > 0 RETURN t.name AS team_name, t.createdAt AS created_at ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which persons have only directed movies and never acted in any?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WHERE NOT (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie) RETURN p.name

question: Which actors have featured in movies released in multiple languages?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE size(m.languages) > 1 RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: "Which user replies to the most posts by users that they do not follow?"
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:REPLY_TO]->(t:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(other:User) WHERE NOT (u)-[:FOLLOWS]->(other) WITH u, COUNT(t) AS replies RETURN u.name AS user, replies ORDER BY replies DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which products have a quantity per unit description containing 'bags'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.quantityPerUnit CONTAINS 'bags' RETURN p.productName, p.quantityPerUnit

question: What is the average number of followers for streams that play "Resident Evil Village"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: "Resident Evil Village"}) RETURN avg(s.followers)

question: What are the first 5 applications that depend on the service 'logstash'?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(service:Service {name: 'logstash'}) RETURN app LIMIT 5

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention users similar to "Neo4j"?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(similarUser:User) WITH similarUser MATCH (similarUser)<-[:MENTIONS]-(tweet:Tweet) WITH avg(tweet.favorites) AS averageFavorites RETURN averageFavorites

question: Name the top three most frequently ordered products.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(:Order) WITH p, count(*) AS ordersCount ORDER BY ordersCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, ordersCount

question: List the names of the teams associated with streams that have "Dota 2" as a played game.
cypher: MATCH (g:Game {name: "Dota 2"})<-[:PLAYS]-(s:Stream) WITH s MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) RETURN DISTINCT t.name

question: Which adult films have a runtime longer than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.runtime > 90 RETURN a.title, a.runtime

question: List all the movies where the character 'Woody' appears.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.character = 'Woody' RETURN m

question: Which person reviewed 'The Matrix Revolutions' and what was their summary?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie {title: 'The Matrix Revolutions'}) RETURN p.name, r.summary

question: Which products have been reordered (unitsOnOrder greater than 0) but not discontinued?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 0 AND p.discontinued = false RETURN p.productName, p.unitsOnOrder

question: Find all suppliers that have a home page listed and supply products in the 'Seafood' category.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Seafood'}) WHERE s.homePage IS NOT NULL AND s.homePage <> 'NULL' RETURN s.companyName, s.homePage

question: Which 3 production companies have the highest total budgets for their movies?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL WITH c, sum(m.budget) AS totalBudget RETURN c.name AS company, totalBudget ORDER BY totalBudget DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total box office revenue of movies starring Tom Hanks?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) WITH sum(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue RETURN totalRevenue

question: List entities that have filed more than 20 filings.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount WHERE filingsCount > 20 RETURN e

question: Identify the 3 suppliers from the city 'London' who supply the most products.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.city = 'London' WITH s, COUNT(p) AS productCount ORDER BY productCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName AS supplierName, productCount

question: Which streams have a description containing 'casual play' and a total view count above 100,000?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'casual play' AND s.total_view_count > 100000 RETURN s.name, s.description, s.total_view_count

question: "Which person had the most involvement in their movie?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(r) AS involvements RETURN p.name AS Person, involvements ORDER BY involvements DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find tweets mentioning any user and list the top 5.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 languages used by streams with over 10,000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE s.followers > 10000 RETURN l.name AS language, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies where 'Joel Silver' acted?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Joel Silver'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 longest taglines in adult films?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult) WHERE a.tagline IS NOT NULL RETURN a.tagline ORDER BY size(a.tagline) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 movies with a specific actor named 'Tom Hanks' in the cast.
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(movie:Movie) RETURN movie.title, movie.average_vote ORDER BY movie.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 entities with the service provider 'Mossack Fonseca'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: 'Mossack Fonseca'}) RETURN e ORDER BY e.node_id LIMIT 5

question: "reflect all possible patterns linking DataCenters to IP adreses"
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(r:Router)-[:ROUTES]->(intf:Interface) RETURN dc.name AS DataCenterName, intf.ip AS IPAddress UNION MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(e:Egress)-[:ROUTES]->(intf:Interface) RETURN dc.name AS DataCenterName, intf.ip AS IPAddress UNION MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(:Machine)-[:ROUTES]->(intf:Interface) RETURN dc.name AS DataCenterName, intf.ip AS IPAddress UNION MATCH (dc:DataCenter)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(:Switch)-[:ROUTES]->(intf:Interface) RETURN dc.name AS DataCenterName, intf.ip AS IPAddress

question: Which actors have acted in movies with Keanu Reeves?
cypher: MATCH (actor:Person {name: "Keanu Reeves"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) MATCH (coActor:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie) WHERE coActor <> actor RETURN DISTINCT coActor.name

question: What is the name of the director with the highest average movie rating?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[cf:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE cf.job = 'Director' WITH p, avg(m.average_vote) AS avg_rating RETURN p.name AS director_name, avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find all entities that are beneficiaries in filings where the amount is greater than 1000000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.amount > 1000000 RETURN e

question: What are the first 3 movies with a majority of non-English languages?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size([lang IN m.languages WHERE lang <> 'English']) > size(m.languages) / 2 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, m.languages AS languages ORDER BY m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which three genres have the highest average revenue per movie?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN g.name AS Genre, AVG(m.revenue) AS AverageRevenue ORDER BY AverageRevenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many distinct `beneficiary_bank_country` values are there in the filings dataset?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) RETURN DISTINCT f.beneficiary_bank_country

question: What is the orderID of the order with the highest freight cost?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.orderID,  toFloat(o.freight) AS freight ORDER BY freight DESC LIMIT 1

question: Name the top 3 processes that are instances of the software 'RHEL'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Software {name: 'RHEL'})-[:INSTANCE]->(p:Process) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.startTime DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all customers with a fax number ending in '6545'.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE c.fax ENDS WITH '6545' RETURN c.companyName AS customerName, c.contactName AS contactName, c.fax AS faxNumber

question: List all movies with a tagline containing the word "Real" and their respective release years.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'Real' RETURN m.title, m.released

question: What are the URLs of streams where 'itsbigchase' is a moderator?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'itsbigchase'})-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) RETURN s.url AS StreamURL

question: Find the filings where the 'originator_bank' is located in a country with a 'name' that starts with the letter "S" and the 'beneficiary_bank' is located in a country with a 'name' that starts with the letter "U".
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(o:Country) WHERE o.name STARTS WITH "S" MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(b:Country) WHERE b.name STARTS WITH "U" RETURN f.sar_id

question: What are the locations of the top 3 users who interact with 'neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user:User) RETURN user.location ORDER BY user.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 originator banks with filings that have the shortest duration between begin and end dates.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WITH f, e, duration.between(f.begin, f.end) AS duration ORDER BY duration ASC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name AS originator_bank, duration

question: Identify the suppliers whose products are all in the 'Beverages' category.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE NOT exists {     MATCH (p)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category)     WHERE c.categoryName <> 'Beverages' } RETURN DISTINCT s

question: Which 5 entities have their locations in countries with the top-level domain '.cn'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {tld: '.cn'}) RETURN e LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 products that have been ordered with a discount of 0 and are from the 'Grains/Cereals' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Grains/Cereals'}) WHERE exists {   (p)<-[:ORDERS {discount: '0'}]-(:Order) } RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 previous versions of the version named '7.1'.
cypher: MATCH (v:Version {name: '7.1'})-[:PREVIOUS*1..3]->(prev:Version) RETURN prev.name

question: List the top 5 keywords associated with movies that have a runtime over 150 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.runtime > 150 RETURN k.name, COUNT(*) AS keyword_count ORDER BY keyword_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 movies with a release date on a Monday?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date.dayOfWeek = 'MONDAY' RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 actors who acted in movies reviewed with a summary 'Slapstick redeemed only by the Robin Williams and '.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:REVIEWED {summary: 'Slapstick redeemed only by the Robin Williams and '}]-(reviewer:Person) RETURN p.name AS Actor, count(m) AS MoviesReviewed ORDER BY MoviesReviewed DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 entities by the number of filings they have filed.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) as filings_count ORDER BY filings_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name as entity_name, filings_count

question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the same year as "The Matrix"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "The Matrix"}) WITH m.released AS releaseYear MATCH (otherMovies:Movie) WHERE otherMovies.released = releaseYear WITH avg(otherMovies.votes) AS averageVotes RETURN averageVotes

question: Which Entities have filed more than 3 Filings?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount WHERE filingsCount > 3 RETURN e

question: List the top 5 movies with a release date on or before December 31, 1990.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date <= date('1990-12-31') RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show all orders that required shipping to 'USA'.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WHERE o.shipCountry = 'USA' RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, o.shipName AS shipName, o.requiredDate AS requiredDate, o.shipCity AS shipCity, o.shipPostalCode AS shipPostalCode, o.shipAddress AS shipAddress, o.shipCountry AS shipCountry, o.shipVia AS shipVia, o.shipRegion AS shipRegion

question: Who are the customers in the 'NULL' region?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {region: 'NULL'}) RETURN c

question: What are the distinct summaries available for movie reviews?
cypher: MATCH (:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(:Movie) RETURN DISTINCT r.summary

question: Which director has the most diverse portfolio of movie genres directed?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS genres RETURN d.name AS director, size(genres) AS genre_count ORDER BY genre_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the top 5 tweets by 'neo4j' with the most favorites.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the origin countries of the first 5 filings by 'The Bank of New York Mellon Corp.'
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "The Bank of New York Mellon Corp."})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH f ORDER BY f.begin ASC LIMIT 5 MATCH (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN c.name AS origin_country

question: "what are the primary languages in the films starred by actors in [Just Visiting]"
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Just Visiting"})<-[:CAST_FOR]-(p:Person)-[:CAST_FOR]->(movies:Movie)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(lang:Language) RETURN DISTINCT lang.name AS PrimaryLanguage

question: List the top 3 officers with the most 'officer_of' relationships to entities that have a 'service_provider' of 'Commonwealth Trust Limited'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: 'Commonwealth Trust Limited'})<-[r:officer_of]-(o:Officer) WITH o, count(r) AS relationship_count RETURN o.name, relationship_count ORDER BY relationship_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the streams that have "Rust" as a played game and are moderated by users who are VIPs of other streams.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) MATCH (s)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WHERE EXISTS {   MATCH (s2:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u) } RETURN DISTINCT s.name

question: Name 3 movies directed by Pixar Animation Studios.
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany {name: "Pixar Animation Studios"})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 actors to have starred in at least 3 movies from the 'Toy Story Collection'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection {name: 'Toy Story Collection'}) WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount >= 3 RETURN p.name AS actorName ORDER BY movieCount DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

question: List the internal_id of entities with the jurisdiction_description 'Samoa' and status 'Defaulted'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.jurisdiction_description = 'Samoa' AND e.status = 'Defaulted' RETURN e.internal_id

question: Find the streams where the streamer has more than 1 million followers and plays 'Rust'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 RETURN s

question: Find all movies that share the same genres as "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: "Toy Story"})-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre:Genre) WITH toyStory, genre MATCH (genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(otherMovie:Movie) WHERE toyStory <> otherMovie RETURN DISTINCT otherMovie.title

question: What are the top 3 videos rated by users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(v:Video) RETURN v.title AS video, avg(r.rating) AS averageRating ORDER BY averageRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: "How many movies that Tom Hanks acted in have \"love\" in the tagline?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS "love" RETURN COUNT(m) AS MoviesWithLoveInTagline

question: Who are the top 3 users who are VIPs in the stream with the name '9linda'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream {name: '9linda'})<-[:VIP]-(u:User) RETURN u.name AS user, u.followers AS followers ORDER BY followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the racks that hold switches with IP starting with '10.1'.
cypher: MATCH (r:Rack)-[:HOLDS]->(s:Switch) WHERE s.ip STARTS WITH '10.1' RETURN r

question: Identify the services running with a start time greater than 1607000000000.
cypher: MATCH (s:Service) WHERE s.startTime > 1607000000000 RETURN s.name, s.startTime

question: List the top 5 entities by their lastEditTimestamp.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) RETURN e.name, e.lastEditTimestamp ORDER BY e.lastEditTimestamp DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the filings where the originator bank is 'CIMB Bank Berhad' and the amount is over 500000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = 'CIMB Bank Berhad' AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN f

question: List all persons who have produced more than 3 movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS num_produced WHERE num_produced > 3 RETURN p.name AS producer, num_produced AS movies_produced

question: List the top 5 highest-grossing movies that belong to the 'Animation' genre.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Animation'}) WITH m ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title, m.revenue

question: Which movies have a poster path containing '/rhIRbceoE9lR4veEXuwCC2wARtG.jpg'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path CONTAINS '/rhIRbceoE9lR4veEXuwCC2wARtG.jpg' RETURN m.title, m.poster_path

question: What is the description of the stream that is moderated by the user with the least total view count?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, s ORDER BY s.total_view_count ASC LIMIT 1 RETURN s.description

question: What are the top 5 movies with a tagline that includes the word 'adventure'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'adventure' RETURN m.title, m.tagline, m.average_vote ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 processes that depend on the service 'java'.
cypher: MATCH (p:Process)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(s:Service {name: 'java'}) RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: Which categories have the least products available in stock?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.unitsInStock > 0 WITH c.categoryName AS category, COUNT(p) AS productCount RETURN category ORDER BY productCount ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the Intermediary with the internal_id "10001"?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {internal_id: "10001"}) RETURN i.name

question: Which 3 suppliers have the highest average units in stock per product?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, avg(p.unitsInStock) AS avgUnitsInStock ORDER BY avgUnitsInStock DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName AS Supplier, avgUnitsInStock

question: What is the average revenue of movies in the 'Comedy' genre?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) WITH avg(m.revenue) AS averageRevenue RETURN averageRevenue

question: Which Racks are located in the same zone as the Router named 'DC1-R-1'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Router {name: 'DC1-R-1'}) WITH r.zone AS routerZone MATCH (rack:Rack {zone: routerZone}) RETURN rack.name AS rackName

question: What are the first 3 movies released after 2000 that Laurence Fishburne acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Laurence Fishburne"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 actors who have played roles in both comedy and action movies.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE g.name IN ['Comedy', 'Action'] WITH a, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS genres WHERE ALL(x IN ['Comedy', 'Action'] WHERE x IN genres) RETURN a LIMIT 3

question: List the entities that have a dorm date available.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.dorm_date IS NOT NULL RETURN e

question: What are the first 3 movies that were produced in the United States and have a vote count greater than 5000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(:Country {name: 'United States of America'}) WHERE m.vote_count > 5000 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the suppliers who have the highest total revenue generated by their products.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[su:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[o:ORDERS]-(ord:Order) WITH s, sum(toInteger(o.quantity) * toFloat(o.unitPrice)) AS revenue WITH max(revenue) AS maxRevenue MATCH (s:Supplier)-[su:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)<-[o:ORDERS]-(ord:Order) WITH s, sum(toInteger(o.quantity) * toFloat(o.unitPrice)) AS revenue, maxRevenue WHERE revenue = maxRevenue RETURN s.companyName

question: List the first 3 directors who have a born date but no died date.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL AND d.died IS NULL RETURN d LIMIT 3

question: Which product supplied by 'Exotic Liquids' has the least units in stock?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: 'Exotic Liquids'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitsInStock ORDER BY p.unitsInStock ASC LIMIT 1

question: What is the disk capacity of the type 'm-4/16/25'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Type {name: 'm-4/16/25'}) RETURN t.disk AS DiskCapacity

question: Identify 3 users who are VIPs for streams with a total view count over 1 million.

question: Find the top 5 tweets by 'neo4j' that mention another user and have been retweeted.

question: List the top 5 users that 'Me' mentions in tweets.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(user:User) RETURN user.screen_name, COUNT(tweet) AS mention_count ORDER BY mention_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 keywords that are most frequently associated with high-revenue movies.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 WITH k, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount RETURN k.name AS keywordName, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the names of 3 persons who reviewed movies with a rating above 80?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 80 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Which person has directed movies with a rating lower than 80 and released before 2000?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.rating < 80 AND m.released < 2000 RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: What are the first 5 streams that have a language not listed in 'en' or 'ja'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE l.name <> 'en' AND l.name <> 'ja' RETURN s.name, l.name LIMIT 5

question: List the entities that were incorporated in 2006 and are now defaulted.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.incorporation_date CONTAINS '2006' AND e.status = 'Defaulted' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.incorporation_date AS incorporation_date, e.status AS status

question: What are the ship countries for orders containing the product 'Aniseed Syrup'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product {productName: 'Aniseed Syrup'})<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN DISTINCT o.shipCountry

question: List all movies with a released year divisible by 10.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released % 10 = 0 RETURN m

question: What are the first 3 movies with a title starting with 'The'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title STARTS WITH 'The' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Find all people who have both written and produced movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE (p)-[:WROTE]->() AND (p)-[:PRODUCED]->() RETURN p

question: What are the top 5 oldest movies in the database by release year?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.year ORDER BY m.year ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 movies that have generated revenue more than 500 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 'originator_iso' values with the highest average 'amount' filed.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f.originator_iso AS originator_iso, avg(f.amount) AS average_amount ORDER BY average_amount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN originator_iso, average_amount

question: List the top 5 movies with the most diverse cast in terms of birth years.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WITH m, COLLECT(DISTINCT p.born) AS birth_years RETURN m.title, SIZE(birth_years) AS diversity ORDER BY diversity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 filings involved the most distinct banks as beneficiaries?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, count(DISTINCT e.id) AS distinct_banks ORDER BY distinct_banks DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, distinct_banks

question: Name the first 5 streams with the lowest follower count and still active.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.followers IS NOT NULL RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.followers AS follower_count ORDER BY s.followers ASC LIMIT 5

question: List all entities that have a struck off date of '15-FEB-2014' and their jurisdictions.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.struck_off_date = '15-FEB-2014' RETURN e.name AS entity_name, e.jurisdiction AS jurisdiction

question: Which machine type has the lowest RAM capacity to disk capacity ratio?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) WITH t, toFloat(t.ram) / t.disk AS ratio WITH min(ratio) AS minRatio MATCH (m:Machine)-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) WHERE toFloat(t.ram) / t.disk = minRatio RETURN t.name

question: What are the top 5 movies with the lowest budgets that have a runtime over 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 90 AND m.budget IS NOT NULL RETURN m ORDER BY m.budget ASC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the top 5 tweets mentioning 'Neo4j' with the greatest number of favorites.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WHERE t.text CONTAINS 'Neo4j' RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, t.favorites AS num_favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the 3 movies with the highest number of votes and a tagline mentioning 'limit'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline CONTAINS 'limit' RETURN m.title, m.tagline, m.votes ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have a VIP relationship with more than three different users?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS vip_count WHERE vip_count > 3 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, vip_count

question: List the people who have produced more than three movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) as producedMovies WHERE producedMovies > 3 RETURN p.name

question: List the first 3 persons who have worked as producers in more than 5 movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.job = "Producer" WITH p, COUNT(m) AS movieCount WHERE movieCount > 5 RETURN p.name AS producerName, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 directors who died after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.died > date('2000-01-01') RETURN d ORDER BY d.died ASC LIMIT 3

question: Display the top 5 streams that play the game 'Rust'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) RETURN s.name, s.url, s.followers, s.total_view_count ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which production companies have produced movies with a budget over 50 million?
cypher: MATCH (p:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN DISTINCT p.name AS ProductionCompany

question: How many movies were released in the year 1995?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE date(m.release_date) <= date('1995-12-31') AND date(m.release_date) >= date('1995-01-01') RETURN count(m) AS movieCount

question: Provide names of entities that were struck off on '15-FEB-2013'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {struck_off_date: '15-FEB-2013'}) RETURN e.name

question: Which 3 products have the smallest quantity per unit available?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.quantityPerUnit ORDER BY p.quantityPerUnit LIMIT 3

question: What is the average IMDb rating of movies starring actors born before 1950?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.born < date('1950-01-01') WITH avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating RETURN averageRating

question: Which 3 videos have the highest number of associated production companies?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(c:ProductionCompany) WITH v, count(c) AS companyCount RETURN v.title AS video, companyCount ORDER BY companyCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the first 5 entities that have been beneficiaries the most times.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WITH e, count(f) AS benefitsCount ORDER BY benefitsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e, benefitsCount

question: Show the top 5 entities by the number of filings they are involved in as both originator and beneficiary.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e,       COUNT(CASE WHEN (f)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e) THEN 1 END) AS originator_count,      COUNT(CASE WHEN (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(e) THEN 1 END) AS beneficiary_count WITH e, (originator_count + beneficiary_count) AS total_count ORDER BY total_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, total_count

question: List the first 5 movies that are part of a collection and have a revenue greater than 100 million dollars.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WHERE m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.revenue, c.name ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 production companies have produced the most movies with a popularity over 20?
cypher: MATCH (pc:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.popularity > 20 RETURN pc.name AS ProductionCompany, COUNT(m) AS MovieCount ORDER BY MovieCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total number of filings where the originator entity and the beneficiary entity are both located in countries with a 'code' that is exactly 3 characters long?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(originatorCountry:Country) MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiary:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(beneficiaryCountry:Country) WHERE size(originatorCountry.code) = 3 AND size(beneficiaryCountry.code) = 3 WITH DISTINCT f RETURN count(f) AS count

question: What is the total amount of filings that benefited entities located in the country with code "GBR"?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(be:Entity) WHERE be.country = "GBR" RETURN count(f)

question: Which 5 users have posted the most tweets?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet) RETURN u, count(t) AS TweetsCount ORDER BY TweetsCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which Interfaces are directly connected to 'DC1-RE'?
cypher: MATCH (r:Router {name: 'DC1-RE'})-[:ROUTES]->(i:Interface) RETURN i

question: List the movies where Tom Hanks worked as a cast member.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:CAST_FOR]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title

question: Which services started after timestamp 1605733619064 and before 1606597376483?
cypher: MATCH (s:Service) WHERE s.startTime > 1605733619064 AND s.startTime < 1606597376483 RETURN s

question: Show the top 5 streams with the most user chatters.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WITH s, count(u) AS userChatters ORDER BY userChatters DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.id AS StreamID, s.name AS StreamName, userChatters

question: Which movies have been reviewed as "The coolest football movie ever"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary = "The coolest football movie ever" RETURN m.title

question: What are the names of the top 5 users with the highest betweenness centrality?
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 5

question: Show the tweets with a favorite count between 50 and 100 and list the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorites >= 50 AND t.favorites <= 100 RETURN t LIMIT 5

question: List the first 5 movies that involve actors born in France.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.bornIn = "France" RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle LIMIT 5

question: Which movies have a review summary containing both "amazing" and "journey"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE r.summary CONTAINS 'amazing' AND r.summary CONTAINS 'journey' RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: What are the first 3 versions of the OS running on machine 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine {name: 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'})-[:RUNS]->(os:OS)-[:INSTANCE]->(v:Version) RETURN v.name ORDER BY v.name LIMIT 3

question: What is the average 'startTime' of all 'Application' nodes?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application) WITH avg(app.startTime) AS average_start_time RETURN average_start_time

question: List the first 3 videos that have a budget less than 5000 USD.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.budget < 5000 RETURN v LIMIT 3

question: Which streams have between 5,000 and 10,000 followers and primarily play the game "Rust"?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game {name: 'Rust'}) WHERE 5000 <= s.followers <= 10000 RETURN s.name

question: List the products that are part of the 'Dairy Products' category.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'}) RETURN p.productName AS ProductName, p.productID AS ProductID

question: Which movies have been rated by user with ID 1?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {id: 1})-[:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m

question: What is the `country_codes` of the entity with `name` "HOTFOCUS CO., LTD."?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "HOTFOCUS CO., LTD."}) RETURN e.country_codes

question: Identify movies that have languages lists containing more than 5 languages.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE size(m.languages) > 5 RETURN m

question: How many 'Machine' nodes are running the 'OS' with 'name' "RHEL"?
cypher: MATCH (o:OS {name: 'RHEL'})-[:RUNS]->(m:Machine) WITH count(DISTINCT m) AS num_machines RETURN num_machines

question: Which 3 directors have directed movies in more than three different genres?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount WHERE genreCount > 3 RETURN d.name, genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the total amount of money filed by entities located in Germany that benefited entities in Afghanistan between 2014-06-05 and 2014-06-06?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(be:Entity)<-[:COUNTRY]-(bc:Country {code: "DE"}) WHERE date(f.begin_date_format) >= date("2014-06-05") AND date(f.begin_date_format) <= date("2014-06-06") MATCH (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)<-[:COUNTRY]-(c:Country {code: "AFG"}) WITH sum(f.amount) AS total_amount RETURN total_amount

question: List the first 5 movies with a plot involving an 'evil exterminator'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'evil exterminator' RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: What is the zone of the network with IP address '10.2' and what is the size of that zone?
cypher: MATCH (n:Network {ip: '10.2'}) RETURN n.zone, n.size

question: Identify the top 5 entities by number of filings where the originator bank is 'HSBC'.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing {originator_bank: 'HSBC'}) WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e, filingsCount

question: List the first 3 suppliers of products in the 'Confections' category.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: 'Confections'}) RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: Find all movies with a rating above 90.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 90 RETURN m.title, m.released, r.rating, r.summary

question: List all users who are moderators for streams that have "Music" in their description and belong to a team created before 2017.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'Music' MATCH (s)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt < datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00') MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s) RETURN DISTINCT u.name

question: Which 3 movies are part of genres with an ID between 15 and 50?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE g.id >= 15 AND g.id <= 50 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, g.name AS GenreName LIMIT 3

question: Find the tweets that reply to tweets posted by Neo4j.
cypher: MATCH (replyingTweet:Tweet)-[:REPLY_TO]->(originalTweet:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(user:User {screen_name: "neo4j"}) RETURN replyingTweet.id, replyingTweet.text

question: Which 3 customers have purchased the most orders?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.companyName, count(o) AS NumberOfOrders ORDER BY NumberOfOrders DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers supply products to more than one category?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH s, count(DISTINCT c) AS numCategories WHERE numCategories > 1 RETURN s

question: Which 5 subscriptions are linked to the 'Ultimate' package?
cypher: MATCH (s:Subscription)-[:FOR_PACKAGE]->(p:Package {name: 'Ultimate'}) RETURN s LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 highest rated reviews and which movies they are associated with?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, r.rating, r.summary ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most associated genres?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, COUNT(g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, genreCount

question: How many Entities have the same jurisdiction_description as the entity with the internal_id "1000914"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {internal_id: "1000914"}) WITH e.jurisdiction_description AS targetJurisdiction MATCH (e2:Entity {jurisdiction_description: targetJurisdiction}) WITH count(e2) AS entityCount RETURN entityCount

question: How many unique games are played by streams with more than 500000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 500000 RETURN count(DISTINCT g.name) AS unique_games_played

question: "which customer has moat orders"
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.companyName, COUNT(o) AS NumberOfOrders ORDER BY NumberOfOrders DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show the top 3 teams by the number of streams they are associated with.
cypher: MATCH (t:Team)<-[:HAS_TEAM]-(s:Stream) RETURN t.name AS team, count(s) AS num_streams ORDER BY num_streams DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 customers based in Germany.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {country: "Germany"}) RETURN c.companyName, c.contactName ORDER BY c.customerID LIMIT 5

question: Which 5 filings have the most distinct beneficiary iso codes involved?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WITH f, f.beneficiary_iso AS iso ORDER BY iso WITH f, collect(DISTINCT iso) AS distinct_isos ORDER BY size(distinct_isos) DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN f.sar_id AS filing_id, size(distinct_isos) AS distinct_beneficiary_iso_count

question: What are the top 5 tweets by favorites that contain the hashtag 'education'?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(:Hashtag {name: 'education'}) RETURN t.text AS tweet_text, t.favorites AS favorites ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which products have been ordered more than 100 times?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[o:ORDERS]->(:Order) WITH p, count(o) AS ordersCount WHERE ordersCount > 100 RETURN p.productName, ordersCount

question: Identify the products supplied by suppliers with no listed phone number.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.phone IS NULL RETURN p.productName, p.productID

question: Which 3 entities have the most filings that concern entities based in 'China'?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country {name: 'China'})<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)<-[:CONCERNS]-(f:Filing) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: List all customers who have placed orders with a required date in 1998.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.requiredDate STARTS WITH '1998' RETURN c

question: List the movies with a higher budget than "Titanic" but a lower IMDb rating.
cypher: MATCH (titanic:Movie {title: "Titanic"}) WITH titanic.budget AS titanicBudget, titanic.imdbRating AS titanicImdbRating MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > titanicBudget AND m.imdbRating < titanicImdbRating RETURN m.title AS movieTitle

question: Which customers (show their `customerID` and `companyName`) have never placed an order with a `freight` cost higher than 100?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE toFloat(o.freight) > 100 WITH collect(DISTINCT o.customerID) AS highFreightCustomers MATCH (c:Customer) WHERE NOT c.customerID IN highFreightCustomers RETURN c.customerID, c.companyName

question: List the first 5 movies that have been rated by users from more than 10 different countries.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(DISTINCT u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 10 RETURN m LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have the highest vote count?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.vote_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: "한국에서 제작된 성인영화 중 평점이 가장 높은 영화에 대해서 알려줘"
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: "South Korea"}) RETURN a.title AS title, a.average_vote AS rating ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the name of the director who directed the movie "Jumanji"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Jumanji"})<-[:DIRECTED]-(d) RETURN d.name

question: Who are the top 3 users based on the number of users they interact with?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(other:User) WITH u, count(DISTINCT other) AS interactions ORDER BY interactions DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name, interactions

question: Which three actors have acted in movies in more than 3 different languages?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, size(collect(distinct m.languages)) AS num_languages WHERE num_languages > 3 RETURN a.name, num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which three genres have the most movies with a runtime over 120 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.runtime > 120 WITH g, count(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount

question: Which streams are part of the team 'ESO Stream Team'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team {name: 'ESO Stream Team'}) RETURN s.name AS stream_name

question: What addresses in Samoa are linked to more than one entity?
cypher: MATCH (a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity) WHERE e.jurisdiction_description = 'Samoa' WITH a, count(e) AS entityCount WHERE entityCount > 1 RETURN a.address, entityCount

question: What is the name of the movie with the highest number of keywords associated with it?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, size(collect(k)) AS keywordCount ORDER BY keywordCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN m.title

question: List the entities that share an officer with the entity named "NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD.".
cypher: MATCH (entity1 { name: "NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD." }) MATCH (entity1)<-[:officer_of]-(officer) MATCH (officer)-[:officer_of]->(entity2) WHERE entity1 <> entity2 RETURN DISTINCT entity2.name

question: Which jurisdiction has the highest number of entities with a 'Defaulted' status and a service provider of 'Mossack Fonseca'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.status = 'Defaulted' AND e.service_provider = 'Mossack Fonseca' WITH e.jurisdiction AS jurisdiction, count(*) AS entityCount ORDER BY entityCount DESC RETURN jurisdiction, entityCount LIMIT 1

question: Which movies have been rated by more than 5000 users?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count > 5000 RETURN m.title, m.vote_count

question: Find all movies where the original and spoken languages are different.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(ol:Language),       (m)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(sl:Language) WHERE ol.id <> sl.id RETURN m.title, ol.name AS original_language, sl.name AS spoken_language

question: Find the filings where the 'originator_bank' and 'beneficiary_bank' both have the word "Bank" in their names.

question: Find the top 5 most expensive products supplied by 'Exotic Liquids'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: "Exotic Liquids"})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice ORDER BY p.unitPrice DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which director has directed the most movies with an IMDb rating above 8.5?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.5 WITH d, count(*) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN d.name AS directorName

question: List the first 3 customers who have placed orders totaling over $1000 in freight costs.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order) WHERE toFloat(o.freight) > 1000 RETURN c.companyName, c.contactName, c.contactTitle, c.phone, c.address, c.city, c.country ORDER BY o.orderDate LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 users have the most moderator relationships with other users?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(:User) WITH u, count(*) AS moderator_count ORDER BY moderator_count DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN u.name, moderator_count

question: Display the top 5 Entities by the number of Filings they have originated.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank_id = e.id RETURN e.name AS EntityName, COUNT(f) AS NumberOfFilings ORDER BY NumberOfFilings DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the URLs of links shared in tweets that are replies to tweets posted by users followed by the user with screen name "neo4j".

question: List the top 5 streams by number of games played.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) RETURN s.name AS stream, count(g) AS games_played ORDER BY games_played DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average total view count of streams that have "en" as a language and are moderated by users who are part of a team?

question: What are the first 3 movies with a runtime less than 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: Which suppliers provide products with a unit price higher than the average unit price of products in the 'Seafood' category?

cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.summary = 'Pretty funny at times' RETURN m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating ORDER BY r.rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 genres are most common among movies released before 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN g.name AS genre, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have been directed by someone who has also acted in them?
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(director) RETURN movie.title AS MovieTitle

question: Which country has the highest total amount of filings benefiting entities within it?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c, sum(f.amount) AS total_amount RETURN c.name AS country_name, total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which streams have the description mentioning 'professional' and list the first 3.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream) WHERE s.description CONTAINS 'professional' RETURN s LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 entities have the most filings as beneficiaries and are located in 'Germany'?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'Germany'}) MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: What are the top 3 movies with a plot involving a 'friendship'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'friendship' RETURN m.title, m.plot, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Who are the first 3 directors who have worked on movies with an average vote below 5?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CREW_FOR]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.job = 'Director' AND m.average_vote < 5 RETURN p.name LIMIT 3

question: Find the top 5 directors who have directed movies with the highest average imdbRating.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, avg(m.imdbRating) AS avgRating ORDER BY avgRating DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN d.name AS Director, avgRating AS Average_IMDb_Rating

question: Who are the top five people born before 1960 who produced more than one movie?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born < 1960 WITH p, COUNT(m) AS producedMovies WHERE producedMovies > 1 RETURN p.name AS name, producedMovies ORDER BY producedMovies DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find all movies released before 2000 with an average vote greater than 8.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') AND m.average_vote > 8 RETURN m.title, m.release_date, m.average_vote

cypher: MATCH (p:Process {name: "7.1"})-[:INSTANCE]->(v:Version {name: "7.1"}) RETURN p.name

question: List the first 5 categories where the average 'unitPrice' of products is above $30.

question: What are the top 3 movies with the most significant difference between budget and revenue?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget IS NOT NULL AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue, abs(m.revenue - m.budget) AS difference ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all entities that have a closed date and their type.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.closed_date IS NOT NULL AND e.type IS NOT NULL RETURN e.name, e.closed_date, e.type

question: Which 3 production companies have the most movies with a vote count over 1000?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.vote_count > 1000 WITH c, count(m) AS num_movies ORDER BY num_movies DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS company, num_movies

question: Which movies have a runtime longer than 100 minutes?

question: Which users mentioned by 'neo4j' in tweets have the highest betweenness?

question: List the top 5 movies with the highest number of imdbVotes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.imdbVotes IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.imdbVotes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 users have rated the same movie with different ratings?
cypher: MATCH (u1:User)-[r1:RATED]->(m:Movie)<-[r2:RATED]-(u2:User),         (m)<-[r3:RATED]-(u3:User) WHERE u1 <> u2 AND u1 <> u3 AND u2 <> u3   AND r1.rating <> r2.rating   AND r1.rating <> r3.rating   AND r2.rating <> r3.rating RETURN u1.name AS User1, r1.rating AS User1Rating,        u2.name AS User2, r2.rating AS User2Rating,          u3.name AS User3, r3.rating AS User3Rating,        m.title AS Movie LIMIT 1

question: List the first 3 products from the 'Seafood' category with a unitsOnOrder value above 20.

question: How many languages are used by streams with a total view count over 10 million, listing the first 3?

cypher: MATCH (toyStory:Movie {title: "Toy Story"}) MATCH (toyStory)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g, toyStory.countries AS countries UNWIND countries AS country MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g) WHERE country IN m.countries AND m.title <> "Toy Story" RETURN DISTINCT m.title AS movieTitle
