cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Comedy'}) WITH avg(m.vote_count) AS average_vote_count RETURN average_vote_count

question: What is the most common country for all registered addresses?
cypher: MATCH ()-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WITH a.countries AS country, count(*) AS count RETURN country, count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the first 3 movies with an actor born before 1900?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE a.born < date('1900-01-01') RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies that are rated by the most users.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:RATED]-(u:User) RETURN m.title, count(u) AS num_ratings ORDER BY num_ratings DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which users are moderators in more than one stream?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MODERATOR]->(s:Stream) WITH u, COUNT(s) AS streamCount WHERE streamCount > 1 RETURN u.name AS moderatorName, streamCount

question: Name the top 5 movies with the most associated collections.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WITH m, count(c) AS num_collections ORDER BY num_collections DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, num_collections AS NumberOfCollections

question: What are the first 3 languages spoken in the most popular movies (popularity > 20)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WHERE m.popularity > 20 RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Show the top 5 people who have reviewed the most movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, count(m) AS movies_reviewed ORDER BY movies_reviewed DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 movies have been rated by the oldest users in terms of account creation date?
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH u, r, m ORDER BY u.timestamp ASC WITH u, collect(m) AS movies LIMIT 3 UNWIND movies AS movie RETURN DISTINCT movie.title AS MovieTitle, movie.released AS ReleaseDate LIMIT 3

question: List the top 3 countries by the number of filings that have a beneficiary bank based in their territory.
cypher: MATCH (c:Country)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity)<-[:BENEFITS]-(f:Filing) WITH c, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS CountryName, filingsCount

question: List the languages spoken in the movie "Toy Story".
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Toy Story"})-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name

question: What is the `categoryName` of the product with the highest `unitsInStock` that has been ordered at least once?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-() WITH max(p.unitsInStock) AS maxUnitsInStock MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-() WHERE p.unitsInStock = maxUnitsInStock MATCH (p)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) RETURN c.categoryName

question: Which entities have an address in Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:registered_address]->(a:Address) WHERE a.address CONTAINS "Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong" RETURN e

question: Which three directors have directed movies with a total revenue over 500 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, SUM(m.revenue) AS totalRevenue WHERE totalRevenue > 500000000 RETURN d.name AS Director, totalRevenue ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which movies have the highest number of associated keywords?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword) WITH m, count(k) AS keywordCount RETURN m.title AS movie, keywordCount ORDER BY keywordCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the first 3 egress names in the DataCenter DC1?
cypher: MATCH (dc:DataCenter {name: 'DC1'})-[:CONTAINS]->(e:Egress) RETURN e.name LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 games associated with streams that have more than 10,000 total views.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.total_view_count > 10000 RETURN g.name, count(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the average budget of movies that belong to a collection with more than 5 movies?
cypher: MATCH (c:Collection)<-[:IN_COLLECTION]-(m:Movie) WITH c, count(m) AS movieCount, avg(m.budget) AS averageBudget WHERE movieCount > 5 RETURN c.name AS collectionName, averageBudget

question: List the top 5 oldest actors and the movies they have acted in.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[a:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE p.born IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name, p.born, collect(m.title) AS movies ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 people who have written and directed the same movie released after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN p.name AS person_name, m.title AS movie_title LIMIT 3

question: "Who played in top gun?"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie {title: "Top Gun"}) RETURN p.name

question: What is the name of the youngest director to direct a movie with a budget over $200 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 200000000 MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m) RETURN d.name, d.born ORDER BY d.born DESC  LIMIT 1

question: List the users, along with their follower counts, who are VIPs for streams that use the English language.
cypher: MATCH (l:Language {name: 'en'})<-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]-(s:Stream) WITH s MATCH (s)<-[:VIP]-(u:User) RETURN u.name, s.followers

question: What is the oldest movie with the summary "An amazing journey"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[r:REVIEWED]-() WHERE r.summary = "An amazing journey" RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.released ASC LIMIT 1

question: What are the first 3 streams that have a language set to 'ru'?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language {name: 'ru'}) RETURN s.name, s.url LIMIT 3

question: How many entities are connected to the officer with node_id 12000001?
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {node_id: 12000001})-[:officer_of]->(e:Entity) RETURN count(e) AS numberOfEntities

question: What is the average incorporation year for all Entities registered in Samoa?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {jurisdiction_description: "Samoa"}) WITH toInteger(substring(e.incorporation_date, 0, 4)) AS incorporation_year RETURN avg(incorporation_year)

question: "find people that have written a movie and have acted in it too"
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:WROTE]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN p.name, m.title

question: Show the first 3 genres that have movies with both an English and French language option.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE 'English' IN m.languages AND 'French' IN m.languages RETURN DISTINCT g.name LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 youngest directors in the graph?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, p.born ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the first 3 movies with the highest IMDb rating.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.imdbRating ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the orders that include products from categories with an average 'unitPrice' greater than $20.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WITH c, avg(p.unitPrice) AS avgPrice WHERE avgPrice > 20 MATCH (p2:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c) MATCH (o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p2) RETURN DISTINCT o.orderID

question: Find all persons born in 1996.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born = 1996 RETURN p

question: Which 3 countries have the least number of filings ending in them?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount ASC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name AS CountryName, filingsCount

question: Who has the most directed movies without acting in any of them?
cypher: MATCH (director:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(movie:Movie) WHERE NOT EXISTS {   MATCH (director)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie) } RETURN director.name, COUNT(movie) AS directedMovies ORDER BY directedMovies DESC LIMIT 1

question: Name the top 3 directors who have worked on movies with an average vote greater than 7.5.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:CREW_FOR {job: 'Director'}]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.average_vote > 7.5 WITH p, count(m) AS num_movies, avg(m.average_vote) AS avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS director, num_movies, avg_rating

question: Which 3 suppliers have supplied products with the most units on order?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, sum(p.unitsOnOrder) AS totalUnitsOnOrder ORDER BY totalUnitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN s.companyName, totalUnitsOnOrder

question: Who are the top 5 oldest directors in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS director, p.born AS birthYear ORDER BY p.born ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 movies sorted by release date in ascending order.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which packages provide access to the genre 'Animation'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Package)-[:PROVIDES_ACCESS_TO]->(g:Genre {name: 'Animation'}) RETURN p

question: Find all tweets by 'Neo4j' that mention 'Me'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(m:Me) RETURN t

question: Find the first 3 tweets that have been retweeted more than 100 times.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet) WHERE t.favorites > 100 RETURN t ORDER BY t.created_at ASC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 products that have the highest reorder levels.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel ORDER BY p.reorderLevel DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 games with the highest number of distinct languages used by streams that play them.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH g, count(DISTINCT l) AS languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS gameName, languageCount

question: Which 3 products have a 'quantityPerUnit' specification involving 'bags'?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE p.quantityPerUnit CONTAINS 'bags' RETURN p LIMIT 3

question: What other movies were released in the same year as "Toy Story"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "Toy Story"}) WITH m.release_date.year AS releaseYear MATCH (otherMovies:Movie) WHERE otherMovies.release_date.year = releaseYear AND otherMovies.title <> "Toy Story" RETURN DISTINCT otherMovies.title

question: Which movies have been produced and directed by the same person?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) MATCH (p)-[:PRODUCED]->(m) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS PersonName

question: What are the first 3 movies that have a homepage URL containing 'disney'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.homepage CONTAINS 'disney' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What is the average IMDb rating of movies with a runtime under 90 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime < 90 AND m.imdbRating IS NOT NULL RETURN avg(m.imdbRating) AS averageRating

question: Which three filings have the highest amount transferred and involve a UK beneficiary bank?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country {code: "GBR"}) RETURN f.sar_id, f.amount ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most revenue among those released in the 1990s?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date >= date('1990-01-01') AND m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') AND m.revenue IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the products that have a 'unitPrice' greater than the average 'unitPrice' of products in their category.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product) WITH c, avg(p.unitPrice) AS averagePrice MATCH (c)<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product) WHERE p.unitPrice > averagePrice RETURN p.productName

question: Who has directed more than one movie?
cypher: MATCH (d:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH d, count(m) AS num_directed WHERE num_directed > 1 RETURN d.name AS director, num_directed AS movies_directed

question: What are the top 5 filings by amount where the filing year is 2017?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin >= datetime('2017-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND f.begin < datetime('2018-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which actors have starred in movies with a budget higher than $100 million and a revenue lower than $50 million?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 100000000 AND m.revenue < 50000000 MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actorName

question: What are the URLs of the top 3 most favorited tweets containing links?
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Link) WITH t ORDER BY t.favorites DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN t.url

question: List the top 5 products with the highest reorder level.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN p.productName, p.reorderLevel ORDER BY p.reorderLevel DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which streams have chatters who are also moderators in other streams?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:CHATTER]->(u:User) WHERE exists {   MATCH (u)-[:MODERATOR]->(:Stream) } RETURN s

question: What is the average number of favorites for tweets that mention users who have interacted with 'Neo4j'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'Neo4j'}) MATCH (u)-[:INTERACTS_WITH]->(user1:User) MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(user1) WITH avg(t.favorites) AS average_favorites RETURN average_favorites

question: Find the directors who have directed movies in more than 10 different genres.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(genre:Genre) WITH d, count(DISTINCT genre) AS distinctGenres WHERE distinctGenres > 10 RETURN d.name AS directorName

question: List 3 movies that have a runtime greater than 120 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 oldest movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.release_date ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 games are the most played by streams with over 1 million followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WHERE s.followers > 1000000 RETURN g.name, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify all entities that have 'Aruba corporate registry data is current through 2014' as their valid until date.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.valid_until = 'Aruba corporate registry data is current through 2014' RETURN e

question: What is the date and time of the most recent tweet posted by a user who follows a user followed by Neo4j?
cypher: MATCH (neo4j:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(followed:User)<-[:FOLLOWS]->(follower:User)-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WITH tweet ORDER BY tweet.created_at DESC RETURN tweet.created_at LIMIT 1

question: What is the total number of dependencies for the 'logstash' application?
cypher: MATCH (app:Application {name: 'logstash'})-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(dependency) RETURN count(dependency) AS totalDependencies

question: "Which 3 users get the most retweets?"
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)<-[:RETWEETS]-() RETURN u.screen_name, COUNT(*) AS retweet_count ORDER BY retweet_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 videos that have a runtime shorter than 30 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video) WHERE v.runtime < 30 RETURN v ORDER BY v.runtime ASC LIMIT 3

question: Which tweets have been retweeted by 'neo4j' and contain a hashtag?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(t:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(rt:Tweet) WHERE EXISTS { (rt)-[:TAGS]->(:Hashtag) } RETURN t, rt

question: List the top 5 movies with the most user ratings.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) RETURN m.title, count(u) AS ratingsCount ORDER BY ratingsCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the products supplied by suppliers with a phone number starting with '(171)'.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WHERE s.phone STARTS WITH '(171)' RETURN p.productName AS productName, s.companyName AS supplierName

question: What are the names of the top 3 oldest actors and the movies they have produced?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, m ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name AS actor, collect(m.title) AS produced_movies

question: What are the top 5 filings by the shortest duration from begin to end date?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.begin IS NOT NULL AND f.end IS NOT NULL RETURN f ORDER BY duration.between(f.begin, f.end) ASC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 movies with a plot involving a 'young boy' or 'orphan'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot CONTAINS 'young boy' OR m.plot CONTAINS 'orphan' RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which users are VIPs for the first 5 streams with the most followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, u ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, u.name AS vip_user

question: List the top 3 filings with the highest number of transactions in a single filing.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) RETURN f.sar_id, f.number ORDER BY f.number DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the most number of votes cast by users?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:RATED]-(u:User) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbVotes AS Votes ORDER BY m.imdbVotes DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the first 3 movies that have been rated by the user with ID '1'?
cypher: MATCH (u:User {id: 1})-[:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: Show all users followed by 'Me' with more than 10000 followers.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:FOLLOWS]->(user:User) WHERE user.followers > 10000 RETURN user

question: What is the average budget of movies released in the year 2010?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {year: 2010}) WITH avg(m.budget) AS average_budget RETURN average_budget

question: List the top 3 filings where the originator bank is 'CIMB Bank Berhad' and the beneficiary bank country is 'United Kingdom'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity),       (b)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE f.originator_bank = 'CIMB Bank Berhad'    AND f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the titles of movies that belong to both the "Adventure" and "Comedy" genres.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g1:Genre) WHERE g1.name = "Adventure" MATCH (m)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g2:Genre) WHERE g2.name = "Comedy" RETURN m.title

question: Which 5 movies have the most quotes listed in their plots?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.plot IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.plot ORDER BY size(split(m.plot, '"')) DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the top 5 movies where actors also served as directors.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie, collect(p.name) AS actor_directors ORDER BY size(collect(p.name)) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 3 streams that have a team with a creation date after 2015?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_TEAM]->(t:Team) WHERE t.createdAt > datetime('2015-01-01T00:00:00Z') RETURN s.name AS stream_name, s.url AS stream_url, t.name AS team_name, t.createdAt AS team_createdAt ORDER BY t.createdAt LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 most popular genres based on movie data?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH g.name AS genre, SUM(m.popularity) AS total_popularity ORDER BY total_popularity DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN genre, total_popularity

question: List the top 5 movies that have been rated by users from more than 5 different countries.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WITH m, count(DISTINCT u) AS userCount WHERE userCount > 5 RETURN m ORDER BY userCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 movies with the most distinct genres associated with them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WITH m, count(DISTINCT g) AS genreCount ORDER BY genreCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN m.title AS movieTitle, genreCount

question: Display all tweets by 'Neo4j' that mention at least two different users.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet) WHERE size([(tweet)-[:MENTIONS]->(u:User) | u]) >= 2 RETURN tweet

question: What is the total `amount` of filings where the `originator_bank` is located in a country with a `tld` that is also a valid Roman numeral?
cypher: MATCH (c:Country) WHERE c.tld IN ['I', 'V', 'X', 'L', 'C', 'D', 'M'] WITH c MATCH (c)<-[:COUNTRY]-(e:Entity) WITH e MATCH (e)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(f:Filing) WITH sum(f.amount) AS total_amount RETURN total_amount

question: List the screen names of the first 3 users who have the most followers.
cypher: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.screen_name ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 5 hashtags used in tweets that mention 'Neo4j' and were created in 2021.
cypher: MATCH (t:Tweet)-[:TAGS]->(h:Hashtag) WHERE t.created_at >= datetime('2021-01-01T00:00:00Z') AND t.created_at <= datetime('2021-12-31T23:59:59Z')   AND exists{(t)-[:MENTIONS]->(:User {name: 'Neo4j'})} RETURN h.name, count(t) AS mentions ORDER BY mentions DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the 'type' of the 'Machine' named "DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Machine { name: "DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1" })-[:TYPE]->(t:Type) RETURN t.type

question: Find the top 5 entities with the highest total amount of filings they benefited from.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity) WITH b, sum(f.amount) AS totalAmount ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN b.name, totalAmount

question: List the customers who have placed orders that include products from both the 'Condiments' and 'Confections' categories.
cypher: MATCH (customer:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(order:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(product:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(category:Category) WHERE category.categoryName IN ['Condiments', 'Confections'] WITH customer,       size(COLLECT(DISTINCT category.categoryName)) AS distinct_categories WHERE distinct_categories = 2 RETURN DISTINCT customer.companyName

question: Which addresses are associated with entities that have a `status` of "Defaulted"?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.status = "Defaulted" MATCH (e)-[r:registered_address]->(a:Address) RETURN a

question: What are the top 3 movies with a title ending in 'End'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title ENDS WITH 'End' RETURN m ORDER BY m.imdbRating DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 most active users based on total social interactions (follows, mentions, retweets).
cypher: MATCH (u:User) WITH u,       count{(u)-[:FOLLOWS]->(:User)} AS followsCount,      count{(u)-[:MENTIONS]->(:User)} AS mentionsCount,      count{(u)-[:RETWEETS]->(:Tweet)} AS retweetsCount RETURN u.name, u.screen_name, followsCount + mentionsCount + retweetsCount AS totalInteractions ORDER BY totalInteractions DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which Entities are associated with Filings that have the originator bank country as 'Angola'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank_country = 'Angola' RETURN DISTINCT e

question: Show the streams that have the most distinct languages.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) WITH s, count(DISTINCT l) as languageCount RETURN s.name, languageCount ORDER BY languageCount DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find the streams that have a chatter user who is also a VIP of another stream with a higher total view count.
cypher: MATCH (s1:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-(u:User) MATCH (u)-[:VIP]->(s2:Stream) WHERE s2.total_view_count > s1.total_view_count RETURN DISTINCT s1.name

question: What are the top 5 languages associated with streams that have the most moderators?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:MODERATOR]->(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS moderator_count ORDER BY moderator_count DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (s)-[:HAS_LANGUAGE]->(l:Language) RETURN l.name AS language, COUNT(s) AS stream_count ORDER BY stream_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which 3 suppliers have supplied products with the most units on order?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) RETURN s.companyName, SUM(p.unitsOnOrder) AS totalUnitsOnOrder ORDER BY totalUnitsOnOrder DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the people who have the role of both actor and director in the most movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, count(m) AS actedInCount MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) WITH p, actedInCount, count(m) AS directedCount WHERE actedInCount > 0 AND directedCount > 0 WITH p, actedInCount + directedCount AS totalMovies ORDER BY totalMovies DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN p.name AS personName, totalMovies

question: Find the movies that have been rated by users with an average rating greater than 4.0.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating > 4.0 WITH m, avg(r.rating) AS avg_rating WHERE avg_rating > 4.0 RETURN m.title

question: What are the top 3 movies by average vote in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m ORDER BY m.average_vote DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 5 actors have the highest number of credited roles in the database?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN a.name AS actor, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many movies has Lana Wachowski directed?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: "Lana Wachowski"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN count(m) AS numberOfMoviesDirected

question: Find the top 3 longest relationships in terms of roles between a person and a movie.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS person, m.title AS movie, r.roles AS roles ORDER BY size(r.roles) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the first 5 orders made in 1996.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.orderDate STARTS WITH '1996' RETURN o ORDER BY o.orderDate LIMIT 5

cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.followers > 10000 RETURN u ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the countries where both the originator and beneficiary entities of filings are located.

question: What is the average number of votes for movies released in the 1970s?

question: List the top 3 orders with the highest freight charges.
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN o.orderID, o.freight ORDER BY toFloat(o.freight) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 movies have the lowest imdbVotes but a rating higher than 7.0?

question: What are the top 5 products by quantity ordered in the most recent orders?

question: List the entities that have a 'same_name_as' relationship with entities that have an 'intermediary_of' relationship with an intermediary.

question: Which actor has the most unique roles?

question: Find the actors who have starred in movies with a runtime longer than their age at the time of filming.

question: List the first 3 entities that are originators in filings where the originator bank is 'CIMB Bank Berhad' and the amount is above 500000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.originator_bank = 'CIMB Bank Berhad' AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN e LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 games are played by streams with the highest ratio of followers to total view counts?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH g, s.followers * 1.0 / s.total_view_count AS follower_view_ratio RETURN g.name AS game, max(follower_view_ratio) AS max_ratio ORDER BY max_ratio DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 highest budget movies were released after 2000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, m.budget ORDER BY m.budget DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the movies with a release year divisible by 5.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released % 5 = 0 RETURN m.title AS title, m.released AS year

question: Find all tweets that 'neo4j' has retweeted from users located in 'Graphs Are Everywhere' and show the first 5.
cypher: MATCH (u:User {name: 'Neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(rt:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(t:Tweet)<-[:POSTS]-(other:User {location: 'Graphs Are Everywhere'}) RETURN t LIMIT 5

question: "Can you map the global footprint of \"CF INDUSTRIES (BARBADOS) SRL\" through its connections to officers and entities in different countries?"
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "CF INDUSTRIES (BARBADOS) SRL"})-[:officer_of|intermediary_of|connected_to*]-(connectedEntities) WHERE connectedEntities:Entity OR connectedEntities:Officer RETURN e, connectedEntities

question: What is the ibcRUC of the entity with the name "NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD."?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {name: "NINGBO SUNRISE ENTERPRISES UNITED CO., LTD."}) RETURN e.ibcRUC

question: Which entities are concerned in filings with an amount greater than 750000?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.amount > 750000 RETURN e

question: What are the top 5 longest movies in the database?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the tagline of the movie "The Matrix Revolutions"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {title: "The Matrix Revolutions"}) RETURN m.tagline

question: Which production companies have produced movies with a budget over 50 million?
cypher: MATCH (c:ProductionCompany)-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS company

question: Find 3 movies that have 'Toy Story' in their title.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS 'Toy Story' RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the Filings where the amount is greater than $1,500,000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 1500000 RETURN f

question: Which 3 adult films have the lowest average votes but were produced in 'United States of America'?
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {name: 'United States of America'}) WHERE a.average_vote IS NOT NULL RETURN a.title, a.average_vote ORDER BY a.average_vote ASC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 highest-grossing movies of 2014?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.year = 2014 RETURN m.title, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 3 beneficiary banks that received filings where the originator bank is located in the country with code "SGP" and the beneficiary bank is located in the country with code "GBR"?
cypher: MATCH (filing:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(originator:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(originatorCountry:Country) WHERE originatorCountry.code = "SGP" MATCH (filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(beneficiaryBank:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(beneficiaryCountry:Country) WHERE beneficiaryCountry.code = "GBR" WITH beneficiaryBank, count(filing) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN beneficiaryBank.name, filingCount

question: Which games are played by the top 3 streams based on followers count?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game) WITH s, g ORDER BY s.followers DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN g.name AS game_name, s.name AS stream_name, s.followers AS followers_count

question: Which movies have been produced and directed by the same person?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:PRODUCED]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS Movie, p.name AS ProducerDirector

question: List all actors who have never acted in an 'Action' genre movie.
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor) WHERE NOT EXISTS {   MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Action'}) } RETURN a.name

question: Find the filings where the originator entity's name contains "AG" and the amount is greater than 1000000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[r:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE e.name CONTAINS 'AG' AND f.amount > 1000000 RETURN f.id, f.amount

question: List the products ordered by 'VINET' customer.
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {customerID: 'VINET'})-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName AS productName

question: Show the first 3 movies released in the USA that have a revenue exceeding 500 million USD.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE 'USA' IN m.countries AND m.revenue > 500000000 RETURN m.title, m.year, m.revenue ORDER BY m.released LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 orders in terms of quantity for the 'Dairy Products' category.
cypher: MATCH (c:Category {categoryName: 'Dairy Products'})<-[:PART_OF]-(p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) RETURN o.orderID AS orderID, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalQuantity ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 5 movies that have a poster path ending in '.jpg'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.poster_path ENDS WITH '.jpg' RETURN m.title, m.poster_path LIMIT 5

question: Show the first 5 filings with the most entities involved as concerns from the same sector.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity) WITH f, COUNT(e) AS entityCount ORDER BY entityCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (f)-[:CONCERNS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) RETURN f.sar_id AS FilingID, f.begin AS BeginDate, f.end AS EndDate, COLLECT(e.name) AS ConcernedEntities, c.name AS Country

question: Which products from 'Exotic Liquids' are part of the 'Beverages' category and have a unit price less than 20?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {companyName: "Exotic Liquids"})-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category {categoryName: "Beverages"}) WHERE p.unitPrice < 20 RETURN p.productName, p.unitPrice

question: Identify the top 5 entities by the number of filings they filed.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WITH e, COUNT(f) AS num_filings ORDER BY num_filings DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name AS entity_name, num_filings

question: What are the first 3 movies with the highest budget to revenue ratio?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 0 AND m.revenue > 0 WITH m, (m.revenue / m.budget) AS budget_to_revenue_ratio ORDER BY budget_to_revenue_ratio DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.budget AS Budget, m.revenue AS Revenue, budget_to_revenue_ratio AS BudgetToRevenueRatio

question: What is the average number of entities that are 'intermediary_of' by intermediaries with a 'status' of 'INACTIVE'?
cypher: MATCH (i:Intermediary {status: 'INACTIVE'})-[:intermediary_of]->(e:Entity) WITH i, count(e) AS numEntities WITH avg(numEntities) AS averageEntities RETURN averageEntities

question: Name the top 3 genres in videos that have a runtime less than 30 minutes.
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE v.runtime < 30 RETURN g.name AS genre, count(*) AS count ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which genres have the most movies with a runtime over 120 minutes?
cypher: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:IN_GENRE]-(m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime > 120 RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the roles of Keanu Reeves in the movies he acted in?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Keanu Reeves'})-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS movie, r.roles AS roles

question: Show the first 3 movies with the most complex role lists in the 'ACTED_IN' relationship.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, r.roles ORDER BY size(r.roles) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which customers have ordered products with a total quantity greater than 50?
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) WITH c, sum(r.quantity) AS totalQuantity WHERE totalQuantity > 50 RETURN c.companyName AS CustomerName, totalQuantity

question: What is the average `amount` of filings where the `beneficiary_bank` is "Barclays Bank Plc"?
cypher: MATCH (filing:Filing) WHERE filing.beneficiary_bank = "Barclays Bank Plc" WITH avg(filing.amount) AS average_amount RETURN average_amount

question: What are the top 5 movies that have the most languages spoken in them?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, size(m.languages) AS num_languages ORDER BY num_languages DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the top 5 longest movies by runtime?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.runtime IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.runtime ORDER BY m.runtime DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the top five people who have reviewed a movie with a rating less than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN p.name, COUNT(r) AS review_count ORDER BY review_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the first 3 actors with the most roles in videos released after 2010?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:CAST_FOR]->(v:Video) WHERE v.release_date > date('2010-01-01') WITH p, count(r) AS roles ORDER BY roles DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN p.name, roles

question: What is the most common genre among movies that grossed over 500 million dollars?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) WHERE m.revenue > 500000000 WITH g, count(DISTINCT m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC RETURN g.name AS genre, movieCount LIMIT 1

question: Which 3 entities have the largest number of incoming [:BENEFITS] relationships?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity)<-[:BENEFITS]-(f:Filing) RETURN e, count(f) AS benefitsCount ORDER BY benefitsCount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the entities that are connected to the officer with the icij_id 'CB195B5424E13A74A6F3BC719050A2B9' through the 'officer_of' relationship.
cypher: MATCH (o:Officer {icij_id: 'CB195B5424E13A74A6F3BC719050A2B9'})-[r:officer_of]->(e) RETURN e.name

question: What are the top 3 countries that received filings from the entity with id "the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp" with an amount greater than 1000000?
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {id: 'the-bank-of-new-york-mellon-corp'})-[:FILED]->(f:Filing) WHERE f.amount > 1000000 MATCH (f)-[:CONCERNS]->(be:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c, count(f) AS filingCount ORDER BY filingCount DESC LIMIT 3 RETURN c.name

question: Who are the top 5 most followed users that Neo4j follows?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(user:User) RETURN user.name, user.followers ORDER BY user.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Who are the 3 youngest directors in the database?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name AS director, p.born AS birthYear ORDER BY p.born DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all movies released after 2000.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released > 2000 RETURN m

question: List the first 3 tweets that 'Neo4j' has retweeted.
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:POSTS]->(tweet:Tweet)-[:RETWEETS]->(retweeted:Tweet) RETURN retweeted.text LIMIT 3

question: Name the top 5 adult videos that were produced in Italy.
cypher: MATCH (a:Adult)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country {id: "IT"}) RETURN a.title AS Title, a.id AS ID ORDER BY a.popularity DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the processes that have a dependency on the service "java".
cypher: MATCH (s:Service {name: "java"})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(p:Process) RETURN p.name AS process_name

question: What are the IP addresses of the interfaces routed by the egress router DC1-RE?
cypher: MATCH (egress:Egress {name: "DC1-RE"})-[:ROUTES]->(interface:Interface) RETURN interface.ip

question: List the first 3 movies with a budget over 50 million.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget > 50000000 RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 3

question: Who are the top 3 users that 'Neo4j' amplifies the most?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'})-[:AMPLIFIES]->(user:User) RETURN user.name, COUNT(*) AS amplification_count ORDER BY amplification_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Identify the top 5 entities by number of filings where the beneficiary bank is 'Barclays Bank Plc'.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank = 'Barclays Bank Plc' WITH e, count(f) AS filingsCount ORDER BY filingsCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN e.name, filingsCount

question: Identify the top 3 filings where the originator and beneficiary banks are in the same country.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(o:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country),       (f)-[:BENEFITS]->(b:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c) RETURN f ORDER BY f.amount DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name 3 movies that have the keyword 'jealousy'.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword {name: 'jealousy'}) RETURN m.title LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 movies with the tagline 'Welcome to the Real World' that were released after 1995.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.tagline = 'Welcome to the Real World' AND m.released > 1995 RETURN m.title, m.released ORDER BY m.votes DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify the first 3 streams that play a game and have a VIP who is a user.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:PLAYS]->(g:Game), (s)-[:VIP]->(u:User) RETURN s, g, u LIMIT 3

question: Which streams are the first 3 that have a VIP user with over 500,000 followers?
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WHERE u.followers > 500000 RETURN s.name AS stream_name, u.name AS vip_user ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies with a budget less than 10 million USD but revenue over 100 million USD?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.budget < 10000000 AND m.revenue > 100000000 RETURN m.title, m.budget, m.revenue ORDER BY m.revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all the movies that have been both directed and acted in by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, p.name AS PersonName

question: List the top 5 entities with the most recent inactivation dates.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity) WHERE e.inactivation_date IS NOT NULL RETURN e.name, e.inactivation_date ORDER BY e.inactivation_date DESC LIMIT 5

question: "Which movies have the string \"then\" in them?"
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title CONTAINS "then" RETURN m

question: Who are the top 5 actors by the number of movies acted in the 'Adventure' genre?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Adventure'}) WITH a, COUNT(m) AS movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN a.name AS actorName, movieCount

question: List the distinct 'beneficiary_bank' values for filings where the 'originator_bank' is "Deutsche Bank AG" and the 'amount' is greater than 1,000,000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing) WHERE f.originator_bank = "Deutsche Bank AG" AND f.amount > 1000000 RETURN DISTINCT f.beneficiary_bank

question: List the first 3 movies with roles that include 'Captain' and their actors.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE any(role IN r.roles WHERE role CONTAINS 'Captain') RETURN m.title, p.name, r.roles LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 products with the highest total sales quantity.
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)<-[:ORDERS]-(o:Order) WITH p, SUM(o.quantity) AS totalSalesQuantity ORDER BY totalSalesQuantity DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN p.productName, totalSalesQuantity

question: Find all movies that have the same original language and spoken language.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[:ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE]->(ol:Language)<-[:SPOKEN_IN_LANGUAGE]-(m) WITH DISTINCT m RETURN m.title

question: Which categories have the most products with a units on order greater than 20?
cypher: MATCH (p:Product)-[:PART_OF]->(c:Category) WHERE p.unitsOnOrder > 20 RETURN c.categoryName, count(p) AS ProductCount ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

question: Which actors have the highest number of movies acted in the database?
cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH a, count(m) AS numMovies ORDER BY numMovies DESC RETURN a.name AS actor, numMovies LIMIT 10

question: Find streams that have VIP relationships with more than three users.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)-[:VIP]->(u:User) WITH s, COUNT(u) AS vipCount WHERE vipCount > 3 RETURN s.name AS streamName, vipCount

question: How many orders have been shipped to the same `shipAddress`?
cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH o.shipAddress AS shipAddress, collect(o) AS orders WITH shipAddress, size(orders) AS orderCount RETURN shipAddress, orderCount

question: What is the tagline for the movie "Cloud Atlas"?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title = "Cloud Atlas" RETURN m.tagline

question: Which streams have the most chatters? List the top 5.
cypher: MATCH (s:Stream)<-[:CHATTER]-() RETURN s.name AS stream, count(*) AS chatter_count ORDER BY chatter_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the `companyName` and `phone` number of suppliers who supply products that have a `unitsInStock` value lower than their `reorderLevel`.

question: Identify the top 5 users who have a profile image URL ending with 'normal.jpg' and follow 'Neo4j'.
cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(m:Me {screen_name: 'neo4j'}) WHERE u.profile_image_url ENDS WITH 'normal.jpg' RETURN u.screen_name, u.profile_image_url ORDER BY u.followers DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find top 5 entities serviced by Mossack Fonseca.
cypher: MATCH (e:Entity {service_provider: "Mossack Fonseca"}) RETURN e ORDER BY e.node_id LIMIT 5

question: List the actors who have acted in movies directed by "Quentin Tarantino".
cypher: MATCH (d:Director {name: "Quentin Tarantino"})-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:Actor) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: What are the top 5 countries where the beneficiary banks are located, based on the total number of filings?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:BENEFITS]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, count(f) AS total_filings ORDER BY total_filings DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, total_filings

question: Name three suppliers from Germany.
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier {country: "Germany"}) RETURN s.companyName LIMIT 3

question: What is the contactName of the supplier with the lowest average product unitPrice?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s, avg(p.unitPrice) AS averagePrice ORDER BY averagePrice LIMIT 1 RETURN s.contactName

question: What are the 3 most recent movies with a status of 'Released'?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie {status: 'Released'}) RETURN m ORDER BY m.release_date DESC LIMIT 3

question: List the 3 oldest directors based on their birth date.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL RETURN d.name, d.born ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 oldest directors based on their birth year who have directed at least one movie.
cypher: MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie) WHERE d.born IS NOT NULL RETURN d ORDER BY d.born LIMIT 5

question: "which product was ordered most by a single customer?"
cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PURCHASED]->(o:Order)-[r:ORDERS]->(p:Product) RETURN p.productName, SUM(r.quantity) AS TotalQuantityOrdered ORDER BY TotalQuantityOrdered DESC LIMIT 1

question: Who are the top 3 users followed by 'Me' with the highest betweenness?
cypher: MATCH (me:Me)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u:User) RETURN u.screen_name, u.betweenness ORDER BY u.betweenness DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which zones have a size of 16?
cypher: MATCH (z:Zone) WHERE z.size = 16 RETURN z.zone AS zone

question: List movies where the reviewer gave a rating less than 50.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:REVIEWED]->(m:Movie) WHERE r.rating < 50 RETURN m.title AS movie, r.rating AS rating

question: Find the first 3 actors who acted in more than one movie with a tagline containing 'beginning'.

question: List the first 3 entities that originated filings with a beneficiary bank country of 'United Kingdom' and amount over 500000.
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity) WHERE f.beneficiary_bank_country = 'United Kingdom' AND f.amount > 500000 RETURN e.name AS entity_name ORDER BY f.begin LIMIT 3

question: List the top 5 actors by the variety of roles they played in movies.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WITH p, size(apoc.coll.toSet(collect(r.roles))) AS roleVariety RETURN p.name AS actor, roleVariety ORDER BY roleVariety DESC LIMIT 5

question: What are the first 5 movies that are part of a collection and have a budget greater than 10000000?
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(c:Collection) WHERE m.budget > 10000000 RETURN m.title, m.budget, c.name ORDER BY m.release_date LIMIT 5

question: List the top 3 movies which are in the genre 'Animation' and have been released.
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre {name: 'Animation'}) WHERE m.status = 'Released' RETURN m.title, m.release_date, m.popularity ORDER BY m.popularity DESC LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 countries by the number of videos produced there?
cypher: MATCH (v:Video)-[:PRODUCED_IN_COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WITH c.name AS country, COUNT(v) AS video_count ORDER BY video_count DESC LIMIT 5 RETURN country, video_count

question: What is the average unit price of products supplied by each supplier?
cypher: MATCH (s:Supplier)-[:SUPPLIES]->(p:Product) WITH s.companyName AS supplierName, AVG(p.unitPrice) AS averageUnitPrice RETURN supplierName, averageUnitPrice

question: What are the start times of all OS instances on machine 'DC1-RCK-1-1-M-1'?

question: List movies that have been both acted in and directed by the same person.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(p) RETURN m.title AS movie, p.name AS person

question: What is the name of the language that is used in the stream that has the least amount of total view count?

cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:RATED]->(m:Movie) WHERE NOT exists {   (u)-[:RATED]->(:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(:Genre {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) } RETURN u, m

question: Who are the people born before 1950?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born < 1950 RETURN p.name

cypher: MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director) WITH a, count(DISTINCT d) AS numDirectors WHERE numDirectors >= 3 RETURN a.name AS actor, numDirectors ORDER BY numDirectors DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the first 3 tweets by 'Neo4j' that contain a link to 'https://twitter.com'.

question: Identify the streams with the highest total view count that have a user moderator.

question: "Which are the properties of every movie in the database?"
cypher: MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, m.votes, m.tagline, m.released

question: What are the first 3 filings where the originator bank's country is 'Angola'?
cypher: MATCH (f:Filing)-[:ORIGINATOR]->(e:Entity)-[:COUNTRY]->(c:Country) WHERE c.name = 'Angola' RETURN f LIMIT 3

question: Which 3 genres contain the most movies?
